title: Na Theih Loh Man Hizaw
body:
Hong it Topa Zeisu nuntak tawntungna hi, Hehpihna leh itna tawh kidim hi Lungdam in la ka sa lungmuangin ka om ta, Kei kha muanna ka Topa Jesuh hi.

Hong itna thei lecin, hong ngaihna thei lecin,  Nang zong sang nuamlo in om kei ni teh Na theihloh man hizaw, Na telloh man hi zaw, En dihve na kha a ding hilo maw.

Sanggam aw hih leitung a ding bang Na geel ngei hiam? Na khantawn a ding zong na geel ngei hiam! Ki sathei kha kei in na khangdawng hoih lai in, Tuate paak bang vul ding na phawk thei hiam?

A kimuh theih lai-in a hong nai om lai in, Hong tung ding na zon hang na muhloh hun, Hong tunma tu-mah in, Amah nial nawn kei-in, En dih ve na kha a dingin hong kun.

title: Ngaklah Veng
body:
En ven ka tenna gamnuam, Leimi te a teel zawhloh, Mizawng mipoite leh tagahte nopsakna gam, Kei hong simmawh kha ke’n maw,Inn leh lo ka neihloh hang, Lei inn sang a pha zaw, vanah inn nuam ka nei hi

Ngaklah veng, tua khuapi ka tun hun ding, To Jesuh a khutpawn ka let ni ciang Lungdamna khituite a luang dinga, Kei hong honpa aw ci’n lungdamin la ka sa ding

En ven tuuno anglai ah, melsia mipoi tampi te, Vanmi bang mel etlawm Topa’n bawlpha khinzo ta, Lei ah ih kosiat nate kham lukhu in khuta uh, A lu tung tee ziahziah, suangmanpha tawh kizem hi.

Sihna hanmual hong liamsan,A paisa it leh ngaih te’n, Hih lei gentheihna gam, nusia in hong pai un ci, Kei ngai in kap kei unla, kei omna ah hong pai un, Ih tun ding hong ngaklahVan khuapi pan khut hong van,

title: Gupna Bukim
body:
Gupna bukim hong pia Jehovah Pasian, Dikna tawh hong tuam Jehovah Tsidkenu, Hong ompih tawntung Jehovah shamah Lungnopna Jehovah Shalom.

 Hong hausak hi, ka sapna teng hong sikJehovah Jireh, Hong damsak Pasian Jehovah Rapha Ama min a ding thuman lampi ah hong kha Jehovah Ra-ah, Gualzawhna hong pia ka Topa Jehovah Nissi

Topa’n hiteh hong cih leh hipah hiteh, Topa’n neiteh hong cih leh a nei hi teh, Topa’n bawlthei hong cih leh hipah hi. Vangliatna khempeuh hong piazo.

Topa’n damteh hong cih leh a dam hiteh, Topa’n hauteh hong cih leh a hau hiteh, Sih ding nat ding launa pan hong gum hi, Singlamteh tung’h hong thuaksakzo.

title: Mi Nuamsa
body:
Mi nuamsa in mi nuam sa in, Sun leh zan in Topa thu lungngai mi hi A nopsakna in Topa thu sung bek hi, A tawntungin Topa tungah lungdam hi.

Gunngei a kisuan singkung bang hi a, A teh vullo, a gah hunin gah den a, A sepna peuh ah, tangtungin nuamsa hi, Sun leh zan in a thu ngai leng nuam ka sa.

Ih Topa hoih hi, ih Topa hoih hi, Thupha hong pia ka kha tha hong dimsak hi. Kei hong damsak hi, hauhna tawh hong tuam hi. Gual zote tung’h gualzo pente ih hi hi.

Lungdam kohna tawh, lungdam kohna tawh Tatsa lo in Topa hoihna gengen ning A thu lungngai leng lungngai leng nuam semsem A hoihna gen, gengen ning phat tawntung ning.

title: Pasian Ta Ka Hi Zo
body:
Pasian ta Zeisu Khazih kapom ka up ciangin, Pasian ta cihna thu kangah, Satan ta panin Pasian ta ka hizo, Kei tangin ka To Zeisu hong thuaksak hangin

(Cho)Pasian ta ka hizo, Topa kaphat den ding, Leitung mi’n hong theihpih loh hangin, Vantungmi sak theihloh sisan manphat na la Vantung kham khua sungah zong hih la kasa ding hi.

 Hot khiatna omkei leh, sing tung’h thah ding ka hi, Sing lamteh mimawh sih na’ng hi, A hih hang Zeisu’n, kei ma mawhna tang in, Sihna mual singlamteh tung’h kikhen khin zo ta,

Ka mawhna a tam hang, Zeisu ka up ciangin A si in ka mawh sawp siang zo, Kei septheih omlo, hong hehpih na hangin, Tua sisan hang mawhnei pi midik ka tang ta,

Hehpih na’n upna tawh gupna kangah khin zo Tawntung mun ding ka nei zota, Leitung mi’n theilo, A lam dang tatna thu A tawntung Topa minphat na’ng langaih ka neita

title: Ani Ni-in Nuam Semsem
body:
A tawntung ka kumpipa,A tawntung ka lawmpa, A tawntung gualzawhna hong pia, Nisim lam hong lak a, nisim tha hong dim, Nisim gualzawhna hong pia.

(Buai na veng mang veh)2 Ka lawmpa ka kumpipa ka phat tak teh, Pasian gam leh ama dikna zong masa leng  Ani ani in nuam semsem.

Vantung gam kham khuapi nuam,A tawntung tang zihziah, It leh ngaih te’tual len gam, Eite hong dawn dingin, nisim kiging den uh, Nuam zen si’n teh tua mun nuam.

title: Hun Hoih Hun Nuam
body:
Hun hoih hun nuam hong musak, Hun kilawm hong ngahsak, Hun manpha sung’h hong tonpih ka To, Zum leh hiam pan’n hong hem, Lauh huaina pan hong keem, Cidam takin a minpha ka lo.

Lungdam si’ng, hunpha sungah,Ka Topa’n lam hong pi,  Na si-pha tawh hong naisak in,  Nang omna peuh lungnopna ka nunna’n vang nei,  Nong itna kei sungah, mei bangin lum den hen, Hallelujah a minthang hen.

Silh leh ten an leh tui dawn, nisim hong sik hong vak, A bei theilo hehpihna thupha, Ka kha a ding zong hong lui, Thu leh la tawh hong vak Hi ci bangin hong luang a thupha.

Lono hing silsial bangin, unok paak palh bangin, Ka nuntakna hong nosuak sak zel, Pahtawi dingin kilawm pen phat dingin zong hoih pen, Ka khatha hong dimzel, hong dimzel.

title: A Bei Theilo Hehpihna
body:
A bei theilo hehpihna leh, itna in kizom den a, Zing nisuak bangin thakzel a, ni a suah pelmawh bang hi.

 Itna kip leh hehpihna in, mihingta te tungah, Nabawl lamdang nate hangin,Topa nang kong phat uhhi. Leivui panin nong lamto a ninphual paninnong domto hi. Pahtawina leh minthan na tawh Ka nunna nong heisak hi.

 Nang na hoih hi, nang na hoih hi,  Na itna kip tawntung hi, Na kilawm hi, na kilawm hi ,Phat dingin na kilawm hi.

Nang na lian hi, na thuman hi, Nang tawh kibang omlo hi.  Nong lahsa thulamdang te hang, Ka dai om mawk thei kei hi.

title: Topa aw Ka Lungdam Hi
body:
Van leh lei piangsak Pasian, Ni leh kha piang sak Pasian, Ka nuntakna a hong bawl ka Pasian,  Nitaang leh guahtui hong pia, tuk ciangin an hong la sak,  Na vangliatna kong phat hi ka Pasian.

Topa aw ka lungdam hi, Nisim nong lungdam sak hi, Ka hin’ lai teng na min ka phat den ding, Tumging tawh nang kong phat ding,Lamna tawh nang kong phat ding, Halelujah na minthang den ta hen.

Tu ni in kei a dingin hun hoih hunnuam hong kipia, Topa’ tung’ lungdamna ka ko ding hi. Lungdam koh biakna pia in Topa ka pahtawi ding hi, Ka hatna teng tawh a min ka phat ding.

Khat veivei nek ding neilo, khat veivei silh ding neilo, Ahi zong Topa hoihna ka phawk hi, Van a leng vasate leh gamlak unok paakte in, Ka nunna nisim in tha hong dim zel.

title: LEIBAT DANG NEINAWN KENG
body:
Vang liatna kangah khina, Pasian ta ka hih nung sang Lungdamna koh ding sim loh, Leibat dang ke’n neinawn keng.

Hong hon ding khat zong neilo, Khitui luang ka om laitak, Ka khitui hong nulsak a, A ang sung kei hong pomta,

Natna in kei hong tuam in, Hong veh ding ka neihloh lai, Thoto in na dam zo hi, Hong cih man ka damsiang ta,

Tu’n keipawh patau nawn ke’ng, Mawh maisak pa nei zo ing, Mawhna in kei hong zol hang, Jesuh hang gupna ngah tang.

title: NA THU SUNGAH NUAM SA ING
body:
(Na thu sungah nuamsa ing)2 Na thu sung bek mah lam-etna nei ing. Mitte vaksak in lungsim nuam sak hi. Na thu sungah Topa kei hong kha in.

 Na thu in lam hong lak meivak hi, (Halelu-ah) Ka pai na lampi khua hong vak sak hi. A lamdang nate ka muhtheih nang in, Na thu sungah, Topa kei hong kha in.

Mihing te’ nuntakna in an leh tui bek hilo hi, Pasian kammal thutak tawh nungta hi, Hih thu a theih nangin Mana tawh vak hi, Sehnel gamah Topa in thuhilh hi.

(Topa a muang khempeuh te)2 Zan a ihmut kal in hong cing ding hi. Na khanlawh ciang zong hong hopih ding hi,  Na gamtatzia ding zong hong hilh ding hi.

title: ZEISU MAW A THUPHA
body:
(Na thu sungah nuamsa ing)2 Na thu sung bek mah lam-etna nei ing. Mitte vaksak in lungsim nuam sak hi. Na thu sungah Topa kei hong kha in.

 Na thu in lam hong lak meivak hi, (Halelu-ah) Ka pai na lampi khua hong vak sak hi. A lamdang nate ka muhtheih nang in, Na thu sungah, Topa kei hong kha in.

Mihing te’ nuntakna in an leh tui bek hilo hi, Pasian kammal thutak tawh nungta hi, Hih thu a theih nangin Mana tawh vak hi, Sehnel gamah Topa in thuhilh hi.

(Topa a muang khempeuh te)2 Zan a ihmut kal in hong cing ding hi. Na khanlawh ciang zong hong hopih ding hi,  Na gamtatzia ding zong hong hilh ding hi.

title: TUU BANG HONG CINGPA
body:
Topa in kei hong cing tuucing lianpa hi, Ka nun sung bangmah ka kisam kei ding hi, Lono na mun tui kiangah kei hong kha hi, Ka nuntakna tha hong dim sak tawntung hi.

Hoihna leh hehpihna in ka khan sung, A tawntungin hong zui taktak dinga, Anuam a taang Topa inn pha sungah, Amah tawh ka om den ding hi.

Sihna lim guam sung na ngawn ka nawk hangin, Hong cing ahih ma’n siatna ka lau kei hi, A molhtum leh a ciangkhut in kei a hi. A tawntungin ka lungmuanna ahi hi.

Ka galte omna mai ah kei a dingin, Sabuai phah in an hong lui in hong vak hi Keima lu zong sathau hong nilh sak den a, Ama kiangah bang ka ngen lai khong ding hiam!

title: SI NAWNLO DING
body:
Lawp gige ing zingsang khat peuh ciang Gabriel pengkul tum ke’n za ning, Sinawnlo ding ka khanlawh ciang It huai tanpa mu ding ka dawnteh, Lungdam awng in lei nusia ning Sinawnlo ding ka khanlawh ciang (Sinawnlo ding) Zingsang khat peuh ciang (Ka khanlawh ciang) Suang manpha kizem, (Lungdam si ning) Minthanna gamah, (Vantung khuapi ah) Hih thu sutsut ning, A khang akhang a tatsa mite tawh, Amah bia in phat khawm ta ding, Sinawnlo ding ka khanlawh ciang.

Mitphiat kal sungin pumthak nei ning, Pasian a minthang den ta hen, Sinawnlo ding ka khanlawh ciang ,Tua khuapi ka zuat toh tak ciangin ,Dahna teng mangpha khak ning ke’n, Sinawnlo ding ka khanlawh ciang.

A ki tansa minam khempeuh tawh, Vantung hoihna ke’n velvel ning, Sinawnlo ding ka khan lawh ciang, Tuidam luanna singkung dum gei-ah, Khawlna ding mun ke’n ka mu ding, Singnawnlo ding ka khanlawh ciang.

title: TUNGLAM KA ET TOH LEH
body:
Tunglam ka ettoh leh van dumpi ka mu a, Mualdawn meeiluumkai-te vanmong bang ka mu a, Ahih hang ka muh nailoh, genzawhloh in tam a, Hih thu ka ngaihsut ciang, Topa bangzah na lian,

Tua hi a, Topa aw kong phat hi Na hihna bangin hong phat ning, Na khempeuhte na khut sung, A patna leh a tawpna, Vanglian khut in len, Hih thu ka ngaihsut ciang Topa bangzah na lian

Hih leitung bangmah lo tungah a kaisak hi. Sun in ni zan in kha aksi te tang sak hi, Amaute a hun zui in ki hei diamdiam uh hi, Hih thu ka ngaihsut ciang Topa bangzah na lian.

Vantung vannuai mun khempeuh ah nang na om hi. Tuipi thuk sung nangawnah zong na ki zel hi.  Na thu sung na koihsate damdam nong musak a ,Hih thu ka ngaihsut ciang, Topa bangzah na lian.

title: NANG OM NA PEUH
body:
Topa nang om na peuh ah, ka kha in zong nuam sa hi. Vul in kun ka kha kun cih om ngei lo. Z ing dai momlai pak palh bang lung tai et lawm nuih mai in.  Nang om na peuh ka kha in nuam sa hi.

Nang om na peuh ka kha in nuam sa hi. Sun le zan a tawntung in. Kei kha muanna nang na hi.

Topa nang om na peuh ah lungnop suahtakna om hi .Huatna, enna, kitot na om ngei lo. Sun kim ka lunggulh pen nang, zangciang ka zalmang na hi.  Nang om na peuh ka kha in nuam sa hi.

Topa nang om na peuh ah, lawm hoih khat nei gige ing,  Nang ma sung lo bukna ding dang omlo. Sep na peuhah lung kim na, hei na peuh ah mai tai na,  Nang om na peuh ka kha in nuam sa hi.

Ka gumpa le ka Topa, ka belh suangpi nang na hi. Nisim hongliah hongdal ka suangpi aw. Cimawh meigong tangahte,A ding lawm hoih pen na hi. Nang om na peuh ka kha in nuamsa hi.

title: VA BANG KA LENG DING
body:
Topa Zeisu’n hih bang thugen, manlang in kong paikik ding hi, Mi siangtho te hongpi ding in, Thu um misi te thoto ding, mitphial kalsung in ki khel ding, Kham innpi sungah vabang in leng to ding.

Va bang in kei ka leng ding hi’ Nisuah nitum sak leh khang pan, Thu um mite ki kaikhawm ding,

Kham innpi ah vabang in leng to ding.

Jerusalem kham khuathak ah, vantung mite ki kaikhawm in, Thu um mite tawh kimu ding, (Hallelujah)4 Lungdam kipak in Pasian phat den ding.

Kham innpi ah kei ka tung ding, Topa’n khitui hong nulsak ding, Natna sihna te om nawn lo,

(Hallelujah)4 Lungdam kipak in Pasian phat den ding.

title: NUAM AW
body:
Mi siangte totsa a tang a kawcik lampi khat om ei, Ih mai ah a paisa gal hang te’n bawlsiatna thuak hi. Hong pina leh a gualzawhna te hangin na lungdam leh, Khukdin in lungdamna ko aw, nangah thupha hangin.

Nuam aw, paakte leh singkungte hangin, Nuam aw, mualte leh tuipite hangin, Nuam aw, nang leh kei hong hinsak man in, Koi koi om ta le teh nuam aw.

Hih leitungah dahna gentheihna leh huaihamna dim ei, A kang ngeilo ciktui om a, sapna teng kicing sak hi, Topa kamciamna muang peuh leng, mikim a ding kicing ei,  Na thupha simsim lel dih in, A dang na nget ma in,

Topa hong vaikhaksa bangin a lampialte maisak aw, Bang hih cih theilo ahih man’ amawh maisak in cizen, Amau te’n zong tel uh hi leh a nunna kikhel lel ding, Amau ten na sanggam hi cih phawk in la huh khial ke’n

title: VAN MITE SAK THEIH LOH LA
body:
Van mite’n ka lungdam lam hong theipih kei, ’Sisan tawh a maumawhna sawp kullo pi, Vantungah la a sak uh hangin khat vei, Lamdang itna la ka sak ciang daitak ngai ding uhhi.

Tua siangtho van mite saktheihloh la in, Lamdang itna ke’n ngaih lua sa’ng, Tua siangtho van mite sak theihloh la in, Hong kimu zo ka gam man hang.

Van mite’n la a sa Topa siangtho hi, Pasian tokhom mai-ah lasa den keei veh, Amau la ka sakpih ding bel lamdang kei, Hong it manin la ka sak pih lam bel thei kei unteh.

title: PIA IN HONG DIM DING HI
body:
Na thuphate sim dih in, khat khit khat ngaihsun dihve, Pasian in a tampi hong piak na thei ve leh, Na neek ding leh na piak ding zong hong sik lailai ai ve, Pia in mi nuamsa na hih lam kithei niteh.

(Pia in (Hong dim ding hi))2  Ngahna sangin piakna ah, thupha om zaw hi, Na sum omna mun ah, na lungsim om ding hi, Pia in pia in na lungdam, na lungdam ding hi.

Meigongnu sathau um sung,Sathau sawh khat zong om lo, A piak manin thupha luang a zah tampi, Kial sung tawntung sathau um,Sathau tawh kilawi nawnlo, Nang zong pia in Topa hoihna na mu ding hi.

A cinghte hau semsem ven, Acilte zawng semsem ve, Piakkhiatna in itna hi, Pasian dan hi veh, Cimawh genthei mizawngte,Meigong tagah dongtuakte, Piakna tawh itna lak in kisik kei niteh.

Piaknoplohna tawh thupha kongvangte ki khak thei a, Hazatna leh iksikna tawh hong khem thei hi. A phalte khang semsem ding, a itte kiam semsem ding Neih man a piak hilo a, phal man hi zaw hi.

title: AW A LAM DANG ITNA LIAN
body:
Mi mawh kahih laitak in, galte kahih laitak in, A sipha tawh kei hong lei in hong dam sak, Ka vangik teng hong zang, ka lungdamna hong ki dang, Aw a lamdang itna lian kei sungah.

 Aw a lamdang itna lian, Aw a lamdang itna lian, Calvary panin hong luang Halelujah Praise the Lord, Ih lungdamna tangthu, ih gualzawhna sut dih ni, Aw a lamdang itna lian kei sungah

Ka maawhna a tam hangin, ka khialhna a tam hangin, Tua te sangin hong hehpihna lian zaw lai, Hihthu mah khumpen sang,Hihthu mahmah ngaihpen sang, A khum penpen khuaizu sangin khum zawlai

Ka lametna kip semsem, Ka lungmuanna kho semsem, Zeisu hoihna tawh nisim in kei hong zem, Hih thu katheih nungsang, upna taawh ka san nungsang Kei sungah hongdim semsem ka tel semsem.

Pasian minthang semsem hen,Pasian’gam zai semsem hen, Vantung nopna mikim sungah hong tung hen, Tua a lamdang lungnopna, Ih gualzawhna la ngaih pen, Leitung mimal tungah hong kizeel ta hen.

title: TUA BANG NGEINGEI
body:
Tuivot ciim in dangtak mite a lungdam sak bangin, Bawlsiatna thuak lungtamkham mite, Hotkhiatna lampi tawnin hong paikhiat pih tak ciangin Lungdam luan’n a manguh bang liang ee,

Tua bang ngeingei, tuan bang ngeingei Sihna leh hell panin Topa’n hong honkhia,  Na mite hauhna kham leh ngun tawn na paikhiatpih bang ngei, Kei a dingin Zeisu hong kipia.

San tuipi kantansak in leikeu tawn na paipih a, Sun in meiipi zanin mei khuampi, A puansilhte uh sialo, a khe uh zong bawklo a, Cidam in a zawngkhal omlo hi.

Bawlsiatna thuakin thumin nakpi’n hong kiko ciang un,  Na kamciam thute na phawk kik a, Na nasem Abraham leh nangma min na khualna in, Amaute hehpih in na honkhia.

Amaute vakvai in khualmi bangin a omlai un, Top’n kuamah nenniam saklo hi, Kumpite thuhilh in ka kamsangte sukha kei un, Ci in a mite hu in kem hi.

Sa ngen in vamim sa pia vantung an lumte khiat a,  Neek ding kitasam sak ngei lo hi, Dawn ding tui suangpi pan phul guntui bangin luang sak a, Lungdam lasa kawm in paipih hi.

title: LAU PEUH MAH KE’N
body:
Ka lungmuanna khat om, Lua ke’n kata aw ci, Hong thapia aw neem khat ka za, Na lampi kong honsak lungkhamna kuampite, Lametna kongpi kong suaksak ding.

Lau peuh mah ken ka ta aw, Vangliatna khempeuh kong pia zo, Kei na hong up uh leh keima bawl sang lian zaw, Na bawl thei ding uh hi, ka kammalte nungkik lo.

Kha siangtho in hong sawl, Topa minthanna ding, Na khutte tung’h vangliatna kong koih, Na mukte hong lawngin, ka thu leh ka kammalte, Kong koihsak khinzo hi, lau kei in.

Na guallehna lampi, gualzawhna tawh na tawn ding, Thahat inla hangin hong ci, Lauke’n la lungkia ke’n, Na mai ah gualzawhna inHong ngak cih tel inla lau kei in

title: KHA SUNGAH BUAL KHAWM LENG
body:
Lamdang lua aw lamdang lua sang liangvai kei a ding, Dahna khitui hong nulsiang ta, nuamna vive dim ta, Hong itna tel semsem leng, nuamna khitui hong luang, Leitung hauhna sang manpha zaw, nopna kei a hi ta

.Aw Zeisu a kha siangtho hong leeng Zeisu Inn kuan sung hong om ciang,  Nu leh pa’n zong lasa khawmta, tate zong hong lamta, Ih inn kuan in lasa khawm leng, Buaina lah om nawn lo.

Kitot kiselna om nawnlo, nuamna vive dimta, Nu pa kal zong hng nuam semsem, kha sung bualkhawm leng, Tu leh tate masuan in, biak inn lam pai khawmta, Kitten kum lah hong tam semsem, Ngaih meel lah hoih semsem

Thangvan laukha siangtho hong leeng,Kawl gam hong phong dingin Vangliatna dim itna khut tawh, tuailai teng hong man ta, Enven hia lai khangnote biak inn ah hong laam ta, Hunkhat lai a a mangthangsa ih tate ai ve leh.

title: KA NUNNA HONG BAWL HOIH SAK
body:
Lam et bei ka om lai, lungmuanna hong tung a, Ka mai ah meiivompi hong kai in ka lampi, Mial in a lauhuai hang khuavak ni hong tang ta, Kei a ding hong pai Zeisu kumpi.

Kei tang a ding hong sihlawh ka Topa’n Tawntung nunna lampi hong tun zo Kei tang a ding hong suplawh ka Topa’n, Ka nuntakna hong bawl hoih sak zo

Pheiphung suan kham in bah, mitguite kham in zeu, Khat veivei lei gawtak tui omlohna gam ah ,Singkung bang ka nunna, huihkhi dam sem in keu, Ka om lai tak Zeisu hong delh pah.

Kei tang dingin hong ding, kei tang ding hong kithawi, Kei thuak ding teng hong thuak, kei septangin hong sem Kei a ding hong thumsak kei tangin mawhlawh tawi ,Siattutna teng a ma’n tual in lem

title: VAN A PA AW KONG PAHTAWI UH HI
body:
//Van a pa aw nang kong pahtawi uh hi// Hong it ung, hong bia ung, Na mai ah hong kun ung Van a pa aw nang kong pahtawi uh hi

//Pasian ‘ ta aw namin hong liansak ung// Mawhna pan nongsawp a Khasiangtho nong guan hi Pasian ‘ ta aw namin hong liansak ung

//Khasiangtho Lamdang hehnempa na hi// Ka lampi nong hilh a, Ka sungah nong teng hi Khasiangtho Lamdang hehnempa na hi

title: GUALZAWHNA SANG PEN
body:
Huntawp a Topa muh ciang, A phatna la ih sak ciang, Tuani gualzawhna a sangpen hi ding. Mi dikte tawh khatvei ciang,Gal khat munnuam ih tun ciang, Tuani gualzawhna a sangpen hi ding.

Tuani gualzawhna a sangpen a sangpen hi ding, Tua ni gualzawhna a sang pen hi ding Kumpipa inn ih tun ciang,Hosiana cin ihsak ciang, Tuani gualzawhna a sangpen hi ding.

Mi siangte tawh khatvei ciang,Kham kongzing ih zuih khop ciang, Tuani gualzawhna a sangpen hi ding Van mite tawh khatvei ciangTawntung la I sak khop ciang Tuani gualzawhna sang pen hi ding

Haksatna teng hong bei ciang,Kumpi lukhu ih ngah ciang Tuanni gualzawhna a sangpen hi ding, A tawntung mun ih tun ciang,Kumpipa mai I din ciang, Tuani gualzawhna a sangpen hi ding.

title: TOPA MITE TOPA A TE
body:
Topa mite, Topa a te, lei pian mapek a keteel sa te, Topa mite, Topa a te, lei pian mapek a keteel sa te,

Ni dangin gamlapi ah ka om ngei hangin, Tu’n Zeisu sisan hangin Pasian kiang tung zo, Zeisu singlamteh hangin khualmi zong hilo, Pasian inn kuanpih khat ka hi zo

Na kha a ding huihdik in thungen tawntung in, Na kha a ding an ahi Lai Siangtho sim in, Na kha a ding thasan in Topa’ nasem in, Tua in Christian nuntakna ai ve.

Kha thupha ngahna dingin, hehpih phatna te, Kha thupha luanna dingin, thupha bawlna te, Kha sung suahtakna dingin, laamna dianna te Tua te’n damna zatui bang ai ve

title: CARMEL MUAL AH
body:
Carmel mual ah Pasian gualzawhna te mu dingin, Hong pai mite Topa’n thupha hong pia hen, Elijah bang Pasian gualzawhna te mu dingin, Carmel mualah Topa’n thupha hong pia hen.

Sa un, Hallelujah la sa un, Carmel Pasian mite gualzawhna, Sangpen Topa gualzawhna hangin na lungdam leh,  Nuam un Hallelu Hallelujah.

Kha khanlawhna mei bangin hong tawhkik in Topa, Kha siangtho aw hih munah kong muak uh hi. Ko aa dingin na lamdang leh na vangliatna te, Hong musak in na thupha kong muak uh hi.

Topa a ding khut kilen in nasem khawm ve ni, Na septheih bang Top’n thupha hong pia hen,  Na septhei bang Topa min tawh kong sang zo uh hi Topa gamzaina dingin pang ciat ve ni.

title: JEHOVAH PASIAN
body:
Jehovah Shalom nopna Pasian ka up ka san a kipan, Telzawhloh lungnopna nei tang, Nisim hih leitung nunna sungah, Nopna dahna ka thuak zong, Ka nopna Jehovah Shalom

(Aw nuam sing Topa tungah)2 Lungdamna la thak Topa kong sak ding, Jesuh tawh ka kimuta, a hoihna ka telsiangta, Kei a ding ka bangkim Jehovah Pasian.

Ka mawhna khempeuh hong maisak Pa, Natna teng hong damsak Pa,Ka muzo Jehovah Rapha, Hih leitung neekzon haksatna leh, Nate hang lunghiang nawn keng, Ka zawhna Jehovah Nissi.

Jehovah Jireh hong sik Pasian,Tu ciangciang hong huh Topa ,Kei a ding amah hoihpen hi. Ama vangliatna sung om hauhna ,Ka sapna teng hong cingsak, Hong sikpa Jehovah Jireh.

title: ZEISU MAW A THUPHA
body:
(Na thu sungah nuamsa ing)2 Na thu sung bek mah lam-etna nei ing. Mitte vaksak in lungsim nuam sak hi. Na thu sungah Topa kei hong kha in.

 Na thu in lam hong lak meivak hi, (Halelu-ah) Ka pai na lampi khua hong vak sak hi. A lamdang nate ka muhtheih nang in, Na thu sungah, Topa kei hong kha in.

Mihing te’ nuntakna in an leh tui bek hilo hi, Pasian kammal thutak tawh nungta hi, Hih thu a theih nangin Mana tawh vak hi, Sehnel gamah Topa in thuhilh hi.

(Topa a muang khempeuh te)2 Zan a ihmut kal in hong cing ding hi. Na khanlawh ciang zong hong hopih ding hi,  Na gamtatzia ding zong hong hilh ding hi.

title: SUL HONG HEI VAW
body:
Pasian gam leh dikna Pasian thu leh deihna, Thupi tak ngaihsun dih ni ,Leitung nate sangin, thu dangdangte sangin, Zong masa zaw le cin,Tua nate tawh hong pia khawm ding hi,

Sul hong hei vaw sanggam aw,Sianmang sinthu anbang kumkhawm in ah,Amai zong dih ni. Vanman tam a, ih lungkham na te,Zeisu zawhna sungah hong tui suak ding hi.Van daituite hong luang ding hi.

A thu sung kibual leng, a kha sung kibual lengAma thu ah lungkim leng, Ih lunggulhnate thei, ih tangsap nate nei,Ih ngaihsutna sangin, hong pia nuam zaw,Amah muang peuh leng.

Haksatna hong tun ciang, lungkhamna hong tun ciang, Gilkial dangtak ih thuak ciang,Pasian mai zong zaw ni, Pasian mai en zaw ni,Midangte muan ding sang, Zeisu kumpi muan ding hoih zaw hi.

Ih gitlohna pan in I lungsim niamkhiat in, Ih Topa kiang zuan dih ni.Ih lungsim sungkhia in ih mawhna pulak leng,Tua hi leh I gam sung, thupha hong pia’nHong dam sak ding hi.

title: HONGSAP CIANG KA DAWNG DING
body:
Itna tawh kei hong beel a hih man in, A mah kahonkhia ding hi, A mah in kamin thei a hih man in, Munsang na ah ka koih ding hi.

A man kei hongsap ciang kadawng ding a, Haksat na sungah nang kong ompih ding hi, A mah honkhia in ka pahtawi ding a,

Nuntak sau tawh nang kong lungkimsak ding hi.

Nangtungah siatna na inn ah gimna, Hong tungsak ngei lo ding hi, Na mai ah tulkhat, na kim ah tulsawm, Hong puk hangin na lau kei ding hi.

Sun a thaltang leng, zan a lauhuai na,

Hongsu khasak loding hi, Topa’ liim sungah naling kei ding hi, Vantungmi ten’ nang hong cing ding hi.

title: JEHOVAH SHALOM
body:
Ka mai ah lungkham cihmawh lawhsam gensiat na bek dim a, Dawi gilo leh Satan in, hong kaih zel hang, Jehovah Shalom in hong ngak den.

Jehovah Shalom kalungmuan na, Jehovah Jireh ka hauhna, Kisap ding bangmah lau keng, Topa’n hong ompih den hi.

Hong langpan dawi gilo te’n, Hong khemna dan ka telsiang ta, Sihna ih pawl hilo hi, panpih kei un, Jehovah Shalom in hong ompih.

Aw ih Topa Pasian in, Lau kei un hong cihkhit nung sang,

Lungmuang takin omlel in, Na mai ah ka ding den ding hong ci.

title: JERUSALEM THAK AH
body:
Mittaw khuamialpi sungah om in, Leitung nopsak nate mulo mah ta leng, To Zeisu kiangha ka tunhun ciangin, Mittaw khuamial omlo Jerusalem thak ah.

Kipak in lasa ning, Hallelujah ci in, Aw ken ngaklah lua ing tua munnuam bel, To Zeisu kiangah ka tun hun ciang in,

Mittaw khuamial omlo Jerusalem thak ah.

Khebui, khutbui in melsia gawp in, Bengngong pautheilo in poimawh mah leng, Hong honpa kiangah katun hun ciangin, Mipoi miphak omlo Jerusalem thak ah.

Gitlohna tawhdim hih leitung ah,

Kamel in ni sangin taang zawphial mah leng, Tawntung nuntakna mun nuam ka luah ciang, Gitlohna hih leitung ke’n ngai ngei nawn kei ning.

title: BEEL TAMPI HONG PAIPIH IN
body:
Na lungsung Topa’h thupha a dim hong piak na dingin,  Na lunggulh hiam tuni in. Na pa hongciamna muangin la, A hongcih bang hong pai in,Taang misiangte’ pai bangin.

 Na lungsung dimlet dong tuni’n hong buak ding hi. Topa hongsawlna bangin, beel tampi hong paipih in. Na lung sung dimlet dong tuni’n hong buak ding hi. Khasiangtho vanglet na tawh.

Zesu sisan sianthosaksa na leibeel te hong kengin. Hong pai un a sam dang zong . Pasian tokhom mai ah napumpi kipia inla ngakin. Kha siangtho hong ki buak dong.

Sathau bei ngeilo bangin hong hehpih na’n bei hun neilo. Hong it na zong bei lo hi. A’ hong ciamnasa bangin khasiangtho vanglian kiteh lo. Beel khempeuh dimsak ding.

title: BETLEN KHUANEU MITE
body:
Betlenkhuaneu mite nolah ihsip ta maw. Hong gum Zeisu hong suak hilo maw. Tuucingte’n zong nuamin hongbia uh. Leimi ta ding hong kipia naugek.

Tuzan kimlai a lungdamhuai bel thu. Betlen khuasung bawngan neek na kuang sung. Hong gum khazih Zeisu naungek Minthanghen mi tung nopna om hen.

Kongit lawmaw tuni’n, nangsung mun a awng maw. Honggum Zeisu naungek suak nuam hi. Bawngkuang sunglo mundang awnglo maw. Na lung sungah tuni’n suak sak in.

A lam dang aksipi’n mipilte lamhilh hi. Kham leh paaknamtui tawh bia uh hi. Kiniamkhiat a hongsuak To Zeisu. Lungdam in eizong va bia ve ni.

title: GAM SA TE’N LUITUI LUANG
body:
Gamsa te’n luitui luang sialsial a lunggulh bang Topa nang kong lunggulh hi. Nangmah bek ka lungsim deihna lehBiak dingin kong lunggulh hi.

Nangmah bek ka hatna ka lum, Nang kiangbek ka hong kipia hi. Nangmah bek ka lungsim leh ka deihna, Biak dingin kong lunggulh hi.

title: Nong Zui Diam
body:
(Lawm aw nong Zui diam tua gamah)3 kei pai ning, (Lawm aw nong Zui diam tua gamah)2 Tua gam ah tua gam ah kei pai ning.

-Bawngnawi leh Khuai zuluang tua damah, -itna bek omhi tua gamah, -Zeisu kamu ding tua gam ah, -Tua gamin Vantung hilo maw.

title: KA MUAN NA ZEISU A HI
body:
Keimah ka muanna a bulpi. Zeisu si leh sianthona hi. A dang thu teng ka um ngamkei. Zeisu a min bek ka um thei.

Keima dinna Zeusu suangpi (Omna dangteng sehnel bang hi.)2

Khuamial in A mailiahciangin. A hong heipihna ka muang ding. Huihpi nakpi a nun ciangah. Munliah na sungah sikkip khia.

A thuciam nate a ma si. Tuipi kanlai ka muangding hi. Ka kimkot teng asiat ciangah. Kamuan na in Zeisu Topa.

Pengkul aw tawh a pai ciangin. Ama mai-ah ka ding nuam hi. A hong siangtho sak khit ciangin. Mawh nei loin ka om ding hi.

title: AMAH’N HONGKHA
body:
Amah’n hong kha hih thu mah mah, Heh nemna dim thupha ahi, Kasepna ka paina tengah, Pasian khutin kei hong kha hi.

A mah’n hong kha, Amah’n hong kha, Ama khut tawh A mah’n hong kha, A nung mantak kazui dinghi, Ama khut in kei hong kha hi.

Khatvei leh Edan bang nuam na, Khatvei khuamialna thukpi, Bangka tuak hang muanna launa, Ama khutin kei hong kha hi.

Phunlo puamlo lungkim takin, Topa nakhut kalen nuam hi, Bangbang thuakzong bang lungkhamna, Ka Pasian in kei hong kha hi.

Na hehpihna tawh galzo a, Nasep ka khit ciang a vekpi, Sih ding lau lo Pasian in ah, Jordan gungal ah hong kha hi.

title: THUCIAM NA PHA MUANG NING
body:
Topa thuciamna pha muang takin om ning, A tawntungin hong gum Topa vang um ning, A min thang hi ci in ah ka ki ko hi. A thuciamna pha ka muang ding hi.

Muangin, Om ning, Hong gum Topa Pasian thuciamnaphaMuang ning, Muangin, om ning, Honggum Topa Pasian thuciam muang ning.

A siatheilo Topa thuciamna ka muang, Up khialh man a launa huih bang hongnun hang, Nuntak nang a athuphabel tawh zawh nang, A thuciamna pha ka muang ding hi.

Tu in a thuciamna muangin ka om hi, A sipha tawh hong sawp leh ka siang ding hi, Mawhna sung pan suahtak ding thu ka ngah hi, A thuciamna pha ka muang ding hi.

Topa Zeisu na thuciamna ka muang hi, Athupha tawh khaubangin hong hen ding hi, Khasiangtho tawh dawimangpa ka zo ding hi, A thuciamna pha ka muang ding hi

title: HONPA TUUCING BANG HONG PI IN
body:
Honpa tuu cingbang hongpi- in, Nong huai na ko kisam pha, Antam gamnuamah hong vak in, Hong bawlkholhsak in omna, (Thupha Zeisu, Thupha Zeisu Nong leizo kote nang aa)2

Hong pawlin nang neihsa kote, Ko paina lampi cingin Hongkem, honghuh in Na tuute Lamkhialh ciang hong zong kik in, (Thupha Zeisu, Thupha ZeisuKo thungetna hongza in)2

Mizawng mimawh ka hi uh hang, Nong ciamzo hong sang ding in, Mawhna phelna’ng, siatnang dal na’ng, Hehpihna na nei cingin, (Thupha Zeisu, Thupha Zeisu Nang lam hong ki hei sak in)2

Ka neulai un nangma pahtak, Na awi bang hongta sak in, Hong hon Topa pha aw dimtak, Nangma itna hong guan in, (Thupha Zeisu, Thupha Zeisu Nongit zo hongit lai in)2

title: HUIHPI NUN CIANG A KI DALNA
body:
I bukna suangpi Topa hi, Huihpi nun ciang aki dalna, A sia namkim a ding bit hi, Huihpi nun ciang a kidalna.

Gimna gam sungah Zeisu suangpi a hi, Belh ding suangpi, belh ding suangpi. Gimna gam sungah Zeisu suangpi ahi, Huihpi nun ciang a kidalna.

Sun in ni liim,Zanin kulhpi, Huihpi nun ciang a kidalna, Galte bangmah patau lo hi. Huihpi nunciang a kidalna

.Huihpi’n I kimkot nuai hangin, Huihpi nun ciang a kidalna, Nusia loding cikmah hun in, Huihpi nun ciang a kidalna.

Pasian suangpi belh ding ithuai, Huihpi nun ciang a kidalna, Tawntung hong nai, hong kem, hong huai,Huihpi nun ciang a kidalna

title: KEIMA TOPA ZEISU LAMDANG HONPAHI
body:
Keima Topa Zeisu lamdang honpa hi, Kei ading lamdang honpa hi, Suangpi kitam sungah ka kha hong liah sak, Nuamna gunpi bang hong musak.

Suangpi kitam sung keima kha hong liahsak, Tua suangpi’n gamgawtak liap sak, A it na sungah ka nuntakna phumta, (Ama khutin kei hong hum ta)2

Keima Topa Zeisu lamdang honpa hi, Amah’n puakhia keima vanpi, Amah’n hong len a kei kalau kei ding hi, Ka ni bangin tha hongpia hi.

Kisim zolo thupha hongpiak kimat in, Ama hoihna tawh ki dimin, Lungdam in la kasa Pasian minthang hen, Hih bang tanpa kanei hi ken

Ama dikna puanpak silha kathawh ciang, Amah dawnin ka lentoh ciang, Ama hongitna leh honghotna ki cing, Van ah awn tampi tawh sa ning.

title: PASIAN MIN THANG TA HEN
body:
Pasian minthang ta hen na lianpi bawl hi, Leitung a itluat ma’n a Ta hong pia hi, Mawhna pan suahtak nang a nunna pia hi, Mi khempeuh a ding nunna kong hong hon hi.

Phat ve un, phat ve un,Athu’n leitung zelhen, Phat ven un, phat ven un,Mikhempeuh lung dam hen, Topa Jesuh minsuang in Pa kiang zuan un,  Na lianpi bawlzo hi a minthangsak un

.Sisan tawh hong leizo tatkhiatna manzo, Aum mi ta ding Pasian kamciam omzo, Mimawh pen nangawn in Zeisu a up leh ,A up phet in a mawh maipah ding hiven,

Na lianpi hong hilh a, na lianpi bawl hi, Pasian ta hangin nopna cing ih ngah hi, Hi hang lamdang Honpa Jesu ih muh hi, Lungdam, nuamna lianzaw kan ding hi ven.

title: Kham Khuapi
body:
Sihna mualkuam galkhat ah, khuapi khat a om hi A hoihna kuaman gen zolo hi Zankimlai in tuuno aksi bangin taang a Tua a etlawm kham khuapi sungah

Tualai ah nitum lo , singteh zong vul ngeilo Midikte a tawntung aksi bangin taang a Tua a etlawm kham khuapi sungah

Tualai ah dahna natna kahna om nawnlo Misiang khempeuh zong tek thei nawnlo Tua khua ah ut sensing zan khuamial lah beita Tua a etlawm kham khuapi sungah

title: Khasiangtho'n Hong Lung Dam Sak
body: (Khasiang tho'n hong lungdam sak)3 Nuam sing Hong nuisak hi hong kap sak hi, A mah'n honglam to ding Khasiang tho in hong lung damsak,nuam sing.

title: IH THEI TEL ZAW DING HI
body:
Thupha gamnuam tun theih nang, haksat na tampi om a, Hih hang Pasian lam tawntung, mitsuan gige’n hongkha ding, Tua gamsung ih tun theih nang, sih mateng ih zui ding hi, Eite’n ih thei zaw ding hi nung ciangin.

Nung ciangin zingsang khuavak ding, Pasian misiangtho te innpi tung ding, Eite’n ih zawhna tangthu ih sutkik ding,

Eite’n ih theitel zawding hi nung ciang in.

Inn leh lo leh neek leh taak, na khempeuh ih kisam a, Nuntak na lei golgawtak, lakpi mah ih zui zel a, Hih hang Topa hongciamna, kammal eite’n muang ciat ni, Eite’n ih theitel zaw ding hi nung ciang in.

Eite lungsim siasak ding, gamtat kampau a hizong,

Phawk khakloh lauhuai ze-et bawlsiat nate ih thuak zong, Hanciam nopna takpi tawh, eite ih puk khathei zel zong, Eite’n ih theitel zawding hi nung ciang in.

title: NA KILAWM HI
body:
A kipatcil a om ka Pasian, Na khempeuh pianna kong biak Pasian, Minthana vangliatna nei Pasian, Van mi siangte phat den Pasian.

(Na kilawm hi Topa)2  Na kilawm phat dingin Topa (Na kilawm hi Topa)2 Na kilawm biak dingin Topa.,

Huihpi leh tuihual daisak theipa, Zawdan gunpi khawlsak thei Topa, Lungkham buaina teng vengsak thei Pa, Husang thei khempeuh phat den Pa,

Tapa khat neihsun a hong pia Pa, Ka suahtak nang lam hong honsak Pa, Damna hauhna nopna hong pia Pa, Nuntakna hong thahatsak Pa.

title: TEE DIAM DIAMDING MISIANG TE
body:
Zankhat Topa kha siangtho in keihong lawng a, Gamnuam khat hong musak a, Luang sialsial tui, nimdildial singcin pak silsial, Vasa’n zong lungdam lasa in leng liai liai.

Zingdam huihnung hiau hiau,Paak nantui tawh dimna, Van mi siangtho te len na, A tang kham khuapi nuam, ka luahnading mun hi (Teediam diam misiangte aksi bangtangding)2

Tua laitak van pan la ngaihpi hong ging ziahziah, Topa sap na ka za hi, Khitui luangin kanunna hong ki khel pah a, Lungdam in Zeisu angsung kadelh vingveng ta.

Gamsa te’n tui luang sialsial a lunggulh bang,T opa nang kong lunggulh hi, Nang omna peuh ka kha in nuamsa diang hi, Leitung nate’n hong khih hong buaisak zo nawnlo,

Tua gam munnuam lungsimin ka ngaihsut kik ciang, Gensiam hileng a hoih dan, A nopdan vangam a lim leh a vang bek hi, Bangzah ‘n a nuam diam tua mun ihtun hun ciangin.

title: PASIAN INNKUAN
body:
Ka nuamhi, Pasian innkuan sungah ka om zo, A sisan siangtho in kei hong sil siang zo, Zeisu tawh luah khawmzo, hih mun ka omlai in Ka nuam hi Pasian innkuan sungah ka omzo,

Ka sanggampa ka sanggamnu ci’n ih kisam, Eite Pasian sungah innkuan khat ih hih manin, Gimthuak khat ih omciang, ih kithuakpih ciat a, A gualzo khat ih omciang, ih ki lungdampih hi.

Tagah te inn pan kipanin, Kumpi inn dong in, Hong ki deidan tuanlo in, La thak kasa thei hi, Siatna pan hoihna ah, Zawnna pan hauhna ah, Kilawm lopi’n hiah ka om, ka Pasian min ka phat.

title: VAN HAUH NA KEI AA HI ZO
body:
Vantungah innkhat nei-ing ni sangin taang zaw hi veh, Khatvei ciang ka tung ding, Tua ciang bel ka khualzin hun,Bei ding a tawlnga ta ning, Aw tua niciang van ah thaman sang ning.

Van hauhna kei a hi zo,A dang bang ka ngen nawn diam Pasian ta tu’n ka hizo, ka honpa Zeisu hang, Lei ah ka hih thilthial hang,Mite’n ka hauh lam thei lo, Aw ka honpa hang mihaupi ka hita.

Lukhu a kihawm niciang,Hih leitung phawknawn kei ning Bangzah a nuam zen diam, Ka lutung te zial zial ding,Leinunna phawknawn kei ning, Aw tua niciang kamai nibang tang ding.

Ka lam etna mikim in hong theihpih leh ut singmaw, Pasian ta ka suahna, Ka honpa hang kisa thei ing, van mite khat ka hizo, Aw tua niciang aksi bang ka tang ding.

title: LUNGDAM KOH BIAKPIAK NA
body:
Topa tungah lungdam kako ding, Tuuno laibu sung ka min kigelh zo, A mual theilo a mial ngeilo ding ,Khut mapawn tawh kigelh zo ta.

Topa tungah lungdam kako ding, Phatna biakna kongpia hi Topa, Lungdamkoh biakna kong paipih hi, Sangpen pa aw ka lungdam hi.

Tuidam kiangah tuuno kikhah bang,  Neek leh dawn silh leh ten inn leh lo zong, A nisim in zat ding sum leh pai, Hong sik hongpia ka Topa hi.

Topa hong hehpihna ka phat ding, Diik ding huih mangenlo hong piak man in, Nitaang khataang dawn ding tui siangtho, A khawnkhong in hong zangsak hi.

title: KIKHENNA OM NAWNLO
body:
Kikhenna om nawnlo, kikhenna om nawnlo, Vantung ka pa inn ah kikhenna om nawnlo, Sihna natnate leh lungzuanna om nawnlo, Tuuno inn ni bang tang, Jerusalem khua thak ah,

Aw tua lai mun nuam, lungsim ka ngaihsut ciang Anop cit dan nop tuak zen si, Tua munah ka pai ciang,Lawm ten hong muak ding a, Hong tankhia ka Topa khutpawnte ka len ding hi.

(Lawm aw nang na ut hiam)2 Tatkhiat sate lenna van khuapi ah, Tua mun tun na dingin Zeisu sisan bek hi, Lawm aw nang na ut hiam, Jerusalem khua thak ah.

Tuni”n Topa sapna, a aw nem na zak leh, Na lungsim khauhsak ken Zeisu zuan vaw, Alian mahmah gupna donlo in om le cin, Mawhna dan tawh bangci ki pelh theih ding nahi hiam.

title: LAINAT NA AW
body:
Itna sisan luangin ka tatsa mite, Khuamial gimna sung kahna aw ka za, Lainat in kakhi luang, kua sawl ding ka hiam?, A mangthang khate kua’n pikhia ding hiam?.

Topa’n nang hongsam lainatna aw tawh, Ka nasem dingte tawm lua e, Mangthang khate kiang itna thugen ding, Nang hongsawl ning e, na hih zo diam ci. Topa’n nang hong sawl, haibang nang hongngak.

Na neih nalam khempeuh kong piaksa hi a, Khatzong sitlo in la kik theipa kahi. Hizong lakik keining naphal bang pia in, Van ah nongciah ciang na hawmthawh kha diai.

 Na tuai lai in sem in, tumbang na huai ding Na neihlai pia in beina hun hong tung ding, Gal le sa haksa in buaina’n hong lap ding, Sep theihlai sem in khua hong mial ding hi.

title: HONG PAIKIK DING KA UM HI
body:
Mualsang tung khat pan in, Topa van kahto a Puanpak silh minih in nungzui te hehnem hi Lungzuang kha peuhmah kei un, tu a kilato Zeisu in Van a kah namuh bangin hong kumkik ding

A gen bang hong paikik ding ka um hi Pengkulte ngaihlua kisa in misite phong ding cih ka um hi Mitphiat sung kikal inah vantung hong keek inah A gen bang hong paikik ding ka um hi

Topa hong kilat ding, nai mahmah ta kha ding Tuni zong hithei hi, tuhun zong hithei hi Tuahun teh misiang khempeuh, leitungin hup zo nawnlo ding Vankim lai ah laktohna ngah ding uh hi

title: A NI NI IN NUAM SEM SEM
body:
A tawntung ka kumpipa, a tawntung ka lawmpa A tawntung gualzawhna hongpia, Nisim lamhonglak a, nisim tha hong dim hi, Nisim gualzawhna hong pia.

(Buaina veng mang veh)2 Ka lawmpa ka kumpipa kaphat tak teh, Pasian gam leh a ma dikna zong masa leng, A ni ni in nuam sem sem.

Vantung gam kham khuapi nuam, a tawntung taang zih ziah, It leh ngaih te tuallen nag am, Eite hong dawn dingin, nisim kiging den uh, Nuam zen si’n teh tua mun nuam.

title: TUA A HIH MA’N TU’N
body:
( Tua ahih man tun thukhenna tawh kipelh zo)3 Ka sungah lungnop suahtakna om hi.

(La bang ci’n nasa, kamtuam tawh lakasa)3 Ka sungah lungnop suahtakna om hi. (Thubang ci’n nangen, kamtuam tawh thu kangen)3 Ka sungah lungnop suahtakna om hi.

title: DEIHNA KHEMPEUH A KICINNA
body:
Deihna khempeuh a ki cinna lawmpha Zeisu nei ing, Kei ading tulsawm tulthen sanghoih zaw hi, Zangkuam unokpak zah a hoih,A mahbek ke’n mu ing, Damnang, siannang kadeih teng a sung om hi, Dah hun ciang hong hehnem in, haksat ciang bukna hi,  Na vangik khempeuh hongpuakin hong ci,Hallelujah.

Amah zangkuam unok paak hi,A taang zingsol zonghi, Kei a ding tulsawm tulthen sang hoih zaw hi.

Ka lungkhamna teng lakhia in, dahna hong puaksak a, Ze-et hunciang a muanhuai ka tausang hi, Upna siasak thei na khempeuh, ke’n tu’n ka nusia ta, Ka sungpan a vangliatna tawh hong kem hi, Leitungin kei hong nial in, Satan in hong do hang, Zeisu hangin ka ma ka tun ding hi,Hallelujah.

A mah’n hong nusia ngeilo ding, zong hong nial ngeilo ding, Amah um in a deihna bang tapeuh leng, Keitungah bang bang piang taleh, launawn peuhmah kei ning ,Mana tawh kakha hongvak ding nuamlua veng, Mingthang gamzuan in lengning, Topa kamu ding hi, Lungnopna guntui a luanna mun hi.Hallelujah.

title: MUAL TUNGAH TUA KHUAPI KA TUN CIANGIN
body:
Zion mual dawn ah khuapi lian khat om hi, Kongzingte khempeuh khamtawh kizut hi, Zingsang khatpeuh teh tua khua ka en ding hi, Mual tungah tua khuapi ka tun ciangin.

Aw mualtungah Zion khuapi Ka tunding ngaklah belin kanei hi, A kum tawn in ka teng ding hi, Mual tungah tua khuapi ka tun ciangin.

Tua khuapi ah pai dingin hong kisam hi, A ut khempeuh te zong kisam hi, Kei adingin kibawl khuapi in hong ngak hi, Mual tungah tua khuapi ka tun ciang in.

Sihna kiciam kha ngeinawn peuhmah lo ding, Lungzuan cihbang om ngei nawnlo ding, Tua lai ah a tawntung in ka teng den ding, Mual tung ah tua khuapi ka tun ciang in.

title: TOPA HONG PAI KIK DING
body:
Thukhenna ni hong nai zota, Aw sanggam aw bangci ding na hiam, Tawntung mun ding lungngai lo in, Lungmuangtak in om ke’n maw,

Mi siangthote hong la dingin, Topa hong pai ding sawtnawnlo, A teelsa mite leikiuli pan, hong khop ciangin Kongit sanggam nang kong mu ding hiam

Topa Zeisu hong paikik ciang, Minthanna tawh hong pai suk dinga, Tatsa mi siangthote khempeuh, Van kimlai ah hong pito ding

Sanggam aw na kiging nai maw, Vantung tuuno moipawi sim dingin ah, Tuuno mopuan na neih kei leh, Kham innpi sung lutthei kei niteh.

title: KA SUNGAH VANGLIATNA OM
body:
Khazih kazuat lai kihhuai mah ta leng, Hallelujah ka sung’h vangliatna om hi, Hong ki siangsak ta sisan muang peuh leng, Hallelujah ka sung’h vang liatna omta

(Vang liatna a om vangliatna a om hallelujah ka sung’h vangliatna omta.)2

Ka mawhna pitawh Zeisu ka zuan a, Hallelujah kasung’h vangliatna om ta, Kongkhak kakiu a, kei hong lutsak ta , Hallelujah ka sung’h vangliat na omta.

Mangthang mite aw, keitawh pai khawm ni, Hallelujah ka sung’h vang liat na omta, Zeisu sisan in hong siangsak zota, Hallelujah ka sung’h vangliatna omta.

title: OMDAN KASIAM TA
body:
Simleitungah mihing pilna leh siamna, Tha leh ngal hatna te’n Topa muzo kei, Vangik pua leh tawldamna ngahlo ta ding, Thuakdansiam haksa lua To Zeisu lo in.

Om dan zong ka siamta, thuakdan zong ka siam ta, Hong makaih a hong hilhpa, ToZeisu a hi, Apiang na khempeuh tung’h, lungdam den ding hi tang, Omdan hong siam sakpa To zeisu a hi.

Sum leh pai deihna leh, huaihamna te in, Lamtawp cih neilo, lungkim om thei lo, Gentheih haksa na leh lungzuan luankhi tawh, Thuakdan hong siamsakpa To Zeisu a hi.

Gentheih zong kasiam ta, hauhdan zong kasiam ta ,Gilvah leh gilkial zong, thuakdan kasiamta, Hongit Topa Zeisu hang na khempeuh tung ah, Hong thahatsak pa hang hih theihloh nei keng.

title: ZEISU EN GIGE IN
body:
Ih Topa gualzopenpa, dawimangpa zonggawp zo, Mawh na koltanna pan hong honkhia zo, Nuam hilhial tu’n ih omta, lungnop suahtakna sungah, Leitung nate’n hong buaisak zo nawnlo.

Kipak in a min siangtho pahtawi ni, Lungtuak ei khangno tuailai te’n mainawt ni,  Na sikna khempeuh Topa’n Na gam hong suak sak ding hi Zeisu en gige inla kalsuan in.

Leitung paiziate en in, buaina leh kisiatna in, tua te’ hang’n na lungsim sosak ken in, Tuate Zeisu zawhna sung’h oltak en hithiat lel in,  Nunghei ke’n cikhuampi nasuak kha deh.

Pitazuh zong Topa tawh, tuihual tung’h pai kiau kiau Upna tawh Zeisu bek a et ciang in, Ahih hang akhuadak leh tuihual kihta tum dektak . Khuadak ke’n Zeisu bek en gige in.

title: ZEISU SIN IN
body:
Lungnopna zong khinteh namtampi in, Leitungin tua nopna piathei lo, Na sumte kawhkholna hiam kidawm in, Lam hong pi ding khat kisam tei tei.

Ciampello Zeisu sin in,Siatna pan itna honglak Nitang in huihnung taleh,Ciampello Zeisu sin in.

 Na nite gualnopna tawh kidim in, Lawpin kipahna khuabang taang,T ua zawhteh dahna khuamial in tuam a, Khuamial vengsak ding kisam teh nang.

Lungzuangin nangkia lam napai lai tak, Guallelhna vive tawh ki dim in, Lungkia in lungsim tamkham dek lai tak, Tuihual daisak pa kisam teh nang.

Hun leh nite meng meng in bei veh, Lungnopna sum tawh leitheih hilo, Zongin thumin tauin na om lai tak, Na mawhna sawp ding mi kisam teh nang.

title: A SANGMUAL LAM
body:
(Cho) A sangmual lam ento in, kah leh lungkham teng vengta, Bangkim ah bangkim Topa, huhna in keivan pan hi, A sangmual lam ento in, nahoih tampi kangah ta, Ka gualzawhna teng tengin, van an Topa thupha hi.

Sun in meiikhuam zan in meiikhuam tawh hong kem hi, Kei hong cingpa lusu ngeilo hi, Sihna kuampi lam katuak zong, Lum leh galhiam a hi.

Sun in niin hong gimsak lo ding hi zan in, Kha in zong hong sukha lo ding hi, Topa a muangte honkhia hi, A khut kuak sungh tun koih hi.

title: KA KHA THA BEK TAWH
body:
Pasian in kha a hihman, amah biakpiak na dingin, Na kha tawh a mah bia in phat lecin, Hermon mualah daitui bang, van daituite hong kia in Hopihna nang zong zathei ni teh

Ka kha tha bek tawh, ka kha tha bek tawh, Ka kha thabek in lawhcing thei niteh, Thu haksa pen te’n zong na-ma hong khak zo ke’n teh, Ka kha hang na-ma na tunzo ding hi.

Khirh a ding nuntakna ah,A siangtho nuntakna ding.T eep leh muam neek dawn kizawh kul hi, A siangtho gamtat kampau, na khempeuh ki dek zolo, Tuate tawh na hizo diam Topa’n ci.

Gupngah lam hong kitel sak,Damngah lam hong kitelsak Hauh ngah lam hong kitel sak khat om hi, Vangliatna tawh dawi hawlkhia,Damlo te damsak , theih naTunglam pan a hong pai kha hang bek hi

title: AW HIHMAH LAMDANG PEN SANG
body:
Nitak a ni a tum lamdang sa ing, Nisuah zong lamdang sasem ing, Ka lungsim hong khoih kha a lamdang pen in, Pasian in kei hong itna thu hi,

(Aw hihmah lamdang pen sa’ng Hihmah lamdang pen sa’ng Pasian in kei hong it zenzen)2

Tuk hun anlak hunte lamdang si e, Vantung aksi nite zong e, Ka lungsim hong khoih kha a lamdang pen in, Hih ka phawk thak hong itna thu hi.

title: SIANMANG ZEISU KASAN MAN IN
body:
Sianmang Zeisu naubang ka san man in ah, Ka ciin leh katuai lai singdang ka tang ta, Lawmgual itte’n lah lenpih ding hong nial e, Phamawh kei sawlbang hei ta-ning Topa tawh.

Phamawh kei ee, Singta bang bang lel taleh, Sianmang Zeisu min hangin, Zion khuapi tual-ah limnga bang lam ning, Lei ah ka gentheih nate ka kham lukhu ding hi.

Aw hong lengaw Zeisu vabang hong leng aw, Ka siangah hong khawl aw, holung kum khawm niN ang tawh nunnop a lenkhop kan a nuam om lo, Hinpih sihpih dingin nang kong teel zohi.

Aw Zion tate mainawt in kalsuan ni, Eite maiah masa Zeisu mitsuan ni, A ma dawnsa tuikha mah ih dawn ding a, Ama totsa lampi mah ih zui ding.

title: BETHSIDA TUI KILOK NAWNLO DING
body:
Mi khuamulo, mittaw pi’n; lam napai napai den leh Sihna guamthuk sung nakiat ding lauhuai sa’ng, Tua guamthuk sung nakiat ma’n na mit mah mah,Doctor Zeisu lawngsak in, Tua hi leh, Na mit hong kihong ding a, lamman na zui ding hi.

Pulpizavat, mittaw khelbai bengngong mi, Leitung pilna tawh nabawl hang dam ke’n cia Bethsidatui hong kilok nawn lo ding a, Na natna mun telin Zeisu lawng sak in.

Khasiangto vabang lenna , leitung mit in muban lo, Pasian pilna leitung pilna’n ban zolo.  Ngiahsutna tawh napuk ma’n na khuak mah mah, Doctor Zeisu lawngsak in, Tua hi leh,  Na lungtang kihong ding a, Thuman na tel ding hi.

Kha siangtho huhna meibang a tanlai na mitsak ke’n Khebai pi-in vangam ah natun sawm ke’n, Tuanglam bang pial kha niteh, na khe mahmah ,Doctor Zeisu lawngsak in, Tua hi leh, Na lungtang kihong ding a, thuman na tel ding hi.

title: NA LUKHU TE’N HONG NGAK DIMDEM
body:
Kap kawmin kuankhia in, A tuh ding khai ci, a pua mi-in, Lungdamin kiko na tawh buhlomte pua in ,Inn ah hong ciah ding hi.

Leikeu na-ah guahin tui a buak bangin, Ka thaman- te’n hong ngak dimdem , Kei a ding kikoih zo kham lukhu hoih lua kisa in, Hong tan ziahziah kham lukhu-te tang pempam, Endih na lukhu te’n hong ngak dimdem zen veleh.

Kiphah dimdem thamante ki gual diudeu, Laibute zong kiphen ziah ziah, Lungdamna khituite taak keuhkeuh hong taak keuh keuh Vantung mi te’n lungdam in hong muak ziahziah, Endih na lukhu te’n hong ngak dimdem zen veleh.

Kangah ding vangliatnate kangaih ciangin ah, Ka thuaknate gentham sakeng, Tua te hang amin siangtho phat ning Hallelujah, AmenCi-in khamlukhu ka khek ma teng, En dih na lukhu te’n hong ngak dimdem zen veleh.

title: KA LAWM HOIH ZEISU
body:
Ka khualzin na leitungah, lawmhoih khatnei ing, Tua in hong it ka Tozeisu hi, Nisim hong lungdamsak, nisimla hongsa sak,Lawm hoih Zeisu ka neih mah manpha bel.

Muvanlai bangin ah, ka thahat theihna ding, Thakhuahna leh lungnopna hong pia, Ka lawmhoih Zeisu in thupha namkim hong pia.

Zeisu tawh ka kimuh ni a kipan in ah, Nisim in lungdam kipak den ing, ‘Dahna thuakna-te in hong buai sak zo nawnlo, Lawmhoih Zeisu kaneih mah manpha bel.

Aw kongit sanggam aw nang zong hongpai pah vaw, A migi kaToZeisu kiang,Sapna khempeuh ki cing, Nang zong hongpia nuamhi,Hong zuan in kongit kongit sanggam aw.

 A ummi tadingin manpiakloh letsong hi, Nuntak tawntungna na ngahna ding, Tu’n Zeisu na san leh vangam nang aahi ta.

title: ZION TEMBAW
body:
Tuipi geiah kading a, a galkhat lam ka gal-et leh, Tuipi geiah tembaw khat a khawl ding mu ing a, A maute a dawn dingin, alawmte tampi om veh, It teng tawh kikhen lohna vantung hong phawk sake.

Inn lam kazuan hi, zion tembaw tungtuang in, Galkhat pekah meiilum lakah a taang ka gal muh ta, Tembaw khawlna ciangdong,Hoihtakin katun mateng in, Vantungmi te aw kei hong kha aw.

Kanu in nunna huihpi thuakin hong paisan khinzo a Tawntung mun hong pi dingin, Honpa neiteh hongci Tu’n ka telsiang khinta hi, kei zong tua mun lam kazuan ta, Ka nu’n galah hong ngak hi, nuikawm hong dawnta ding.

title: HONG IT KA NU
body:
>Minbang ka piancil in, ka nu’n hong it manin, A ang nunkhum tui tawh hong vak den a, Ka ut bangbang in hong gamtat saktheih manin ,Ka nu hong itna bang zah in lian hiam.

Hong it ka nu bang tawh ka teh thei diam, Hong ho kamkhum bang tawh ka teh thei diam, Leizawhloh suangmanpha sang lianzaw hi,  Nu aw nong ho kamkhum za nuam den ing.

Ka nunna a manpha ding nong pattah manin,  Nu aw nong itna lian ka phawk den a, Top’n hong hehpih in, na nunkum sawt sak hen, Sim leitung kumsawt guabang hing khawm leng.

 Nute pumpi khempeuh ei a ding manpha hi, A angah hong tawi-in hong lum sak a, A nungah hong pua in nuamtak hong ih musak,  Nu aw nong itna lian ka phawk den hi.

title: HONG LUNGDAM SAK HI
body:
Lungdam kohna tawh ama kongpi ah lut unla, Ama huang sungah tumta un, Tuni pen Topa’n hong piak sa nipha hi a, Hong lungdam sak manin ka kipak hi.

(Hong lungdam sak hi, hong lungdam sak hi. Hong lungdam sak manin ka kipak hi.)2

Topa hoih hi, a itna kipin kho tawntung hi, Tua ahihma’n a min phat un, Ama thumanna a khang a khang in kip hi. Hong lungdamsak manin ka kipak hi.

title: HIH LEITUNG KIKHENNA GAM HI
body:
Hih leitung in gibing khenna gam hi, Mitphiat kalsung na ngawn lungmuan om theilo, Tu nuam ta leng ding, khawlnuam ta leng pai, Hih leitung kikhenna gam hi.

Phatni hei na peuhah Topa phat ni, Ih khen zongin Zeisu sung kimu kik ding, Lei-ah ih kimu diam van kimlai ah Hih leitung kikhenna gam hi.

Ih khen zongin kimu ding khawlmun ah, Hih leitung in ih khualzinna gam bek hi, Ih khawlkhawm zong holung cim omman lo, Hih lei khitui luanna gam hi.

Hun leh tuiluang in hong pai khengkheng veh Hih leitung in a sawt ding hinawnlo pi, Leitung aw mangpha Zeisu hong nai zo. Kikhen om nawnlo ding vanah.

title: PASIAN HONG HENPIHNA THUPHA
body:
Pasian’ hong hehpihna thupha, Kei kiang hong tun theihna, Ka kilawm lohpi hong deih na, Bang hang hiam thei zo keng.

Ahih hang ka up Pa ka thei hi, Amah muanhuai hi, ke’n ka thei zo hi, Ama tung ka piaksa te zong, Keem zo ding hi tua ni dong

.Hong honkhia zo thei hih upna, Kei tung a hong piakna, A thu um leeng lungnop theihna, Bangci bang hiam thei keng.

Kha siangtho in mi lungsim hei, Mawhna hong phawksak thei, Zeisu hong musak umsak thei, Bangci bang hiam thei keng,

Topa mai ke’n ka muh ma in, A pha a sia tuah ding, Gentheihna ding nopsakna ding , Bang ka sunsiah thei keng.

title: THUMAN LAMHILH KHA SIANGTHO
body:
Thuman lamhilh kha siangtho, Tapidawte nusia lo, Vang tung gam zuan zin mite, A khut tawh hong len gige.

Agimte tawntung phatuam ,A zak ciang Ama aw nuam, Vantung innpi lam zong mi, Hong zui-in, kong kha ding hi.

Hong ompih den lawm pha pen, Ko guak hong zawttawm sak ke’n Khuamial, lungman, launa sung,  Nang mah’n hong ompih tawntung

,Huihpi nasia mahmah in ,Lungkiat lai tak hong ci-in, Vantung innpi a zuan mi, Hong zui in, kong kha ding hi.

 Na sepna hun beita a, Vantung tun’ ding bek om ta. Kei min zong a om buang tam, Zeisu’ si bek ka paulam,

Sihna gun ka ngah lai tak, Hong ci lai, siang tak tel tak, Vantung innpi a zuan mi, Hong zui in, kong kha ding hi.

title: HONG IT ZAW NING TOPA
body:
Hong it zaw ning Topa, Hong it zaw ning; Khuk din’ a kong thumna, Nang hong ngai ding. Hi bang hi kong thumna, Khazih hong it zaw ning, Hong it zaw ning, hong it zaw ning.

Ni dang leitung nopna ka lunggulh pen, Tu in kong deih nangmah, a hoih pha pen, Tu in kong deih nangma, Khazih hong it zaw ning, Hong it zaw ning, hong it zaw ning.

Dahna natna thuak hang, phamawh sa lo , Nangma sawltakte bang, la ka sa zo, Ka sa khawm anau bang, Khazih hong it zaw ning, Hong it zaw ning, hong it zaw ning.

Ka sih laitak in ah, nang kong phat ding, Ka hutawpna inah, ka vaikhak ding, Ka ngen lailai hihmah, Khazih hong it zaw ning, Hong it zaw ning, hong it zaw ning.

title: HONG PAI UN THU UM TENG
body:
Hong pai un, thu um teng, Lungdam in kipak un, Hong pai un va en niBetlen khua sungah Vantung KumpipaBawngkuang sung hong suak ci

Va bia ni, hong pai ta un,Va bia in hong pai ta un, Hong pai un, va bai ni,Khazih Topa

Sa un, kipah na laVantung mi honte aw, Vantung a sang bel naKhempeuh thawn sak un, Van sang bel na ahPasian’ min thang ta hen

Hi hi, hong hon ding pa,Tu ni’n kong dawn uh hi, Zeisu Topa, na minThang tawntung ta hen, Pa Pasian deih thuMi bangin hong piang ta

title: SINGLAMTEH KIANG KONG PAI
body:
Singlamteh kiang kong pai hi, Tha le sumlo, mittaw pi, Na dang bangmah man lo pi ,Hotna cing ka zong ding hi.

Topa, nangmah kong muang zo, Singlamteh tung si Tuuno, Na singlamteh kong beel zo, Hong hon aw, tu’n hong hon aw,

 Nang kong lunggulhna sawt hi, Ka gitloh sawt lua zo hi, Zeisu in dam tak hong ci, Na mawhna kong sawp ding hi.

Ka vekpi’n kong kipia ta, Ka lawm, ka hun, ka neihsa, Ka vekpi’n ka pum ka kha,  Nang’ a ka hi khin nuam ta.

Na thu ciamte ka muang hi. Na sipha tu’n ka phawk hi, Ka lungsim ka niamkhiat hi, Nang mah tawh ka si khawm hi

title: KAM A GEN ZAWH HI LO
body:
Zeisu in keimah hong itna, Keimah hong tatna dingin ah, Singlamteh gilo hong thuakna, Kam a gen zawh hilo

Hong itna kam’ gen zawh hilo, Hong itna kam’ gen zawh hilo, Zeisu in keimah hong itna, Kam a gen zawh hilo

Ka nun’tak tawntung nangin ah Nakpi’n dahna a hong thuakna, Ling kiphan lukhu hong khukna, Kam a gen zawh hilo

Pasian kiang hong thumsak TopaAma sung kangah lungnopna, Ama si hang hong piang thupha,Kam a gen zawh hilo

Hong nai ciang kangah lungdamna, Launa kihello tawldamna, Ama hang lametna a pha,Kam a gen zawh hilo.

title: VANGLIAN KUMPIPA HONG SIHNA
body:
Vanglian Kumpipa hong sihna, A singlamteh ke’n veelveel leng, Kei’ hauhna kei kiphatsakna, Kei’n tu’n bangmah in sim nawn keng.

Khazih ka Pasian’ sihna lo, Ki sialhpih ding bangmah om kei, Ka deih belteng khat zong siitlo, Ama’ si kheekna- in ka nei.

En ven a lu, a khut, a khe, Dahna itna, hong luangsukkhawm,  Na mu ngei maw linglukhu leh Itna, dahna gawm kilawm khawm.

Leitung khempeuh pia thei hi leng, Tamlua ka ci ngeikei ding hi. A hong itna ke’n ngaihsun leng, Ka pum ka tak ka pia nuam hi.

title: HUH PA HONG PAI KHINTA
body:
Lungdam thuzeelsak un, mi om na ci tengah, Mihing lungsim omna, mihing galtam na ah, Tapidaw lei khempeuh lungdam thu gensak un, Huhpa hong paikhiata,

Huhpa hong paikhinta, huhpa hong paikhinta, Vantung kha siangtho pen,Panpiak ding hong ciam pen, Lungdam thuzeel sak un, mi omna ci tengah, Huhpa hong paikhinta.

Zanhun saupi beita, zingkhua hong vakzo ta, Lungsim vangikpi teng, hehna hu-ging vengta,  Nitaang kham mual panin, hong suahkhiat tak ciangin, Huhpa hong paikhinta,

A kha sung zatui tawh, kumpite’ To hatpa’n, Thongkia kha khempeuh tung hong puak, hotkhiat kicing, Thongpi hawm sung tengah zawhna lapi hong ging, Huhpa hong paikhinta,

Genzawhloh itna siang ka lei in bang ci-in, Genzawhloh hehpihna, mi vakvai tung gen ding, Amah leh a meel taang, sungah ka omtheih nang, Huhpa hong paikhinta.

title: NUNTAKNA KHOMUN
body:
Nuntakna khomun kei, hong pia’n Topa, Galilee tuili gei, na hih bang mah, Ka lungsim vah zo kei, lai simna tawh,  Nang mah tak ka lungdeih, hinna thu aw

Thuman thutak hong pia’n, ka Topa aw, Khomun na piak bang zia’n, na thupha tawh, Tua hi leh ko teng kia’n, ka suakta ding, Thuman in hong khahkhia’n, ka lungmuan ding

Kei a ding, Topa, nang , nuntak khomun, Keimah ka suahtak na’ng, nangma thu gun,  Nang tawh vantung luah na’ng, nong vaak ding hi .Hong it sak in thuman, itna na hi

Topa aw, kha siangtho, kei hong puak in, Keima mit khuamu lo, vaak sak dingin, Na thu thuk lai siangtho, hong tel sak ding, Na thu sung pang nang ko hong musak ding.

title: LUNGDAM HUAI HINGNANG KONG TEELNI
body:
Lungdam huai hi, nang kong teel ni, Keimah hong hon ka Pasian aw, Keima lungdamna a lianpi, Mi tung genlo om thei ding maw,

Ka nuam hi, ka nuam hi. Zeisu’n ka mawh hong phelzo hi, Thungetna zia a hong hilh hi,  Nisim in hong lungdam sak hi. Ka nuam hi, ka nuam hi. Zeisu’n ka mawh hong phelzo hi.

 Naseppi bel kikhinzo hi, Kei Topa a ka hizo ta, Hong kaihna na ke’n ka zui hi, Ama thugen leng nuam ka sa.

Ka lungsim aw, lungka nawn ken, Hih thupha ah kiptak khawltan, Topa kiang pan lungleng nawn ke’n, A pha khempeuh nei hi, amah’n.

Lungsimtakpi tawh ka ciamsa, Nisim in ka ciam phapha ding, Lungdam huai bel hih ki ciamna, Ka sih ciangin thupha pia ning.

title: SI SUNGAH VANGLIATNA OM
body:
Na mawh vangik pan na suakta ding hiam? Si sung, sisung vangliatna om hi. Siatna tungah nang na gualzo ding hiam? Si sung vanglian lamdang om hi.

Si sung vanglian, vanglian lamdang om, Tuuno sisan sungah,S i sung vanglian, vanglian, lamdang om, A manpha Tuuno si sungah,

 Na kiphatsak pan na suakta ding hiam? Si sung, si sung vangliatna om hi, Siangtho ngah ding Kalani tui zuan in, Si sung vanglian lamdang om hi.

Vuk sangin na paak zaw mahmah ding hiam? Si sung, si sung vangliatna om hi, Nuntakna tui sung mawhna nin siangta, Si sung vanglian lamdang om hi.

Na Kumpi Zeisu’ na nasem ding hiam? Si sung, si sung vangliatna om hi, Nisim amah phatna na sa ding hiam? Si sung vanglian lamdang om hi.

title: BANG DANG HI LO, ZEISU SI HI
body:
Bang in ka mawh sawp siang thei, Bang dang hi lo, Zeisu’ si in, Bangin hong damsak kik thei, Bang dang hi lo, Zeisu’ si in.

Manpha hi hong luang si, Vuk bang hong ngosak si, Tui dang ka thei kei hi. Bang dang hi lo, Zeisu’ si hi.

Ka sian’na ding hih ka muh, Bang dang hi lo, Zeisu’ si hi. Ka mawhna kiphel na’ng thu, Bang dang hi lo, Zeisu’ si hi.

Mawh maisak bang dang hi lo, Bang dang hi lo, Zeisu’ si hi. A pha ka bawl hang hi lo, Bang dang hi lo, Zeisu’ si hi.

Kei lametna lung nopna, Bang dang hi lo, Zeisu’ si hi. Kei in dikna ka ngahna, Bang dang hi lo, Zeisu’ si hi.

title: KHAZIH THO ZO
body:
Hanthuk sungah lum hi, Kei Honpa Zeisu, Ani tun’ ding ngak hi,Kei To Zeisu.

Han sung pan hong tho zo, Vanglianpi tawh galte zo gawp zo, Khuamial gam pan galzo in hong thoto hi. A mi siangte maan’pih ding hingkik zo hi. Hingkik zo, hingkik zo,Hallelujah, hingkik zo.

Cin’ hangin mawkna hi,Hong hon Zeisu’ han, Ciamteh hang mawkna hi,Ka Topa, luang.

Sihna lenzo lo hi,Hong honpa Zeisu, Dalnate su-gawp hi,Kei To Zeisu’n

title: NUNG CIANGIN A NOPNA
body:
Sungsang a pha zaw gam nuam om a, I upna in ki-gal muh thei hi. Ei a ding tua gampha vantungah, I pa’n om-na hong bawlkholh sak hi.

Nung ciangin a nopnaTua gampha ah I ki mu ding hi,  Nung ciangin a nopnaTua gampha ah I ki mu ding hi.

Eite in tua gungal gampha ah Thupha ngah mite la-ngaih sa in, Dah ngei nawnlo ding I lung sungah Khuisa ngei nawnlo ding tawldam khin.

Hong piaksa vaanglian hong itna pi Hong siang sak thupha pahtawina la, Tawlngalo phatna I sa ding hi, Hong it van tung Pa Pasian mai-ah

title: INNKUAN KI-IT LENG
body:
kimmkot teng kilawmna, Innkuan ki-it leng, Aw ging khempeuh lungdamna,Innkuan ki-it leng, Lungnopna leh kicinna, Kiheina teng maitai na, Hun khempeuh nuam mahmah a,Innkuan ki-it leng.

Innkuan sung ki-it leng, Hun khempeuh nuam mahmah a, Innkuan ki-it leng.

Bukno khat sung zong nuamna, Innkuan ki-it leng, Huatna en’na omlohna, Innkuan ki-it leng, I pai-na tengah nuamna,Leitung khempeuh lungdamna, Lungdamna dim nuntakna,Innkuan ki-it leng.

Pasian zong hong lungdampih, Innkuan ki-it leng, Leitung teng ki-itna dim, Innkuan ki-it leng, Lui-ging bek zong la ngaihpi,Vandum bek zong maitaiina, Pasian vanpan hong nuihpih,Innkuan ki-it leng.

title: KHA SIANGTHO HONG LEENG
body:
Nakpi tak in ka lungdam theihna Topa hang bek hi nuam lua ing Kipak takin ka laam ka dianna Ka Pasian hang hi nuam lua sing!

A manpha pen tat khiatna puanpi’nKei hong tuamta, Nun kilamdang pian kilamdang ta, Thuman puanpi tawh kei hong tuam ta, Phat loh theiloh… dian loh theih loh… Kha siangtho hong leeeng.

Zipipa puan hoih tawh kizem a,Monu kizepna suang manpha Tua bang teek in Topa’n hong zem ta Ka Pasian hoih dan lamdang ee!

Topa hoihna ke’n ka muh tak teh, Kam a gen zawh ding zong hi kei Lai a at zawh ding zong hilo a, Lungsim leh kha tawh phat ding hi.

title: TOPA IN EITE ZAWHNA
body:
Topa ka kidalna lum lehKa munkip muanhuai nahi ta Amah tawh tonlengKa lampi nuam semsem ta Ama khut in kei hong len a,Muan huai tak in kei hong kem ta Topa in eite zawhna ahi

Thangsiahte thangzak pan in,Aki khak khia vasa bangin, ‘Lamin diangin Topa min ka phat thei ta, Ka mawhna teng hong mai sak. Ka natna teng zong hong damsak, Nuam hilhial ka om theita,Hong it Topa mai-ah

Sihna lim guampi sung na ngawnKa nawk hang ka lau kei ding hi.  Na molhtum leh na ciangkhut inHong lungmuang sak Ka galte omna mai-ahSabuai phah in an hong lui ta Topa in eite zawhna ahi.

title: GAMLAPI MUAL TUNGAH
body:
Gamlapi mual tungah, Singlamteh tul gemgam, Gentheihna maizumna lim ahi, Tua khuampi ka it hi, leitung buppi tan ding, A ithuai pen pa hong sihna hi.

Tua singlamteh ke’n ngilngei keing ning, Zawhna minpha ka tutzawh mateng, Tua singlamteh khahlo lenlen ning, Khamlukhu ka khekna ni mateng.

Mi in tua singlamteh, a thusimloh hangin, Ke’n ka phawk tawntung na a thu in, Pasian tuuno in vantung nopna nusia hi, Kalani mualah tua pua dingin.

Ka mawhna hong maisak, hong siangtho sak dingin, Sisan luangin Zeisu hong si hi. Pasian tapa sisan siangtho a hong banna, Tua singlamteh ka velvel nuam hi.

Tua singlamteh khuampi ke’n nusia ngei kei ning, Taina, zumna ka thuakpih hangin, Tua hi leh khat vei ciang hong sam ding a inn ah, Amah tawh a min thangkhawm dingin.

title: A SAWT LO IN INN AH CIAH DING
body:
Lampi ah hong lungnuam sak ding, la khat sa ni A sawtlo in inn ah ciah ding Zan khuamial bei ding, nitang tawntungna sungah A sawtlo in inn ah ciah ding

A sawtlo in ah, A sawtlo in ah Tuipi hual i kantan ding Eite kimu ding, huihpi nun a ven ciangin A sawtlo in inn ah ciah ding

Sep ding ihmuh peuh in khutih i sem ding hi A sawtlo in inn ah ciah ding Pasian hehpihna in ih tha hong khauhsak ding A sawtlo in inn ah ciah ding

A gim khete ading lam i maisak ding hi A sawtlo in inn ah ciah ding Itna lungsim kizel kimin hoihna lawh hen A sawtlo in inn ah ciah ding

Lungkhamna pengin tawldamna gal khat ah om A sawtlo in inn ah ciah ding Tua khuapi nuam sungah khitui luanna om lo A sawtlo in inn ah ciah ding

title: A MANPHA SI
body:
Manpha si , tawntung manpha si, Tun kei a ding manpha, Tua si hang bek ka kha tawl dam, Dahna teng bei sak hi.

Aw lamdang hi tua sisan luang Gumpa pang pan phulkhia, Vantung dongah la in sa ning ,A manpha bel sisanh.

Pawk in nei nawn peuhmah kei ning, Zuaulo Pasian in ci, Note’ mawhna khialhna taangin, Ka ta sisan ka bua,;

Mawhna ka bawl tampi ka thei, Maizo diam tua zahpi, Ahih hang manpha si’n sawp hi, Mawhna teng puakhia hi.

A cimawh lungsim leh pumpi, Si ding a lum zongin, Lungnuam tak in kei ka si ding, Tua manpha sisan hang,

title: HONG SIANGSAK SI
body:
En un, mawhna khempeuh a puakhia pa, Sihna Kalvary mual tungah, Singlamteh tung gimna sihna thuak in, Kei a dingin a sisan hong luang.

Hong gumpa Topa naak sungah, Sisan leh tui hong luangkhia hi. Ka lung sungah om tawntung hi, Mawhna kisawp siangzo.

Mawh sawpsiang nang tui, A hong luangzo hi, Hong gum Topa sihna mun pan, A tawntungin tua tui ah kisil ni, Hong gum Topa kiang zuan in pai ni.

Tua si sungah a kisil khempeuh te, A mawhna teng vuk bang ngo ding, Na mawhna khempeuh uh hong maisak ding ,Ka kiang hong pai un, Topan hong ci.

Mawhna sungah ka pai kiknawn kei ding, Zeisu’n kei hong suakta sak ding, A kha siangtho in kei hong pi ding a, A gam sungah hong lutpih ding hi

title: TUUNO SI TAWH NA KISAWP ZO HIAM
body:
A siangtho ngah ding Zeisu kiang na pai hiam? Tuuno si tawh na kisawp zo hiam? A thupha kicing dingin na um nai hiam? Tuuno si tawh na kisawp zo hiam?

Tuuno a (tuuno a) sipha tawh (sipha tawh) Nang mah in na kisawpsiang zo maw?  Na puansilh vuk bangin ah na ngah zo hiam ?Tuuno si tawh na kisawp zo hiam?

 Nisim in Topa kiangah lamna zui hiam? Tuuno si tawh na ki sawp zo hiam? Kithat a thuak Topa kiang na belta hiam? Tuuno si tawh na kisawp zo hiam?

Mopi pa hong pai ciang na puan siang dingin, Tuuno si tawh na kisawp zo hiam? A bawl innpi nuamah luttheihna dingin, Tuuno si tawh na kisawp ding hiam?

Mawhna khialhna a bang na puansilh pai-in, Tuuno si tawh na kisawp ding hiam? A sianglo na lung sung ciktui luangsak in, Tuuno si tawh na kisawp ding hiam?

title: KEI HONG HONPA ASI LUANGIN
body:
Kei hong Honpa a si luangin, Ka Kumpi hong si maw? Tangtel bang bek keima a ding, A lutang hong zang maw?

Keima gitlohnate hangin, Singlamteh tung tau maw? Lamdang hehpihna leh itna, Bang tawh tehthei ding maw?

Kei zong singlamteh ka muh ciang, Zum in ka kisel diam? Lungdamna tawh lungnehno in, Ka khi ka luangsak diam?

Ahih hang khitui takna in, Itna lohkhinzo kei, Topa ka pumpi kong pia hi, Hih kan ka hihthei kei!

title: VANTUNG KHUA I TUNG DING HI
body:
Zeisu’n an bang hongit na pha Lambang puak zaila sa ni. Thangvan inn taang suasiang nunnuam Ko aa ding ngo bang lang hi.

Thangvan dong I tun’ciangin Deih teng leh lai lungdamna ngah dinghi .Kum khua in lasa ni Topa Zeisu I phat ding hi.

Thang vantung lam I zuih laitak Zaitha tawl na om ding hi .Hi zong I pai khit ciangin ah Zai-tha tawl omlo ding hi.

Zangni suah sim I um ding a Lim bel sawlsang i leeng ding Saumang nunnuam kuam bang luah na’ng Gua bang hin’lai ngaih khua-ah.

I mai nopna lai lungdamna Va bang leeng tung nuam ing ci, Thangvan kankil I tun’ ciangin Kham vaang khuapi I mu ding

title: KHAM KHUAPI
body:
Sihna kuam gal khatah khua lianpi khat om hi, Minthan’nate kigen khin zolo, Tua munah nitumlo, singtehte vulngeilo Tua Pasian kham khuapi hoih sungah

Tua munah ni tumlo, Singtehte vul ngeilo Tua munah thumaan mi maitang Topa en ding Tua Pasian kham khuapi hoih sungah

Tua mun’n I it Kumpi hong tanpa Topa om Thuman mite’n lungdam’n en uh hi. Tua munah thumaan mite aksi bang taang ding Tua kham khuapi hoih sungah

Singlamteh phung I tun’ pih khitsa kha khempeuh Tuu buk sung I tun’sa tuu khempeuh Lukhu zepna ding suangmanpha bang kikem hi. Tua Pasian kham khuapi hoih sungah

title: TUA LAI DAHNA OM NAWN LO
body:
Vantung ka ngaihsun hi. Topa Pasian omna, A kham maitang nisim mu ding  Nop kicing man ngahna

Dahna kipelh na mun, Dahna kipelh na mun Itna kicing vantung khamgam Dahna kipelh na mun.

Vantung ka ngaihsun hi, Hong teel Topa omna Hong itna pha phatna ding la Kisa tawntung ding hi.

Vantung ka ngaihsun hi. Vantung mihing te in Puanpak sih in a om uh hi, Ei zong I om ding hi.

Vantung ka ngaihsun hi. A tungsa I lawmte Mu-a kikhen nawn lo ding, A nuam tawntung ding hi veh

title: VANTUNG KHUA OM DING HI
body:
Vantung vanglian hehpihna gam, Mi siangtho te inn a hi, Ama kiangah om tawntung ni, Leitung na khempeuh paai ni.

(Cho) Leitung ni a, bei ciangin ah, Nung ciang in inn nuam ah, Mi siangtho te omna lam ah, Vantung khua om ding hi.

Tawntung inn nuam vanglian gam ah, Ih lawm te tua gam om ding, Tua inn nuam sung ah om ding in, Mi nam cin a khawm ding hi.

Hong gupna sip ha vanglian pi, Hehpihna gam teng zel sak, Hih gal gam ah ih om lai in, Hong hehpihna thu gen in.

Khat tang hih hang pai in gen ni, Leitung dahna kiam ding hi, Lungsim deih teng tawntung omna, Kim tak in a om ding hi.

title: INN PHA BEL AH I PAI DING HI
body:
Mi siangthote pai na dinglampi in Pasian mai-ah a om ding hi Vantung khua mualah I pai ngitnget a Zingsol I tungah hong taang hi

Inn pha bel ah I pai dinga Lungdamna tawh I kimu dinghi. Khua mun nuambel ei te’n I phak ciang Dahna om nawnlo hi.

Lamnuam tawn mi siangtho honpite in Zion khua-ah a pai kik ciang Meivak sungah namgimtui thunkhol un Vantung khua-ah I pai ding hi

Lam nuam tawn dinga I ngaihsut tek leh Khat leh khat I ki-it na in Pasian tawh eite I omkhawm ding a  Nuam in I om tawntung ding hi.

Zawdan gungei a a votna gei-a hI din’ hangin a gal khatah Topa Pasian tawh I ngap khawm ding a A min I phat tawntung dinghi

title: ZAWDAN GUN GEI-AH
body:
Zawdan gungei-ah ka ding a A gallam ka en hi. Khanan gamnuam hong kilang a Ka luahna ding gam hi.

Tua gamnuam sungah ei I khawl ding hi. A nop tawntung gungallam in –ah Nung ciangin maw si le tuuno lasa ding hi.  Zeisu tawh mang tawntung ding hi.

Tua gam phabel sunga inn ah Khuavaak tawntung om hi. Pasian leh Zeisu vaangin aTaang tawntung ding hi.

Cik ciang tua gam ka tung ding hiam Khuamial om lohna-ahI Pa mai-taang lungdamna dim, Cik ciang ka mu ding hiam

Ka sin sungah lungdamna ding Leitung sawtpi omlo Zawdan gunpi kilok hangin Lungdam in ka tum zo.

title: HONG HON TOPA ZEISU TAL AH
HING EI VE
body:
Kei Topa Hnig eive, tun zong leitungah om Ahin kik ken thei gige, Mite’n bang gen taleh A man hong hehpih thei a, hong hopihna kaza Amah kasap laitakin hong nai gige

Hinge hinge hong hon Khazih Topa Hong tonpih a,hong hopih hi, ka paina khempeuh ah Hinge hinge mihing honkhia Topa Bang kacih thei hiam nong cih leh Kalung sungah hing hi

Ka kiim leitung mun khempeuh ah hong itna kamu Lungkhamna ka thuak zel hang Ka lungkia ngeikei ding, Huihpi nunna tengah A man hong kha, ken ka thei A mah hong kilat ding ni hong tung ding hi

Nuamun nuamun Zeisu mi, lungdamin lasa un Hin tawn tung, haleluijah, Zeisu khazih kumpi Muanna tawh a zong mite’n A mah muthei ding uh Tuabang itna a nei midang om ngei kei

title: KA THEI HI KEI HONG TANPA HING HI
body:
Ka theihi kei hong Tanpa hing hi, Leitungah hong pai kik ding hi. Ka theihi, nuntakna thak hong pia Hehpihna vaang a khut sung om.

Kathei, ka thei To Zeisu hing hi, Leitungah hong paikik ding hi, Ka thei, ka thei nuntakna hong pia, Hehpihna vang a khut sung om.

Ka thei hi hong thuciam pel ngei kei, A gensa thu bei ngeilo ding, A gilo sihna pan ka suakta, Amah mu ding nung ciangin ah.

Ka thei hi ka om nang mun bawlkhol, A omna peuh kei zong om ning, A lamdang a mah’n kei hong keem hi. Kei a dingin hong pai kik ding.

title: A THU ZAZA NUAM ING
body:
Zeisu thu thei semsem nuam ing Hongit na thu gengen nuam ing Keitang hong si pa hong itna A cing zaw in ka thei nuamta

A thu zaza nuam ing ,a thu zaza nuam ing Keitang hong si pa hong itna A cing zaw in ka thei nuamta

Zeisu thu ken sinsin nuam ing A deihna khentel thei nuam ing Pasian Khasiangtho ka sia pa’n Khris zia leh tong hong lakkhia ta’n

Zeisu kammal zaza nuam ing Topa tawh holim nuam ing A aw ngai in vai khempeuh ah A genteng ka pomkim nuam ta

Van tokhom ah a tutna thu Van hauhna teng a neihna thu A gam zainang leh hong pai nang Za nuam ing Kumpi a suah nang

title: TOPA HOIH HI
body:
Topa hoih hi, Topa lian hi Lungkham hun in hong huh a, Ama kiangah a beel mite Ama’n limtak hong kem hi.

Hong phat ning maw, Toapa hong phat ning  Na vangliatna lamdang si, Thuk in zai e,Lamdang nong itna, Ka belh suangpi To Zeisu

Lungsim tamkham, lam-et bei te, Meigong tagah genthei te, Leivui pan in nong lamto a, Zeisu hong itna bek hi.

Kha siangtho mit hong vaksak a, Itna khut tawh hong len a, Kei nong sap leh kong dawng ding a, Ka thu sim kong hilh ding ci.

title: TOPA KA NUNNA HONG BAWL HOIH HI
body:
Ka nuntakna Topa nang a hi, Muvanlai bang ka thahat nading Nisim thupha namkimte nong pia Ka nuntakna Topa nang a hi.

(Cho) Topa ka nunna hong bawl hoih sak in A tawntung na min kong phat zawh nading Hih leitungah hu nong kop lai teng in A tawntung na min kong phat den ding.

Topa hoihna leh hehpihna in Ka nuntakna tha hong dim sak hi Sing bang a keu sa ka nuntak na Gungei ah sing kung bang ka no ta.

Hih leitungah nopsak nate in Ka nuntakna hong gum zolo hi Zeisu min bek tawh ka kalsuan ciang Gungei ah sing kung bang ka no ta.

title: ZAWHNA OM HI ZEISU SUNG
body:
Kazahi, a lui tangthu, vanpan honpa hong paina thu, Kalvari ah sihna hong thuak hi, misia kei hong gum hi,  A si hong luankhiat man a, gim in a tauna thu ka za, Ka mawhnate ka ki sik a, tu’n zawhna , ka ngah hi.

Zawhna om hi, atawntung, ka honpa Zeisu sung, A si tawh kei mi mawh, Hong zongin hong lei zo, Ka theih ma’n hong it zo a, kei zong ka it kik thei ta, Gualzawhna ka ngah nangin,A si sung hong phum zo

A damsak theih thu ka za, Ama vangliatna lang sak a, Khebaite hoihtak lam pai sak hi, Mittaw khuamu sak hi Tua ciang ka it Zeisu kiang,kei hong dam sakin ka cih ciang, Amah ka kiangah hong pai a, Zawhna a hong pia hi.

Van ainn nuam thu ka za,Topa’n kei ading bawlzo ta, Kongzing khempeuhah khambek kiphah,Limlang tuipi galah,Vantung mite’lasakna,A hong tatkhiatna thu ka za Khatvei ciang ke’n zong tua laiah, Zawhna lasa ding ta

title: KUA I LANG PANG ZO DING
body:
Topa sungah nuam un, hong hehpihna phat un Hong hencip khempeuh phel khia hi Si tawh hongtan zo, lau nawn peuhmah kei un Zeisu ah deihna teng cing hi

//Eilam ah Pasian// Ei lam hong om leh kua i langpang zo ding, ///Kua/// Kua i lang pang zo, kua pangzo ding

Topa sung hat un, a thahatna suang un Nisim thuman in citak ni Siatna’n hong nawkciang, thuman ading hang un Amah i tha leh bukna hi

Ama thu muang un, a kamciam peel ngeilo Khris sungah Amen hi khin ta Lei a bei zongin, athu bei thei ngeilo Laisiangtho in gen khin zo ta

Topa sung kip un, a ang muanhuai sungah Tawntung nunna kipatna hi A thanem pen zong a khut sungpan in ah Kuamah in sut zolo ding hi

title: NITANG SUNG OM DIHIN
body:
Leitungah khua mial lungkham na dim a Khua vaak in nitaan na zong om ta Lungkhamna khuamial sung na om khak le Nitaang sung zong om thei ding hi teh.

(Cho) Nitaang sung om dih in Tawntung nitang sung om in Nitaang sung ah nungta dih in Tawntung nuam na sa ding hi Na lam hong taang sak ding hi Sanggam aw nitaang sungah om dih in.

Huihpin ih kimkot teng a nuai hang in Lam etna teng hong bei sak hang in Huihpi leh guah pite veng pak na ve Khuamial in lau na tam hang sa ni

Lam etna tawh nisim in lasa ni Khuamial in lau na tam hang sa ni Tawntung Honpa mai ih muak den kei leh I vekpi in hong huai ding hi veh.

title: LAI LEN TAWN
body:
A nop in bang a nuam pen hiam? Topa phat a laam mah nuam pen Khat leh khat khut kilen in Topan thupha hong pia tahen ki ci leng.

(Cho) Hei! Anopin nuam, gupngah ka kitel ni buang pawh Hei! Anopin nuam, kamtuam ka pau theih ni buang pawh Hei! Anopin nuam, lai len tawn a ih tawn deudeu buang pawh, Hei! Anopin nuam, Zeisu lam bang ih paak buang pawh.

Topa phat in khut beng ziahziah, Etlawm maitai nuih mai siusiau Khat leh khat khut ki van in Halleluijah, Ha le lujah ki ci leng.

Topa phat in khut van ziahziah Zeisu lian bel lian bel ci in A vangliatna phawk kawm in

Shalom shalom shalom shalom ki ci leng Topa phat in diang khawm ziahziah Taksa deih na teng sing khia in Zeisu lianbel lianbel ci in Zeisun Zeisun Zeisun hong it ki ci leng.

title: TOPA TAWH TONKHAWM LENG NUAMEI
body:
Topa tawh tonkhawm leng nuam e,Buaina kinuaisiah ta, Buaina tungah tawntung kigual zo hi. Haksakna omlo hilo a,Haksakna kizo thei, Topa hong om pihna kitel peuh leng.

Aw nuam sing, ka Topa sungah,Hong hehpihna lasa ning, Hong itna sung tawntung ka lung muang hi. Amah tawh tonkhawm leng nuam ei,Holim khawm leng nuam zaw laai, Topa sungah nisim in nuam ka sa.

Topa nang tawh holim khawm leng , Nong hona aw za ing, Na kammalte simin lungngaingai leng,Mit tawh na kimuh theihloh hang,  Na kilawn theihloh hang, Kei nong lawn lam nong suk khak lam ka thei.

Lam in diangin Topa phat ni,Kha sung kibual khawm leng, Topa hong om pihna hong lang sak hi. Suakta lote suahtak na tawh,Dam lote damna tawh,T opa’n hong om pihna hong lang sak hi.

title: CIK CIANG NONG CIAH DIAM
body:
Hong taisan nai keng ei Nang nong mangngilh hangin Hnog nusia naikeng ei Nang nong phawkloh hangin Na siatlam thei ing, na gitloh lam thei ing Kei hong zuan photin, kong kikhel sak ding hi

Cik ciang nong ciah diam Cik ciang nong zuan diam Lainatna khitui tawh Haibang hongngak ing ei Kumkhua kivei ta ei, sul hong hei loding maw Siatna hong phak ma’n hong ciahkik vaw ka ta

Na ga,tat bangbang in Hong thukkik hizen leng Sim leitung panin Kong paikhia ta dinga Hong lainat ingei, kang meili na zuat ding Zing ciang cinawn seken, tuni’n hong sang pak vaw

title: HAI KHAT PAN IN DAWN KHAWM
body:
Up leh Zuih ki khat hi hangTaang mi siangte bangin ah, Khasiang khat bek sungah,Hai khat pan ih dawn khawm hi

(Eite pum khat hihang Zeisu sungah)3 (Zeisu sungah)2 Eite pum khat hihang, Zeisu sungah

(It na’n khau bang hong khih Zeisu sungah)3 (Zeisu sungah)2 It na’n khau bang hong khih, Zeisu sungah

.(Khut kilen in sem ni Zeisu sungah)3 (Zeisu sung ah)2 Khut kilen in sem ni Zeisu sungah

title: VANGAM MALEP
body:
Leitung i nuntakna, siatna tawh kidim, Nek leh dawn haksa, sum zonna zong haksa, Siatna a tam man in, inn kuan kilem nawnlo, Tua innkuan sung zong , gawt mun neu khat a hi.

Vangam malep, Oh! Vangam ma lep, Vangam malep lei ah zong kiciam khol thei, Zeisu nei kim in, Pasian zahtak ciat leng, Vangam malep, innkuan sung nuam pen.

Innkuan sung lutang in, Pate hi a, Pate siam manin, innkuan sung nuam ding hi, Zite’n pasal thu mang leng, tate’n zong thumang ding Tua innkuan sung zong Topa’n makaih ding hi.

Innkuan sung nuam pan in, hong khang khia mite, A heina peuh ah maitai tak in om thei, Pasian in thupha pia, Pasian in ompih hi, Tua innkuan sung zong, vangam neu khat a hi.

title: HONG LEENG ING EE
body:
Leivui pan in hong lam to, Niinphual pan in hong dom to, A sang na lam ka tung to Lung mawl kei ka nuntakna hong lam to, A zawng khal pen kei bang lel, A lungmawl pen kei bang lel. Na min ading nong lam to, Gual laiah Sian aw na minpha ka lo.

( Hong leenging e Sianmang Zeisu,  Na zal na leh na anglim ngai ing ee, Khuva bang hong khawl sak aw)2

Lai kawi khat zong theilote,Laipai khat zong neilo te, Lung mawl genthei mangbang te, Luai nau bang hong muamin hong pantah a, An zong ne thei nailo te, Puan zong silh thei nai lo te, Gal leh sa bang melma te, Sian in hong itna dam tui hong luan ta

Tun sung khat pan laizom te, Itna melma lung mawlte, Suihlung dawn bang ih tuak diam, Sinlai siangtho va bang pil ding in hong siam, Hong leeng aw, hong leeng aw, Sianmang Zeisu hong leeng aw,  Nang kiang lo koi ka pai diam Na min phat lo maimit ka sing thei diam.

title: KAWL GAM HONG PIA IN
body:
Kawlgam hong pia in kawlgam hong pia in Natat samite Sian aw na zal na, nun nuam leeng Dingin nun nuam khawl ding in Sian aw na ang lim liap ah hong pi in.

(Cho) Tui in tuipi atuam bang in kawlgam Hong tuam tahen, nong gupkhiat na Tul sing lam teh thu, Kawlgam bup Asiat ma in kha khan lawhna hong Pia in, hong pia in Topa aw Kawlgam hong pia in.

Kawlgam aading in khua ul sisuak in, Khitui naptui tawh lobang hial ding in, It na melma te nuih siam hong lel te, Sian aw na ang lim liap ah hong pi in.
