Tho in la taang in sun ni tang bang in, Topa khuavakin nang hong tan zo hi. Natan na sung ah, Kawlgam minam te, Hong uk kumpi te hong pai ding uh hi.

title: KAI ADING TAM KHANG SUANGPI
body:
Kei adding tam khang suangpi Nangma sung kong bel ding hi Na pangvang pan hong kizui Thakhat luangkhia si leh tui Mawh kiphel thuapna hi hen Hong sut henla hong sawp hen

Ka khutin ka sepna tawh Thukham deihna cin zolo Hahkat den zomah leng zong Tawplo khitui luan hang zong Mawhna kiphel zo samlo Nangmah bekin nong honzo

Khutsung bangmah keng lopi Na singlamteh kong bel hi Puan neilo nangman nong guan Cimawh hehpihna kong zuan Kihhuai tuinak kong delh hi Nong silkeh ka si ding hi

Ka nuntak laitak hi taleh Ka sih laitak hi taleh Theihloh gam ka kai ciang zong Thukhenna mai kong tun dong Keitang kitam suangpi aw Nangma sung hong bel sak aw

title: HONG PAISAN KEN
body:
Hong paisan ke’n migi Topa, Kong thum hong ngai in, Mi dangte kiang na ban bangmah, Kei hong kheng kei in.

Topa, Topa, kong thum hong ngai in, Mi dangte kiang na ban bangmah, Kei hong kheng kei in.

Hehpihna na tokhom mai-ah, Kisik kong khukdin, Nang hong huh in ka uplahna,  Noptuam hong pia in.

Nangma phatna bek ka suang hi, Na mai muhna ding, Na thupha tawh nong phel ding hi, Lungzan damna ding.

Ka nuamna teng bulpi nang mah, Hinna sang pha zaw, Leitung vantung omlo kuamah  Nang sang a pha zaw.

title: HONG PAI CIANGIN
body:
Hong pai ciangin, hong pai ciangin, Suangmanpha khawm dingin, Ama itte a ma aate,A suangmanphate,

Singsang aksi sol bangin,A taang ciat ding uh hi, A kumpi lukhu tungah,Te diamdiam ding hi.

Hong khawm ding hi, hong khawm ding hi, A gam sung om ding mi, A siangtho te, a taangphate,A suangmanpha te,

Naupangnote, naupangnote, Hong tanpa a itte,Ama a hi, a ma- it hi,A suangmanpha hi.

title: HAT IN ZION SEM MENG IN
body:
Hat in Zion, sem mengin na nasep ding, Mi teng tungah khuavak Pasian hilh in, Mihing khat zong khuamial sunga mangthang ding, Phalhetlo hi mihing piangsak Pa in.

Lungdamna thupha, nopna thupha Zeisu hong tatna thupha va gen meng in.

Enven mawhna khuamial thonginn mial sungah, Mi tul tampi kihen in om uh hi. Khat beek vapailo a, mau ko dingin ah, A suahtak na’ng uh Topa si napi.

Mi namkim pau namkimte kiang va gen in, Amau henna in itna Pasian hi. Kiniamsak in a bawlsate hon dingin, Van nun nuam piakna ding hong si suk hi.

Na tate sawl in tua thupha gen dingin.  Na sum tawh huh in manlang theina ding, Na lungsim teng tawh nakpi thungetsak in, Na zat khempeuh Zeisu’n hong dimkik ding.

title: PASIAN ITNA NGAIH SUN IN
body:
I lungngaih tawntung dingin ah,Topa Pasian itna, Mawhna a lian I neih napi,“Tate aw” hong ci hi.

En un, Topa Pasian in, tate aw hong cihna,Pasian tat I tang ding hi, en un,Topa Pasian in, ei hong it thupha phatna,

Topa tawh kinaitheihna ding,Zeisu a si luangsak, Ka ta itte aw, ci’n hong sam,A angsung I khawl ding.

Nung ciang I min bang cithan’ ding,Tu’n kitheinailo hi. Topa Zeisu hong kumkik ciang,Amah I sun ding hi.

Tua thu a lawpte khempeuh in,Ih Topa bang ding hi. Sihna a zo minthang Topa,Maimu dingin a pha.

title: SINGLAMTEH’N INN LAM HONG HILH
body:
Singlamteh lam tawnin ka ciahkul ding hi, Tualo lam dang om lopi, Tua khuavak kongpi tung theingei kei ning, Singlamteh lam ka khialh khak leh.

Singlamteh’n inn lam hong hilh, Singlamteh’n inn lam hong hilh. Mailam ka pai ciangin nuam semsem ding, Singlamteh in inn lam hong hilh.

Singlamteh phung ka vanteng tolhkhia khin hi, Topa mai ka muh ciangin, Lungtaiitak tualam tawn ding kong kipan, Ka lung sung phatna tawh kidim.

Si kithehna lamtawn ka ciahsuak ding hi. Topa totsa lampi mah, A dawndongin kei ka kahtoh thei leh, Pasian inn sung ka kha teng ding.

title: ZION KHUA I PAI HI
body:
Topa itteng pai ni. Langsak ni i nuamna, Kituaktak in la sakhawm ni,Kituaktak in la sakhawm ni, Topa tokhom kim-ah, Topa tokhom kim-ah.

Zion khua I pai hi, a kilawm khuaphapi Zion, Ih tun mateng kah toto ni, Kilawm Pasian khuapi Zion.

Ei Pasian theilo te’n phat nuamta kei leh uh, Ei vantung Kumpipa ta te’n,Ei vantung Kumpipa ta te’n, Thangsak un, nuamna thu thangsak un nuamna thu.

Vantung gam sung tunma kham khua sung sikma in, Hong maleep hi siangtho nuamna, Hong maleep hi siangtho nuamna, Zion mual kahlai in Zion mual kahlai in.

Tua hi a, lasa un nul un dahna khitui, Vantung gamah a nopna mun, Vantung gamah a nopna mun, Tunna ding lam i zui, tunna ding lam i zui.

title: THUNGETNA HUN NUAM
body:
Thunget hun nuam, thunget hun nuam, Lungkhamna pan hong samkhia a, Ka deih ka sapna a tuamtuam, Ka gentheih hun ka Pa mai-ah, Dahna hong tun ciang thungen leng, Ka lungsim hong nuamtuam sak a, Mawhna’n hong zol ciang thungen leng, Dawimangpa thang pan ka suakta.

Thunget hun nuam, thunget hun nuam, Va lenpih in keima thumna, Keima kha thupha a pia nuam, Thuman a dik Pasian kiangah, Keima mai-ah um in muangin, Hong pai in hong cih khit nungsang, Thunget hun nuam hong tun simin, Lungkhamna teng amah suan tang.

Thunget hun nuam, thunget hun nuam, Kei lungsim hong hehnem lai in. Pasian hong ciam Khanaan gamnuam, Luah ding ka lentoh mateng in, Hih ka pumpi puan bang suaha, Sang dingin tulngeilo noptuam, Ka leen’toh ciang kha ning mangpha, Thunget hun nuam, thunget hun nuam.

title: DING UN, DING UN ZEISU MI
body:
Ding un, ding un, Zeisu’ mi singlamteh galkapte, A kumpi dial sangkhan un, lelhna thuaksak lo e, Gal khat khit khat a ban in, Ama’n hong zawhpih ding, Gal khempeuh zawhkhit ciangin,Khazih Topa maang ding.

Ding un, ding un, Zeisu’ mi, Mang un pengkul sawlna, Galpi phual-ah vakuan un, Tuni Topa nipha, Pasal kisa teng kuan un, Galte a tam hangin, Tha le tha kisi sak un, Hang seem un lau ciangin.

Ding un, ding un, Zeisu’ mi, Ama tha bek suangun, Mihing tha’n hong lelsak ding, Nomau tha muang kei un, Pasian thu galvan bangin, silhin, vil-in, thungen, Gal leh sep ding om ciangin,A baihsa’n om khial ke’n.

Ding un, ding un, Zeisu’ mi, gal bei haknawnlo ding, Tun’n galkapna ding zing ciang,Gal zawhna la ging ding, A zote khempeuh in-ah, nuntak lukhu ngah ding, Vanglian kumpipa kiangah,A tawntung maangkhawm ding.

title: TOPA TAWH TONKHAWM IN
body:
Topa tawh tonkhawm in, bangbang piangta leh, Na lampi khuamial hang, Ama nungzui in,  Na gal te’n hong neh in, A lauhhuai hangin, Zeisu tawh ton le teh kihtak ding om kei.

Tonkhawm in, hangtak mainawt in, Natha hong khauhsak ding hi, Nisim in amah tawh pai in, Na khualzinna lam hong pi ding hi.

Topa tawh tonkhawm in, Na paina peuh ah, Khuamialna lim sungah lam hong hilh ding hi, Ama vaangin na lampi hong taangsak ding, Keugaw gam zong lonona hong piangsak ding.

Topa tawh tonkhawm in, Nang thu’n tawlnga ken’n, Hong thupiakna bangin na gamta ding hi. Hong sawlna bang mangin, Ama tha muangin, Zeisu nun na zuih leh na khial ngeikei ding,

title: TOPA BANGZAH NA LIAN
body:
Topa Pasian nang ma khut tawh na bawl sa, Leitung khempeuh ka ngaihsut ciangin ah, Aksi te mu in vanging te ka za hi, Leitung khempeuh ah na vang ki lang hi.

Tua ahih ciang la kong sa hong honpa, Bangzah na lian, bangzah na lian, Tua ahih ciang kong phat hi Topa aw, Nang na lian hi, nang na lian hi.

Sing lah-ah zong ka vak kawikawi ciangin ah, Singkung tungah vasa ham ngaih ka za, Mualsang dawn pan, kuam thuk sung ka etsuk ciang, Lui ging za in huihdam hong nung hiauhiau,

Pasian in ah a Tapa haza lo in, Hong puak ka ngaihsut ciang um kei phial ing, Singlamteh tung kei van lungdam tak pua in, Sisan luangin ka mawhna hong paih sak.

Ki kona tawh Khazih hong pai kik ciangin, Hong ciahpih ding bangzah ka nuam ding hiam? Tua ciang ki-niamkhiat na tawh ka bia ding a, Ka Pasian lian hi ci’n ka ki ko ding.

title: TOPA HONG HEHPIH NA
body:
Zingsang phalvak tungin,Vansang dawn pan in, Nisim in lungnopna ka ngah hi, Mual sang dawn leh guam sung, Mualkuam zanglei ahi zong, Topa hong itna in kikhel ngei lo hi.

Zankim lai ahi zong,Ih pa anglim nuai ah, Lung nop kicing hauhna ka ngah hi, Nuamsa’n ka om zonginHaksa’n ka om zong in, Topa hong itna in kicing den hi.

Topa aw hong phat ning, a tawn tung in, Nisim naisim kong phat zong tul geilo ding,  Nong itna lian in kikhel ngeilo a tawntung, Topa hong hehpih na lian lua sang.

title: KA LUNGMUANG TA
body:
Mawhna vangik puak zwah ding hilo, Zeisun singkhuam tungh hong puaksak zota, Ka mawh hong maisak zo a, a sin hong sawp zo, A liamma hang natna teng dam khin ta.

(Cho) Ka kha muangta, ka lungmuang ta, Kalani ah si To Zeisu sisan hang, Lengthe bangin kakhuang ding hi, Kuama telzawh loh lungnopna nei khin tang.

Ka etlawm ta Pasian mi dingin Zeisu paih let in hong ki et ciangin Tun ka kilawm ta hi, Pasian mi dingin, Pasian mit tawh kei hong ki et ciangin.

Hong ki leizo, hong ki tan zo, Man tawh kileisa mikhat ka hita, Kei hong kisam ding hi mopi pawi sungah, Nang na uh hiam Tuuno pawipi sungah.

title: TOPA VANG KIAMLO
body:
Leitung nuntakna, khat vei leh nopna, Khatvei leh sehnel gam bang, Cimawh beidongin, damlo zawngkhal in, Khat veivei lamet bei kisa.

Topa vang kiamlo kikhel lo,(Hallelujah)  A hoihna kiamlo ki khel lo, Hong itna zing nisuak bang hi, Topa hih theihna ki ciangtan lo.

Galilee gamah Zeisu hong vak lai Damlo tampi damsak hi,Misi thosak hi, miphak damsak hi, Natna namkim te damsak hi.

Lunggim mi ading lungnopna om hi, Bangin hong lunggim sak hiam, En in na mai-ah thupha nak om hi,  Na up na muan gamzah nang aa,

title: KI CING HI
body:
Topa hong piak thupha, kei leh ka innkuan pihaa ding, Ki cing hi, hong hehpihna ka phat ding,  Neek leh dawn, silh leh ten, Nisim zat ding sum leh pai Hong pia hi, ka sapna hong cing sak hi.

(Kicing hi, hong hehpih na thupha )2 kei aading hong hehpihna ki cing hi (Kicing hi, hong hehpih na thupha )2 kei aading hong hehpihna ki cing hi

A si hang mawh maina, a liamma hangin damna, Hong pia hi, hong hehpihna ka phat ding, A khawnkhong nuntakna, A zawnkhal na hang hauhna, Hong pia hi, hong hehpihna, kicing hi.

Thanemte tha hatna, cidam lote tung damna, Hongpia hi, hong hehpihna ka phat ding, Lunggim lungdamna, aki hen mi suahtakna, Hong pia hi hong hehpih na kicing hi.

title: KAL SUAN SIM IN
body:
Kalsuan simin, honpa kamai ah pai hi, A itna khut tawh hong makaih a, Husan simin Topa nangmah kongbia hi,  Nangmah tawh tonkhawm leng nuam ka sa.

Kalsuan simin, a hongpi ding ka thei hi, A sang zaw ah hong paipih tawntung hi, Khat vei ni ciang lamtawpna ka tung dinga, Kalsuan simin inn ka nai semsem ta.

Ka upna tha khat veivei ahong kiam ciang, Ka etna khempeuh lungkiatna hi, Ki hei kik in kei hong Gumpa ka et ciang, Hong ompih man in ka thahat hi.

Bang bang hong piang ta leh Pasian kamuanghi,  Nuntakna a mah sungah om hi, A mah lampi a hong honsak thei Pa hi, Khapsa gam nuamah hong tun ding hi.

title: KA KHUAL ZIN NA HIH LEITUNG
body:
Ka khual zinna hih leitungah, haksatna a tam hang, Ka lam tawpna ah Zeisu in hongngak cih ka thei hi, Tua mun ka tun matengin ah, kalsuan in ka pai ding, Van kongkhak pan Zeisu’n hongngak, keizong ka nai semsem

Kumpipa mai kamuh ciang bangzah in a nuam zen tam, Lungdamna letsong ka sang ding hi, Leitung ah ka sepna bangin thaman hong kipia ding hi, Tua hun ciang phawknawn kei na ning, Hih leitung haksatna te,

Kongit u leh nau lawmgualte aw, hih leitung na nun sungin, Vantungah na thaman dingin bangzah na khol zo hiam?  Na sepkhiat bang na piakkhiat bang, Topa’n hong thukkik ni ciang, Maizum in na bu kha zaw diam, lungdam in na om zaw diam.

Hih leitung haksatna leh gimna te ih thuak hangin ah, Phamawh kei hih leitung gimna tomno khat sung bek hi, A tawntung ka luah ding kham innpi’nHong ngak cih ka thei hi, Tua maninTopa nasepna, ke’n nuam kasa sem sem.

title: ITNA PASIAN
body:
Leitung mit tawh mel ka muh loh hang, Vanglian Pa khut in paai bang hong pom den,  Naubang hong kepnate, Ham bang hong huaite, A nop in nuam semsem Hallelujah.

Leitung pilna bang mah neilo a, Lungmawl kei bang lel mimci bang nongtel, Sian aw na lenggah huan,Gia bangzun ka cimlo, Lau khasiangtho tuibang hong dim den aw.

Tung solkhapi a mialzong,Tungsunni mual a liam zong, Mualliam theilo kei nong itna, Cinglo taklo tual niam ka nunna,A sangna lam hong kaito , Agape itna Pasian, Namin paak bang kong tawina, Zaila’n naubang hong awi awi ning maw.

Patpuan hilo, naipuan hilo a, Zeisu sisan tawh kizem puan silh tang, Lungin ka gelgel ciang hoihin a hoih sem sem, Anbang hong itna lian tumdang diaksang.

 Na hehpihna tawh hih ciang kong tung, Mailam ka nunna hong zang toto aw, Lungbang hong sungden aw, Abraham bangin, Mite aa ding thupha hong hisak aw.

title: TUA HI KA LUNGDAMNA
body:
Ka nunna ka lungngai a lunggim lua cih na’ng theilo, Mite enleng maizumna khat geelleng lam-et bei, Kei bang lel ka nuntakna bang hi lel hiam ka cih lai, Ka maiah sing khuampi khat muthei ing.

Tua hi ka lungdamna, tua hi ka suahtakna, Tua hi ka kipahna, tua hi ka lam-etna, Tua hi kei hong siampa, tua hi ka vang neihna, Tua in gual zawhna hong pia.

Leitung ka nunna khempeuh avekpi’n ka piakhia zo, Ka sung pan awgingkhia teng phatna la bek ahi zong, Phat dingin kilawm pen sa’ng,Pahtawi dingin zong hoih pen, Hong itna lian ke’n bang tawh ka thuk zo diam.

Tu-in kha muanna neitang,Ka geelna teng guak suaklo, SepnateTopa thupha silh leh teen ding zong hong sik, Ka kha tha zong hong dim zel,Bangbang piang zong lau nawn keng Topa deihna bang piangcih ka tel nung sang.

title: VANG LIAN NA KA TUAH DING TEL
body:
Zeisu itna’n sihna pan hong gum khia, Mi khial kei a dingin a sisan hong luang,

Mangthang mi khial gilo kihhuai pen ing, Vang lian ka tuah ding tel, (Oh kei bang leltak in vanglian aka tuah ding, lamdang oh lamdang lua.

Oh a itna na’n Jesu’n hong gumkhia zo, Phu loh vangliatna tawh kei hong pom lai a,

Tua vangliatna pian dang sisan vang hi, Piandang vangliatna hi ka tan dia lawm aw,

Vantung ka tun dong a ka la ding hi, Pian dang sisan vangin vangliatna kei a.

title: ETLAWM EE
body:
Van khasiangtho hong leeng a, A khawlna mun et lawm ee, Huih bang mau-in lambing in ki pak ziah2 Kam thak pau-in kipau a, lathak te zong ki sakhia,V anlaukha a khawlna mun et-in lawm ee

Etlawm ee, Etlawm Zion tate, The bang khuangin gungei sing bang huang diamdiam ,Etlawm ee, Etlawm sian vontawi te, Gualzawhna lasa-in Topa phat uh hi.

Khanlawhna meibang hong kuang, Ki-itna hong khang semsem, A ki-imcip mawhna te zong hong ki phokhia, A ki lemlo mite tung kilemna daitui hong kia, Maigum mi zong maitai-in hong diang khia ta.

Dam lo ten damna ngah a, Lunggim mite’n tawldamna, Topa tatsa gupngah mi hong khang sem sem, Vangliatna tawh ki tuamzo, gualzo pen te ihi hi. Teel tuam tate Topa a ding mainawt ni.

title: LAMDANG ZEN MAH SI CIA
body:
Zan a vansang en ding ka khuadak leh, Vanpi nungah apil Pasian om veh, Aksite a mau mun ciat ah belh a, Van dumpi puan in silh sak khin zota.

Vanglian Pasian lamdangzen mah si cia, Vanpi’n hong bia, napi’n hong phawk si cia, Telzawh dinghi lo lamdang nong it zia, Vanglian Pasian lamdang mah si cia.

Gamla pek ah ni kha aksi ka mu, Dem zawhloh hehpihna Pasian ka mu, Meii tung tuangin hong ki pulak ding hi, Tua kan a lamdang zaw omlo dingpi

Lawp cinten in vantung ka ento a, A bawlsa khempeuh te lamdang ka sa, Bang hang peuh mah in kei hong phawk zenzen, A tapa sing tungah hong ki khai zenzen.

title: KA INN DIM ZO
body:
Pa’ inn sungah nopna leh lungkimna om hi tu ni’n, Sabuai tungah an tampi om a, kua mah nolhlo pi, Lasakna leh nuihna aw tua mun ah ki za den a, Ahizong Pa in dahna tawh hih thu hong gen khin ta

Ka inn dim zo ka lo bel hawm si ee, Tu-ni’n ka lo ah kua kuankhia ding, Ka it ka tate in sabuai kiim bek um nuam napi, Ka lo ah kuamah kuan nuamlopi. Ka lo ah kuamah kuan nuam lopi.

Sabuai kiangah ding khia in kong khak pan in dakkhia ve, An tam na innpi galah ante kuai khin zo ta ee, An lak hun khengkhin zo ta a, a la ding omlo ma taw, Inn sung pan Pa’ thumna aw za thei lo lailai na maw.

title: THUNGEN KHIA NING
body:
Sep ding a ki lawm lopi ka sem kha a, Gen ding a kilawm lopi ka gen kha hi, Tua hun ciang hih ka sem dingThupha ka ngah na’ng –in ah, Mun khat ah gel-in thu ngen khia ning.

Ken’n pawh thu ngen ning,Ken’n pawh thu ngen ning, Lam hong pii ding lawmpa,Khat ke’n nei le ling, Ke’n pawh thu ngen ning,Ke’n pawh thungen ning, Mun khat ah gel-in thu ngen khia ning.

Nisim a hongpiak thupha teng phatpeuh leng, Ka thumna khempeuh hong dawng ding cih kathei hi, Mun khat ah gel khian inah.A ma kiang thungen peuh leng, Ka vangik khempeuh hong dawn khia hi.

title: GUAM TE’N MUAL TE KIPSAK THEI AI VE
body:
Mual tungah ih din teh nuam mah si ee, Ih kha zong suakta in nuam sa veh, Pasian tawh a kinai pha diak tawh ki bang ee, A bawlsa a khutma ih muh teh.

Guam te’n mualte kipsak thei bek ai ve, Sang kah leng hong hatsak semsem ta, Topa lunggulh hun te lungdam huai gige, Guam sung ih tot ciang hong nuam sak se.

Mual leh guam tawh ki dimin ih nun sung teng,  Nop hun leh lungkiat hun ih thuak zel,  Nopsak hun lungkiat hun phukha mah ta se leng, Tua hun ciang na ngawnin hong kem lel.

Khat vei ciang guam cih bang om nawn ke’n teh, Zi-on mual tungah ih kah tak ciang, A etlawm vantung gam ih muh ciang nuam si’n teh, Hun in hong suvet lo ding tua ciang.

title: HOLIM NUAM EE
body:
Kong piak vantung nopna, Na ngah sa suahtakna, Thei lo-in tu ciang na puuk zeel maw, Pa’ kiang kong thum sak hi, An ngawlin thu ka geen zel, Itna bek in leitung zawhna

Holim nuam ee, Holim nuam ee, Van a kha siangtho hong kumsuk teh, Holim nuam ee, Holim nuam ee, Khasiangtho aw ka sung hong teeng den aw.

Hauhna kong piaksa hi,Zong un na mu ding hi, Lung nopna pilna kongpiak sa hi, Dawi in hong kheemzeel maw, Lau in na lungkia maw, Na sansa upna tawh zo in

Lungkia nawn kei ning, lung kia nawn kei ning, Suakta zo ka lungdamna khang semsem, Um lah nawn kei ning, Nungkik nawnlo ding, upna leh itna in zawhna,

title: SIATNA HOIHNA TAWH ZO IN
body:
Siatna te’n ih nunna hong zo nuam in, Ih kampau ah hong siah tawntung hi, Ih khelh theih na’ngin, ih puk theih na’ngin, Hong zol hong khem hong tah tawntung hi.

Hong hamsiatte samsia kik lo-in,Thupha tawh thuk in la, Hong bawlsiate ading thu nget sak in, Siatna leh gitlohna te’n,Kizo sak peuhmah kei in la, Thu hoih le thupha tawh zo tawntung in.

Na galte a gilkial leh an pia in, A dang a taak leh zong tui suah in, Siatnate siatna tawh thuk kik lo in, Thu hoih thupha tawh zo tawntung in.

Hong sam hi eite thupha luah dingin, Thuman sang thuhoih len tawntung in, A nam tui pen leh a deih huai pen in, Dikna puan bangin silh, tawntung in.

title: BETSAIDA BUAL AH KI DIAH IN
body:
Betsaida bual kilok lai, Kha siangtho huih a nun lai, A hun lap aa ki diah te’n, Damna ngah damna ngah hi.

Lap lai teh aw lap teh,Betsaida bual kilot lai, Ki diah in tun ki diah in, Paulap zongzong nawn ke’n aw.

Na nunna lungmuang ken aw, Paal lunte zong tual kia thei, Na laukha lailungmuang ding, Cii bang teel zekai ke’n aw.

title: HIH LAMPI TAWN IN
body:
Hih lampi tawnin sawtpi ka pai zo hi, Hi hi dam tak in pai ning, Mualsang te lah kah hak mahmah aa, Khat veivei ka nungah van a gik pua ing.

Inn ka tun teh a vek in bei na veh, Ka buai na teng,Tua mual kan khin peuhpeuh leng, Ka vangik teng nga ning,Tua munah ka tun tak teh, Lungdamna khitui luang ding, Inn ka tun teh a vekin bei na ve Ka buai na teng.

Tu laitak in bel, haksatna a tam hang , Ka hat na’ng a hong piak hi, Zanin khuamial in ka lungzuan hang, Kei guak hong nusia ngei het lo ding a hi.

title: SUP LAWH KEI NING
body:
Mite’n Zeisu’ nungzuihna,Lung kia in tawp san mah leh, Ke’n bel ka cross pua-in ka zui den ding, Nisim in tha hong guan ding, To Zeisu ka nei zo hi,Suplawh keining Zeisu nung ka zuih man in.

Hong piak sate bek ah lungdam ka hi kei hi, Hong piak lai ding te ah zong a min phat ning, Tua manin nisim-in ah, gual zawhna la ka sa hi, Sup lawh kei ning Zeisu nung ka zuih man in.

Ka kha nuntakna dingin,Ka muh nailoh vantung gam, Upna tawh tung ding ci’n ka gen khol gam, Pasian’ hong kamciam bangin, Hih leitung na khempeuh zong, Hong piak thuah ding cih upna tawh ka mu ta.

title: NUNGTA AHIH MAN
body:
Pasian in a Tapa hong sawl, Hong it ding leh hong damsak ding, Ka mawhnate maisak ding hong pai, Nungta a hih manin a han guak bek om hi.

Nungta ahih man bangbang piangta se leh, Phamawh sa keng zong lau bek keng, Mailam hunte a khut sungah om cih thei ing, A mah nungta ahih man ka nun na’n man nei.

Naugek te zong Amah hong kep sak, Bangzah tak in lungdam huai hiam, Tua sangin zong lungdam huai zaw lai, Nungta ahih man lau nang omlo cih thu mahmah

Ni khat ni ciang sihna gungal ah, Haksapi-in ka kan ding hi, Tua hun ciangin sih na zozo in, Amah kumpi a hihlam ka mu thei ding hi.

title: VAN LA PI
body:
Kei tumtak in lungdamna lasa-in ka pai hi, Khat veivei ka lungzuangin ka phun kha zelzel hi, Hi bang dinmun ciang bek tawh vakthap lel ding maw, Vantung mite tawh vanlapi sa khawm lo ding maw.

Mualsang tungpan in la aw gal zak ing, A mah muang in mang leng kei zong sa thei ding hing, Tua lungdamna thugen in ka vak kawm in ah, Lim tak in ka ngaih tak ciangin Vanlapi ka za.

Lungdamna thu gimpi a, genbaih kei mah in teh,  Na ki pat khiat ding zong baih kei thei kha mah in teh ,Hi hang ki pan phot lecin na tel na ding hi, Vanlapi a kisakna mun Zion na hi.

title: NIAL ZO KENG
body:
Deidan neilo simlei vannuai mi khempeuh, Lainat na aw nemno tawh hong sam lai, Calvary tulsinglel tungah khattang vontawi, Duang kikhai-in nang leh kei itna hong lak.

(Nial zo keng)2 Zeisu hong itna, Kata aw hong ciah in, hong ciah in, Lainatna awnem tawh hong samsam lai ve,  Nial zo keng, nial zo keng ee.

Thei hi leh nang zong nial kei ni teh maw, Theihloh kal hong it takpi Zeisu hi, Mipilte leh sum haute’n zong mu zo tuan lo, Ke’n nei tangh ee lungnopna taktak Zeisu.

title: KEIMA KONG BIAK PASIAN
body:
Keima kong biak Pasian, A vang lian Pasian,  Ngaihsut zawhloh in vaangliatna tawh dim hi, Sim zawhloh aksi- te phazah ding seh a, Tua van aksi-te a min ciatin sam hi.

Keima phatna lel tawh Topa lungkim hi, Keima biakna lelte Topa’n hong saang hi, Kei ka ginatloh hang Topa vaanglian hi, Ka biak Pasian hangin ka lungdam ding hi.

Eite biak Pasian in a nungta Pasian, Sing leh suang pasian, a si pasian hi lo Amah nungta ahih man, kei ka nungta hi. Ka Topa a ding kei ka nungta ding hi.

Pasian ngaihsut tham ding, mi’n bang hi lel hiam? A hong phawk tham ding mi in bang hi lel hiam? A Tapa khat neihsun hong pia ka Pasian, Hong itna vantung pan leitung hong tuak suk.

title: TUA KHUAPI TEE ZEIZAI
body:
Vantung kongkhakte tang pempam, Sabuaite kiphah dimdem, Kong honsa gei-ah mi khat ding veh, A tee zialzial gun ka mu a, ka tenna ding mun hi ta, Hih zah liangin , inn lunggulh ngei keing

Tua khuapi tee zeizai,Inn ka tu’n ding zong hong nai, Ka pa’n kongkhak gei-ah hong ngak zen ve leh, Hih leitung gam simtham pan,Suakta ding kiging zo tang, Hih zah liangin inn lunggulh ngei ke’ng

A inn kuankuan in kikhawm uh,A mai tai thei mahmah uh, A dahmai cih bang kimu lo hi,Lunggulhna tawh ka khiluang a, Kha nei leng ka leeng nuam ta, Hih zah liangin inn lunggulh ngei keing

Puan pak silhin lasa ziahziah,Tuuno pahtawina la hi, Kham gawsem tumin mi siang honpi, Phat khawm veni amau bang mah, Tatsa mi siangte hi hang,Hih zah liangin inn lunggulh ngei keing.

title: BUH LAK HUN ZO
body:
A seem dingte tawm lua a, na sep ding tampi om hi, Topa buh lak hun zo ta hi.Buhte minkhin kuai zota hi, Tawntung khuamial gam sungah nisim in bei den,

Aw, nisim nai simin bei den, Ka itna bei thei tuanlo, A mawkna in ka si luang ke’nteh, Ka tatsate’n ahilh kei leh, Vantung mi sawl mai ning.

Kuate ahiam, ka sawl ding, kei adingin kua pai nuam, Ka si manpha tawh ka tatsa,Mawhna sungah nisim bei den, Ka kiangah hong tung thei ding kuamah omlo

Amaute ka it manin, ka gam nuampi nusia in, Singkhuam tungah kipia zo ingh.Gimna thuak a ka tatna thu, Mi tampi’n theilo in khuamial sung om den.

Kei hiah om ingh Topa aw, nang ading hong sawl inla, Ka nuntakna nang a hi khin,Kha siangtho in hong makaih hen, Ka sem den ding gam khempeuh na neih mateng.

title: NA SIH NUNG CIANG
body:
Na sih nung ciang koi-ah na pai diam? Nang hong Tanpa mun bawlsa ah maw? Nang hong kheempa Satan kiangah maw? Na sih nung ciang koi-ah na pai diam?

Mihingta ding khatvei sih seh hi, Tuani hun ciang thukhenna a om ding aa,  Nang zong sanggam aw, na si ding hi., Na sih nung ciang koi-ah na pai diam?

Na sih nung ciang koi-ah na pai diam? Nang hong Tanpa mun bawlsa ah maw? Na pai theih na’ng hong Gumpa muangin, Khantawn hinna na ngahna ding hi.

 Na sih nung ciang koi-ah na pai diam? Nang hong Tanpa mun bawlsa ah maw? Tawntung nopsakna le gim thuakna,  Na deih teel in koi-ah na pai diam?

Na sih nung ciang koi-ah na pai diam? Nang hong Tanpa mun bawlsa ah maw? Lungnop kicing ding khat bek om hi, Mihing nunna paakpalh bang ahi.

title: KUA NA NGAWH DIAM?
body:
Topa hong gupkhiatna thu donlo in na omlai leh, Na nuntakna lungngai in, bangci ding na geel ngei maw Ka thuhilhte siatkaih in, nialnial in na om lai leh,  Ni khatni ciangin na zong ding hi.

Van mangpa kikona tawh,Peengkul hong kitum tak the, Gupkhiat mi siangtho khempeuh,Mitphiat kai in hong mang ding, Na pasal hong mang ding hi, Na tate hong mang ding hi, Tua ni takteh nang kua na ngawh diam?

Tua ni hong tun tak teh, hih leitung dahhuai sin teh, Vengsak veng khang mi kizong a, khitui luanna om ding, A lumkhawm khat hong mang ding,Ansu khawm khat hong mang ding, Tua nitak teh nang kua na ngawh diam?

Pawlpi sungah min apin, pawlpi ngeina teng zui-in, Gamtat hoihna hahkat in, kikhawm in sumpi pia-in, Tui na kiphum khit tak teh, Vantung tun ding na sawm leh, Khatvei na suakkik in Topa’n ci.

Na mawhna tu’n kisik in, peengkhul hong kitum ma in, Tua vantung mopi pawi-ah nang zong na om kei kha deh, Na sih khit ciangin hankhuk sungah vai kihawm nawnlo, Cih thei in, tu-in na Piangthak in.

title: TOPA AW KONG MUANG HI
body:
Topa aw, kong muang hi, Nang mah bek kong muang hi. Hih leitung nuntakna, lungmuan om thei lopi, Uptheih muantheih dingin, lungsim hemlam tam si, Hih leitung ka nun sung, Topa bek kong muang hi.

Kei hong sungin, kei hong liah in, ka Honpa aw, Ka suangpi aw, bittak in na khaliim hong seel aw, Lungmuanna huang sungah,Tawldamna liim sungah, Hong Lenin hong kha in, Na-ang sungah lungmuang takin,Hong khawlsak aw

Mite muan ding sangin, Topa muan hoih zaw hi, A muang mite lampi, Topa’n hu-in keem hi. Hong paisan ngeilo hi, hong nusia ngeilo hi, Hih leitung ka nun sung, Topa bek kong muang hi.

Hong theikhial ngeilo hi, hong telkhial ngeilo hi, Amah muanna sungah, dohna khempeuh veng hi, Hong enkhial ngeilo hi, hong hokhial ngeilo hi, Hih leitung ka nun sung, Topa bek kong muang hi.

title: TU’N NANGA HI TANG
body:
Man neilo hi bang leel kei nuntak sung, Iplahna them zong neilo bang ah Topa maipha muh nang semzolo pi’n, Hizahta nong it ma’n nuam lua ing.

Tu’n nanga hi ta’ng hong Gumpa aw, Tubansiah nang thu hi ta’ng ka To Zeisu, Bangbang piang ta zong hong phat den ni’ng,  Nang lo-in bang mah tangtun zo ke’ng

Ze-etna namkim in kei hong tuam hang, Lungmuang ta’ng, To Zeisu’n hong do sak, Simmawh thu’n tamvei hong kinelhsiah zong, Gualzo ka To Zeisu min phat ta’ng.

title: NANG TEEK TEEK HONG DEIH
body:
Tulai momno lia le taang, Ih gam a ding nang bang na geel, mawhna kol sung, Gal in don vaw mulkim huai lua, luankhi tawh, Nisim thunget kisam.

Hong it lua veng aw, ih Zogam mialpi sung zong, Banghang tu ciang Zeisu meel a leeng lo, Kua muang na hiam i gam a ding Zeisu in, Nang teekteek hong deih.

Nang nong kihel loh in maw, Hong mial semsem ding ih Zogam maw u leh nau, Dipkuat huai lua tulai ih nuntakna thu, Citak ding hong deih hi.

Gamthak khuavak puak dingin, Nang leh kei ih mawhpuak hi na thei nai maw? Dipkuat huai lua tulai ih nuntakna thu, Citak ding hong deih hi.

title: HALELUJAH TUUNO CI’N
body:
Mi honpite laizang ka ding Topa Minam tuamtuam pau dangdang lakah Si tawh nong tatsa mi ka hi Topa Sihna panin nong hon khia Kam in cin kei, nuam sing cih ding longal Kam in cin kei, phat taak cih longal A hih hang ka aw sangkhan in La ka sa ding hi, ka hih theih zahin.

(Halelujah)3 Tuuno ci’n (Halelujah)2, Na si sung kiptak ka ding Leii teng in nam teng in mi khempeuh in Gam khempeuh in minthang sak ni, Tawisang ciat ni, minphatna pia ni, Pasian Tuuno.

Nong hehpihna sung kiptak ka ding Nong sawp tuuno sisan tawh Ka tate aw cin ko nong sam hi Na mai khukdin thu kong ngen Vangliatna khahkhia’n, ko sung na kasep nang Nang tawh kibang nuamzaw kan lai ing Nam teng in nang hong muh nang Na minthan lak in kong bia ding hi.

Khuk khempeuh khukdin leii teng in Nang Topa hi cin pulak ding Zeisu I Topa hi.

title: A KHA NUAI AH
body:
A kha nuai-ah, lungmuang takin ka om a, Khuamialpha a, huihpi nak nun’hangin, Ka muang thei hi, hong kem ding hi, ka thei hi, Hong tan zo hi, a mata ka hihi.

A kha nuaiah,hong na pan, Kuamah’n hong khen zolo ding , A kha nuaiah keima kha teeng ding ,Lungmuang tak om tawntung ning.

A kha nuaiah, dah ciangin belh dingin pha hi, A mah kiang a tawldamnuam lunggulh ing, Leitungin hong damsak zolo ciangin ah, Tua lai-ah hehnem, lung damna ka ngah.

A kha nuaiah,nopna bangzah tak manpha, Nuntak haksatna beima teng beel ning, Hong liah, hong dal; siatna’n hong sutheilo ding, Zeisu sung khawlleng lungmuan tawntung ning.

title: TUUNO KI LAWM HI
body:
Singlamteh hang nuam sing Leibat nong loh sak nuam sing Zum le dai nong thuak sak hi Kei nong it man lamdang hehpih nong pia.

Hih it na hang nuam sing Aki kilh khut te hang nuam sing Sian thona tuitawh hong sawp hi Hong pomna le hong maisakna tun thei tang.

(Cho) Tuuno kilawm hi to khomtung tu in Lukhu tampi na khu hi Zawh na tawh na maang hi Pasian ta Zeisu pahtawi lam to un Van ngaihno Zeisu kithat lum hi Tuuno kilawm hi, Tuuno kilawm hi.

title: KA LUNG MUANNA JEHOVAH SHALOM
body:
Ih teenna hih leitung tui hual bang kilok thei, Khat veivei, Zeisu ki mangngilh thei. Upna a piang sakpa upna kicing sakpa, Zeisu teltak ih et ding hi zaw.

Mi zong piak ka sawmlo mi aa, zong ka englo, To dang zong ka deihlo Zeisu bek, Ka tuanna tembaw a hoi zongin ka laulo, Ka lungmuanna Jehovah Shalom

Ka teenna leitung in Zeisu bang a ci zongin, Kei aa Zeisu bek mah manpha pen, Amah ka zungpi ka nuntakna naak hi a, Ken nusia thei nawnlo Zeisu

Thupha hong pia thei ding To dang a om zongin, Sihna zo a thokik Zeisu bek, Ama hangin tu’n kei sihna pan ka suakta, Lungnopna kha muanna hong pia.

title: GILGAL AH THA IH LA DING
body:
Canaan gam zuan dingin a pai diamdiam lai un, Ai khua sim ding hong kithawi uh, Joshua lungkham lua in,Topa tung thungen aa, Na khut sung teipi zan in Topa’n ci hi.

Gilgal ah tha ih la dinga, nung kiklo Mi siangte mainawt ni,Kha tha tawh ih do ding a ,Khazih gam zai semsem ding Khazih a ding ih tha saan ciat ni.

Khazih galkapte aw, hong ding khia mengmeng un, Topa’n thu hong ciamkhinzo a,Lauken la, lung kia ken,  Galhiam tawh kithawi un na sikna ciang ciang, Na gam hong pia ning ci.

Tu’n Joshua tekta a, a kum zong tam lua ta, Gal sim ding tamlua Joshua aw, Na gal sim ding tamlua na mite tha pia in, Canaan gam na hawm sak in Topa’n ci hi.

title: VANGNGAIH ANGLAI KA POMTA
body:
Vang ngaih ang lai ka pom ta, San mun muang mun muang sawl bang ka heita Vang ngaih bel ka To Jesu ka neih khit teh Gual in nuih ciam hong lel zong naubang ka heh hong nem pa Hong dam sak pa To Jesu ken nei hi veng.

(Cho) Zai la in ka oih cim lo Va bang in ka laam cim lo Vang ngaih bel ka To Jesu ka neih khit the Zin in gibang hong khen zong Ang lai naubang ka pom sa Vang ngaih Jesu tawh sam bang khen nawn lo ding.

Sim lei ah mi zatam ten ka paal lai zu bang in hong nial zong le Lung mawlken ang lain au bang ka pom cim lo Kua tawh tan bang kong the diam nong it nathuk in sang ee, Sang gah ken na paal ningtui ka dawn cim lo.

Mubang kong ngaihluatman mawka paal lainang ading hong piaing e, Lung mawl ken anglai pai bang kong pom cim lo Hong sang aw ka duang neem ni, ka luan khitui bek mah hi Nang ading kum sawt tang bang hong dam sak aw.

title: VAN KONG KI HONG
body:
Vankong khak ki hong ta Nuntak na tui hong luang khia Luang den ta hen A tawntung in ah, Zeisu tokhom tung pan.

(Cho) Lungnop damna suah takna leh nuntakna, Topa hong piak thupha te, Up na tawh thungen Mi khempeuh tungah, Thupha hong tung ta hen.

Lungnop suah tak na Ka Topa’n hong pia ka sung pan in Nuntakna ciktui hong luang khia

Lungnop damna suah takna leh nuntakna, Topa hong piak thupha te, Up na tawh thungen Mi khempeuh tungah, Thupha hong tung ta hen.(Haleluijah)
Haleluijah Kumpipa minthang hen Haleluijah Pasian Tuuno aw Phat dingin Na ki lawm Kalungsim khempeuh tawh Haleluijah Pasian Tuuno aw

title: HOSANA
body:
(Thanem te’n hat zo cihen A zawng te’n hau zo ci hen Mittaw te’n mu zo ci hen Topa’n kei tung hong sem khin zo)2

(Cho) Hosana Hosan A kigo van tuuno Hosana hosan sih na pan tho kik zo kik hi.

Tua guntui sung kaki bual hi Mawh na teng hong sawp siang hi Hong hon pa it na ciktui Vantung pan hong luang suk hi

Tua guntui thuk sung pan tho in Topa ang ka zuanding hi Hong suak tasak a hih man Hot dam na la ka sa ding

title: LUNGNOP SUAHTAKNA
body: Lungnop suahtakna ka Topa’n hong pia, Ka sung panin Nuntakna ciktui hong luangkhia Lungnop suahtakna ka Topa’n hong pia.   (Cho) (Nuntakna laibu sung ka min kigelh zo)3 Haleluijah

title: LUNGDAM NA TAWH AWNG NI
body:
(Lungdam na tawh phat ziahziah ni, Topa in gualzah na hong pia khin zo hi)2

I lang pang galhiam ten hong zolo ding, I lang pang kumpi gamkip loding, Topa in eite hotkhiatna Suangpi hi Oh! Tuuno' sisan hang,zawhna i ngah zo hi!

title: ZEISU NUNGTA HI
body:
Hallelujah! Zeisu nungta hi, Sihna in zong len zolo,Hankhuk zong kinusia ta, Zeisu a tawntungin Nungta hi, nungta hi.

Amah Alpha le Omega, A patna le a tawpna,Mawhna hamsiatna bei khin, Suahtakna i ngah khin zo,Pasian’ Tuuno tho kik zo Nungta hi, nungta hi,Halelujah, Zeisu nungta hi.

title: BEEL SEEKPA KHUT
body:
A hoih Topa a lamdang Honpa Ka vai khempeuh Nangma khut sungah Om cih thei ing, Nang deih bangin Nong seek ding hi Na omna sung ah damtak Nong kai a Na Kha Siangtho tawh lam Nong lak a Nangma sung ah no semsem nangin Hong hilh in

Siangtho sapna sung Nong tawn sak a, Kei Nong teel hi Nang kiangah hong kai in Hong puah pha’n Topa kong ngen hi Hong seek, hong bawl, hong zang hong dim Beel seekpa khut sung kong ki-ap hi Hong sam hong lak hong len hong tonpih in Beel seekpa khut sung kong ki – ap hi.

title: TOPA NA HOIH HI
body:
Kei hong panpih kei lecin Koi lam ka zuan diam? Zingsang khuavak Bang ci’n tho in ka muak thei diam? Nong hehpihna tawh ka nung pan nong sam sam hi Nang tawh I ki nai hang in Topa kong mu thei kei hi

(Cho) (Topa na hoih)2 (Nong hehpihna a tawntung kip hi)2 (Na migit na kei hong musak in Na hihna bang hong mu sak in)2 Na hih na bang taktak in.

title: NANG NA SIANGTHO HI
body:
Nang na siangtho, siangtho Nang bang omkei Topa,  Nang na siangtho siangtho Na minthang den ta hen!

Minphatna la ka sasa ding, Kong it zaw semsem ding, Kumpi tokhom tawh kinai-na mun ah, Ka om na’ng ka mu hi.

title: HALELUJAH, TOPA MANG HI
body:
(Haleluijah)3 Topa maang hi, (Haleluijah)3 Vanglian Topa maang hi.

A lamdang vangliatnapi tawh A gualzawhna hong lak hi. Khuamial tung leh sihna tungah Gualzo khin Thong kia mite suahtakna pia, Sikkol khempeuh sutat khin Hong hehpihna hang Gupna ngah ta!

title: TOPA MAANG HI
body:
[(Topa maang)3(Leitung lungdam hen)3 Mi khempeuh kipak hen, Topa maang hi.]2

(Cho) Meikuang Ama’ mai ah pai, Gal te khempeuh kangtum khin Topa omna ah (mualte khuainun bang tuisuak)2

A thumaanna vantung in hong lak, A vangliatna mi ten mu Na khempeuh tung Topa Nangmah, (kong laamto uh hi)2

title: MUVANLAI BANG
body:
Hiah nang kong ngak hi Kasung ah hong teng in Topa kong lunggulh luahi Nang sung hong selin Khuk din thu kong ngen Kong thei tel nuam zaw sem sem hi

(Cho) Ka sung teeng in Ka nunna hong zang in Ka leeng to ding Muvan lai bang.

title: KA BANGKIM NANG NAHI
body:
//Zeisu Pasian tuuno, naming manpha hi//

Ka thazawn ciangin ka hatna Ka zonzon hauhna nang nahi Ka bangkim nang nahi Saungmanpha bangin kong zong hi Hong khahsuah leng mihai hi ning Ka bangkim nang nahi

Na lakhia khinzo ka mawhna Na thokik zo na min ka phat Ka bangkim nang na hi Ka puk ciangin nong phong kik hi Ka dangtak ciang tui nong suah hi Ka bangkim nang na hi

title: ZATO MANGPI PA
body:
A siam bel hong damsak theipa Hong it Topa Zeisu hi. Dahna hong nopsak nangin ah, A hong sapna aw ngai in.

Vantung mi a la sakna,Leitung mi pha bel cihna, Sa ni a ngaih mahmah la,Zeisu pha bel min hi.

 Na mawhna a hong phel Topa, A hong sapna aw ngai in. Vantung lam nuam tak zui inla, Zeisu tawh kham lukhu in,

A hingkik Tuuno vanglianpa Zeisu ke’n ka hong um hi. Hong gum Topa na min a pha, A lianbel ka ci ding hi.

Zeisu maitang mu dingin ah, Vantung ka paitoh ciangin, A hong itna tokhom kiangah Phatna lasa tawntung ning.

title: ZEISU-AH DEIHNA TENG CING HI
body:
Zeisu ah deihna teng hi, Hin na, nuam na, van nuai, Nisim-in a mah tha lo-in, Ka puk ding a lau huai, Ka dah ciang a-ma kiang ka pai, Mun dang bang lo ka mai a taai, Ka dah ciang hong nuamsak, A mah- Kei ma lawm.

Zeisu a deihna teng cing hi, Lungkham laitak ka lawm, Thupha deih in amah zuan leng,A ma’n hong pia nawnnawn,  Ni tang le guah tui hong pia hi, Tuk ciangin an hong la sak hi, Nitaang, guahtui, le an hong pia, Kei ma lawm.

Zeisu a deihna teng cing hi, A tung ka thu man ding, Kei tungah hong thuman ka lawm,Bangci ka nial zo ding, A-mah zui leng ka khial ngei kei, Sun le zan hong cing khial ngei kei, Sun le zan in zui-ning a mah, Kei lawm,

Zeisu a deihna teng cing hi,Lawmpha zaw deih tuan keng, Amah tu in ke’n ka muang a,Muang lai ding sih ma teng, Hih bang lawm tawh nuntak a nuam, Bei geilo ding hinna a nuam Bei ngeilo nuntakna nuam na, Kei ma lawm.

title: VAN KONG KIHONG
body:
Van kong kihong ta Nuntakna tui hong luang khia Luang den ta hen A tawntung in ah, Zeisu tokhom tung pan

Lungnop damna, suahtakna leh nuntakna Topa hong piak thuphate, Upna tawh thu ngen Mi khempeuh tungah, Thupha hong tung ta hen

title: PHAT DING NA KILAWM HI TOPA ZEISU
body:
(Phat ding na kilawm hi Topa, Zeisu! Pahtawi ding na kilawm hi Phat ding na kilawm hi Topa Min thanna khempeuh ngah ding)2

(Vangliatna khempeuh Ukzawhna khempeuh A tawntung phat dingin na kilawm hi Vangliatna khempeuh Uk zawhna khempeu A tawntung phat dingin na kilawm hi)2

title: VANGLIAN PASIAN TOPA
body:
Vanglian pasian Topa Na min kong phat den ding hi Vanglian Pasian Topa Na min kong phat den ding hi. Zingsang simin nang kong zong ding Nong thuhilhna bang mangin hong zui ning,

Kal khat khit khat Aman hong kha, Nisim in Topa nung ka zui den ding, Nisim in Topa ka zui den ding, Nisim in Topa nung ka zui den ding, Kal khat khit khat Aman hong kha, Nisim in Topa nung ka zui den ding.

title: ZEISU KONG PHAT UH HI
body:
Zeisu kong phat uh hi Kumpite Kumpipa, Hong kumsuk aw, Hong khawl in Topa,  Na vangliatna kong phat uh hi.

Siangtho biakpiakna kong pia uh, Siangtho biakpiakna kong pia uh, Siangtho biakpiakna kong pia uh, Zeisu kumpi hong kumsuk aw.

title: ZEISU A HOIH PEN TOPA
body:
//Zeisu a hoihpen Topa Zeisu lamdang thulakpa Min khempeuh sangin Min lianzaw kong pia uh hi Ko tawh hong omkhawm lamdang hi//

//Phat ding na kilawm hi Pahtawi dingin Khut siangthote lamto sa in Na min siangtho hong phat ung//

//Nang na lian hi Na bawl nate lamdang hi Nang bang om lo hi Topa Nang bang om lo hi Topa//

title: HONG PIKHIA IN
body:
Sehnel gam sung tui na phul sak, Israel tung na piak bangin, Zogam keu ah nunna tui luangsak aw, Zomite kha dangtak lua in nunna lam pan pialkhinta ung, Na kha siangtho hong sawlkik in aw Topa

Hong pikhia in aw Topa, hong pikhia in, Na tuu huang nuam sungah omkim dingin, Muvanlai tha hong guan in, tai tampi hong tonpih in, Na khalim nuai hong khawlsak in aw Topa

Suangpi panin tui na phulsak, Israelte na dawn sak bang, Zomi kha dangtakte hong dawnsak aw, Isrealte na pi-khia aa, Canaan gam sung na lutpih bang, Na kha siangtho hong lutpih kik aw Topa,

Van anlum leh vamim sa tawh, Israelte na vak bangin, Zomite zong nek le dawn hong pia aw, Nangma sungah nuamsa dingin aneu alian hong huaikim in, Itna Pasian nangbek hong muang ung Topa.

Kei vapai ning mangthangte kiang, Nong gupna thu tangko dingin, Zogam buppi hong khanglo sakkik aw, Laulo hangtak, na thu gen ding, Na kha siangtho hong guankik aw, Mangthangte kiang gupna thu gen ning Topa.

title: TOPA LAPTOH ZOMI TE
body:
Zomi te hong tawi sang in minam lian in hong bawl a, Zomi te thupha hong pia in gual tawh tan bang kim ding in Pilna siam nate nong pia inn leh lo te nong pia aa Topa lap toh Zomi te minam lian aw Zomi te.

(Cho) Hong makaih a hong hilh pa leivui pan hong lam Topa tagah inn pan hong dom to Kumpi inn dong ah hong kha.

Zomi te hong lamto in minam lian in nong bawl a, Zomi te thupha hong pia a gual tawh tan bang kim ding in, Mipil tampi nong pia a, misaim tampi tak nong pia Topa laptoh Zomi te mipil misaim Zomi te.

Zomi te hong makaih in minam lian in nong bawl a, Zomi te thupha hong pia in gual tawh tanbang kim ding in, Mihau tampi nong pia aa, milian tampi zong nong pia, Topa laptoh Zomi te mihau milian Zomi te.

title: ZO LAUKHA PAALLUN DING HI
body:
Mimbang pianna tuan pupate’n, Sin lailung a mawl manin maw, Ton le aih, galthat sa manin, A nunna mual liamsan ta.

Nun bang nuam aw, ih gam lei-ah Namcin Zeisu naubang ih pom ciang, Lungdeih teng liibang cing ding a, Zo laukha hong paallun ding hi.

Tun le zua, lia leh taangte aw, Singdang gam a eng dingin ah, Tung Sianmang in lung awilo ee, Gual tawh kim ding Sian siam hi.

Tung Sianmang naubang a pomte, A paallun tui bang luangluang ding, Sim leimi-lun zatam teng sang, Gual tung tuang vabang pil ding.

title: JUBILEE LA
body:
Heitui vangkhua piankum 100 cinna Jubilee. Tuang hong tungta seino gual ngaih aw.

(Cho) Kum 100 cinna (cinna) Jubilee ah (hongpai) Hongpai un lungdam khawmni, nuam in Topa phatkhawm ni. Phamsa tun leh zua ciin le tuai aw, zuang hong tho ve un, Kum 100 pawi ah hong paiciat un Laambang pakkhawm ve ni ee, Tuan pupa leh tongdot te sinlai vabang phawngsak cia, Khangsawn momno te’n huan tubing ciinding aw.

Kum 100 cinna tun mualsuang kiphut zo ta ee, Khangsawn noten tuubang ciin na ding.

Khangsawn momno te vabang pil in siam ciat ni, Pi le pu ten mabang hong patsak.

title: SECOND DAVID
body:
Second David kha galdo ding tangbang dam in nong tungta maw. Heitui vangkhua khimzinna gamah, khimbang a zing heitui Vangkhua nibang a taan theih nading in, sepna khempeuh Topa minthan na hita hen!

(Cho) Second David kha galdo khitui gospel te aw, Heitui vangkhua ko ading in tuang nong tungta uh maw, Tangbang dam in sepna khempeuh Topa gualzawhna hita hen, Sepna khempeuh Topa minthanna hita hen!

Kha galdo ding galkap te aw tangbang dam in nong tungta maw, Heitui vangkhua khimzinna gamah, khimbang a zing heitui Vangkhua nibang a taan theih nadingin, sepna khempeuh Topa minthanna hita hen!

Khitui gospel gospel te aw tangbang damin nong tungta maw, Heitui vangkhua khimzinna gam ah, khimbang a zing heitui Vangkhua nibang a taan theih nadingin, sepna khempeuh Topa minthanna hita hen!

title: KUMLUI MANGPHA
body:
Hih leitung nuntakna sungah, A haksa nuntakna sungah Ka kha Topan hong kem kei leh A mangthang ding tumah in zong.

(Cho) Kum ten hong khengta, nang nakikhel maw A beisa sung na mawhna te lungngai in, A thak kum sungah hong kem lai lai in, Hong tung ding kumthak ah ni taang pha hong tan aw.

A ni hong bei a kha hong bei Kum ten hong kheng diai diai ta a, Hong tung ding a thak kum sung ah, Bang hun hong hi ding kithei lo.

Len un, len un a nuam kumlui Tu mah in hong paisan ding hi Mi khempeuh a ding a it huai Kumlui aw hong paisan dingmaw.

title: LEITUNG LUNGDAM, TOPA HONGPAI
body:
Leitung lungdam, Topa hong pai, Kumpi za ngah ding hi. Lungsim kheempeuh bawl phat sak hi. Van leh lei la sak ngai, Van leh lei la sak ngai Van leh, van leh lei la sak ngai.

Verse 2 Leitung nuam na’ng Zeisu maang hi. Mihingte’n la sa hen. Lo lai, tuipi, suangpi, mualpi’n Kidem in ham uh hen, Kidem in ham uh hen Kidem, kidem in ham uh hen.

Verse 3 Nung ciang mawhna a khan’loh na’ng Ling in bawlsia lo ding A pha lo na a pha bel in Bawlpha ding hong pai ding, Bawlpha ding hong pai ding, Bawlpha, bawlpha ding hong pai ding.

Verse 4 Hong hehpihna thupha bel in, Leitung hong uk ding hi. A minthang siangtho hong itna Mi kheempeuh thei sak hi, Mi kheempeuh thei sak hi Mi khem, mi kheempeuh thei sak hi.

title: GUPKHIAT KA HIH NUNG SANG
body:
Ke’n nei khin tang ka saknop la, Gupkhiat ka hih nung sang, Kumpi, Honpa phatna la, Gupkhiat ka hih nung sang.

Gupkhiat ka hih nung sangGupkhiat ka hih nung sang, Ama min tawh vanglian ningGupkhiat ka hih nung sang, Ka Honpa’ min in ka vanglian ding

Ke’n nei hong lungkimsak Khazih, Gupkhiat ka hih nung sang. Ama deih bek ka bawl ding hi, Gupkhiat ka hih nung sang.

Ke’n nei kitel teci panna, Gupkhiat ka hih nung sang, Beisak launa leh up lahna, Gupkhiat ka hih nung sang.

Ke’n nei kei a ding inn muanpi, Gupkhiat ka hih nung sang, Tua’h atawntung ka um ding hi. Gupkhiat ka hih nung sang.

title: I NGAK LAITAK HONG TUAK DIAM
body:
Topa Zeisu nuamna hong pia dingin, Sunkim zankim hong pai leh, Lungsim dikin meivak a baihsa in, I ngak laitak hong tuak diam.

Ute naute, I kigingciatzo hiam? I kha inn nuam lutna ding,  Nangmah leh kei kigingsa’n hong mu diam?  Ngak in, Topa hong pai ding ngak in.

Zingsang khat peuh phalvak tung pan laitak, Khat khat in hong sam pak leh, Hong kepsak talen I piakkik laitak, Pha hi, nang hong ci-na diam?

Hong vaikhakna bangin i hih zo leh, I siamnazah sit kei leng. I lungsim kisuanna a om kei leh, Nopnapha I ngah ding hi.

A ngak zote in thupha ngah ding hi, Vangtung khua-ah maangkhawm ding, Sunkim zankim a hong pai kha ding hi, I ngak laitak hong tuak diam?

title: VANTUNGAH MI HONG SAP LAITAK
body:
Topa Zeisu hong paikik ciang vantung pengkulaw za a Zingtung khuavak tawntung nuamtak taang ding hi. Kiphelna ngah mihingte inGungal hong kikhop ciangin, Min hong sap laitak keimah zong om ding hi’ng.

(Vantungah, min hong sak laitak)3 Min hong sap laitakKeimah zong om ding hing.

Zingtung meiikai omlo khuavak Zeisu mintawh sitho a Topa tawh nungtakik a nuam sung tum hi. Sihna a ngah mihingte in vantung inn ah tum ciangin, Min hong sap laitak keimah zong om ding hi’ng.

Topa a na hong semsak a zing nitum dong matengin, Kidopna tawh ama itna gensak ni. Leitung sihna hun hong kheng ding hi, Nasep natang zo in, Min hong sap laitak keimah zong om ding hi’ng.

title: GAM MINTHANG HONG PIANG DINGHI
body:
Vantungah gam a minthang bel eite aa dingin om hi, Kum simin mi siangthote ki khawm uh hi, Gam minthang tawh kinai theih nang in-ni in hongkheng hi, Gam minthang hong piang ding hun hong tungdek tak hi.

(Gammin thang hong piang a hun tung dek tak hi)2 Ki-sa khol-in, ka kha aw,Sawt lo pengkul tum ding hi, kumpipaMinthang tawh hong pai ding hi.

Topa bawlsa vantung a gam minthang phuallungngaih na in. Hong gum Topa hong pai ding hun ding i ngak hi, I thang-awkna hih leitung koltanna sun ah hong phel hi, Gam minthang piang ding hun tung dek tak hi.

Sawtvei I ngak ciangin hih leitungah lungkhamna tam hi, Meeikai manin mihing lungsim kisia hi, Gam min than’n thugen inla,la pha sa in hansuah in, Gam minthang hong piang ding hun hong tung dek tak hi.

title: KHAZIN GALKAPTE’N AH
body:
Khazih galkapte’n galsim ding kuan un, Eite ma a masa Zeisu mitsuan un, Khazih eite maamgpa makai hilo maw, En un a dial paina galphual lam manawh.

Khazih galkapte’n ah gal kap ding kuan un, Singlamteh pua unla na mailam nawt un.

Zeisu min a zak ciang dawi’mite tai uh,  Nawt un tua ahih ciang na mualsuah dong un ,Phatna aw kizak ciang dawi’gam kiling hi. Lawmte tua ahih ciang awng un phatna pi.

Galkap honpi bangin pawlpi’n masot hi, Tang misiangte bangin I totna khat hi. Eite kikhenlo in pumkhat bek I hi. Lawp le zuih kikhat in hong ki-it sak hi.

Kumpi’za siathei hi, kumpi’gam kip kei, Hih hang Zeisu’ pawlpi cik mah’n siathei kei, Dawi in Pasian’ pawlpi cikciang zongei kei, Khazih hong ciamsa hi, a ciampeel ngei kei.

Tua hi a, hong pawm un, mi khempeuh in ah, Ko tawh hong sakhawm un, galzawh nuamna la, A minthang pahtawi un leitung vangtungah, Tatsatlo in phat un Khazih kumpipa.

title: TOPA SUNGAH THAHAT UN
body:
Topa leh a vangliatna sungah thahat un, Ama thuman sungah kiptak dingun, Gal kidona sungah ama’n lam hong kai ding, Topa min tawh nang na gualzo ding hi.

Thuman in…kiptak ding… Kumpipa thupiakna tawh zawh dong, Topa minthanna ding lehAma thu gualzawhna ding, Topa thahatna sungah kiptak ding.

Topa leh a vangliatna sungah thahat un, Galte mai panin kihei ngei kei un. Thuman galsim laitak amah na kiang ding ding, Ama vangliatna sungah mainawt un.

Topa leh a vangliatna sungah thahat un, Ama thuciamnate pelngeilo ding. Thuman galsim laitak na taklam khut len ding, Amah muangin na gualzo tawntung ding.

title: AKSI TAANG A OM DIAM
body:
Tuni in ah tuagam nuam ken ka ngaihsun hi Nitum ciangin ah ka tung ding hi Hehpihna tawh Honpa kiang kadin ciangin ah Ka lu tung aksi taang a m diam

Ka lutung aksi taang aksi taang a om diam Nitak a ni a tum ciangin ah Tawkdamna inn sungah ka khanlawh ciangin ah Ka lutung aksi taang a om diam

Topa hatna sungah nasemin thungen ding Ka ngah mi bang kei homh hisak in Minthan ni’n aksi taang kei ading hi kha ding Amah phatna tuihual bang om ciang

Ama mai ka et ciang, bangzah in lungdam ding A khephung ah suang manpha koih ding Khma khuapi sungah lungdamna hong khangsak ding Ka lutung aksi taang a om diam

title: OMNA OM LAI HI
body:
Tuni in ah tuagam nuam ken ka ngaihsun hi Nitum ciangin ah ka tung ding hi Hehpihna tawh Honpa kiang kadin ciangin ah Ka lu tung aksi taang a m diam

Ka lutung aksi taang aksi taang a om diam Nitak a ni a tum ciangin ah Tawkdamna inn sungah ka khanlawh ciangin ah Ka lutung aksi taang a om diam

Topa hatna sungah nasemin thungen ding Ka ngah mi bang kei homh hisak in Minthan ni’n aksi taang kei ading hi khOmna om lai , Tuuno innpi sungah, A vanglianpi tawh nang hong samta hi .Tum in, tu in tum in, omna om lai.

 Nitang beidekzo, ni-in liapta hi, Hong liapta hi manlangin ah pai in, Omna om lai, tum in tu in tum in.

Mopina pawi sung zin a khoplai in, Hong sapmi nahih leh tum in tum in, Omna om lai, tum in tu in tum in.

Dimkhindek hi, lungdamna inn sungah, Manlang a na lut leh ngahlai ding hi Omna om lai, tum in tu in tum in.

Omna om lai, kong kihon laitak hi, Pai in tum lecin na laplai ding hi. Omna omlai, tum in tu in tum in.

Tum in tum in tua pawi nang a ding hi, Ki-it tawntungna hai kidawn ding hi. Tum in, tu in tum in, omna om lai.a ding Amah phatna tuihual bang om ciang

Ama mai ka et ciang, bangzah in lungdam ding A khephung ah suang manpha koih ding Khma khuapi sungah lungdamna hong khangsak ding Ka lutung aksi taang a om diam

title: MAWH NEITE ZEISU’N NGAI HI
body:
Mawh neite Zeisu’n ngai hi, Hih thupha na thangsak un, Vantung lamkhial a puk mi, Lunghei nei mi va hilh un.

Sa sa un, sa kikkik un, Mawh neite Zeisu’n ngai hi Hih thu teltak tangko un, Mawh neite Zeisu’n ngai hi.

Hong pai-in hong damsak ding Na muangin a thutak hi. A siabel pen zong sang ding, Mawh neite Zeisu’n ngai hi.

Tu’n sin sung kisuang nawnlo, Thukham mai-ah ka saingta, Amah’n hong siangsak khinzo, Thukham kalhna cin’ khinta.

Mawh neite Zeisu’n ngai hi, Kei nangawn a mawhpi mah, Vantungah hong lutpih hi. Mawhna teng siangta in ah.

title: SINGLAMTEH GALKAP KAHI HIAM
body:
Singlamteh galkap ka hi hiam Topa nungzui hi hiam Ama nasep nading inah Ka maizum thei ding hiam

Kei tang ding asi mipa A minpha tawh ka do ding Singlamteh ka puak hang in ah Zawhna lukhu ngah ding

Midangten nopna ngah dingin Sih dongin a do hi Paak tawh kibawl lupna tungah Van a kipua ding hiam

Gal do ding galte a om hiam Tul luan na thuak ding hiam Leitung gitlohna in Pasian Kiang hong paipih ding hiam

Mang ding inah ka kido nang Hong hang sakin Topa Nangmah thupha’n honghuh ta in Gimna ka thuak ciangin

title: KAH HANG HONG GUM ZO LO
body:
Kah hang hong gum zolo Khitui in ka mai sawp zong Ka launa daisak tuamlo, Mawhna kum sawpsiang theilo, Kah hang hong gum zolo.

(Cho) Zeisu kap keitang ding si, Singkhuam tungah khaina thuak, Kei hong hon dingin hong ngak A mah bek hong hon thei.

Sep hang hong gum zolo, A hoih pen ka sem thei zong A siang pen ka ngaihsun zong, Ka kha thak suaksak thei kei, Sep hang hong gum zolo.

Ngak hang hong gum zolo, Huh theihloh mawhna nei zong Ka bil sung hehpih’n hong sam, Ngak lai leng ka si ding hi Ngak hang hong gum zolo.

Khazih up na’n hong gum Hong umsak in na Tapa A bawlsa nate um in A khut in kei hong pom ding, Khazih upna’n honggum.

title: MAWHNA ZOL ZUI KEI IN
body:
Mawhna zol zuikei in, na zuihleh khial ding Khatvei zo phot lecin, a zom zawhnop ding Pasal nakpi’n do in, lunggulhna mialpi Zeisu en gige in, hong zawhpih ding hi

Hong huh nading thungen in Tha hong pia hong kem ding hi Hong huhnuam hi Topa in A hong zawhpih ding hi

Kholhpihj gilo peel in, kam hoihlo zang ken Pasian’ min zahtak in, a mawknan zang ken thukhual in citak in, thumaan in migi Zeisu en gige in, hong zawhpih ding hi

A zote Pasian in , kham lukhu pia ding I puk khazel hangin, upna tawh zo ding Eite hong honpa in , tha hong guan ding hi Zeisu en gige in, hong zawhpih ding hi

title: I LUNGNUAM HI, ZEISU MUANG LENG
body:
I lungnuam hi, Zeisu muang leng, Ama hong gen bang um leng ,Ama hong thuciamna muang leng, Topa’ hong cihna thei leng.

Zeisu, Zeisu ke’n ka muang hi, A muanhuai na thei zo ing. Zeisu, Zeisu manpha Zeisu, Amah muang semsem nuam ing.

I lungnuam hi, Zeisu muang leng, Hong sapna a si muang leng, Hong dam hong siang sakthei a si, Sungah upna tawh bual leng,

I lungnuam hi, Zeisu muang leng, Mawhna pumpi nusia leng, Nuntak lungnop tawldam nuamna, Zeisu khut tung pan sang leng.

Zeisu kong muanthei ka nuam hi, A manpha lawmpa na hi, Hong honpa aw a tawp dongin, Nong ompih ding ka thei hi.

title: SIAN’THO NA’NG HUN ZANG IN
body:
Sian’tho na’ng hun zang in, Thungen zelzel in, Ama sungah om in, Athu’n kivak in, Pasian’ tate pawl in, a nangte huh in, Na khat na hih ciangin, dongkhial ngei kei in.

Sian’tho na’ng hun zangin, mi a kin zongin, Zeisu bek tawh om in, hun tampi zangin, Amah nasut na’ngin, etteh tawntung in, Ama lim langsak in, nang’ tatna pan in.

Sian’tho na’ng hun zangin, hong pi-na zui –in, Amai ah tai kei-in, bang aci zongin, Na nuam na dah zongin, Topa mah zui-in, Zeisu en tawntungin, ama thu muang in.

Sian’tho na’ng hun zangin, lung hi dide in,  Ngaihsut a namkim in, amah uksak in, Kha siangtho tua bangin, ki kaisak le cin. Vantung naseem dingin, siam ding sawtlo in.

title: NANG TAWI NAIZAW NUAM ING
body:
Nang tawh naizaw nuam ing, ka Pasian aw, Singlamteh thuak ta leng, hong domto aw, Thuak hang ka sasa ding, Nang tawh naizaw nuam ing. Nang tawh naizaw nuam ing, ka Pasian aw.

Zakoh bang ka vaka, nitum ta hang, Khuamial a suangtum bek, ka lukham hang, Ka maang hong nainuam ing, Nang tawh naizaw nuam ing, Nang tawh naizaw nuam ing, ka Pasian aw.

 Na mai-ah hong lak in, vantung lampi, Nong ngahsak khempeuhte, hehpihna hi, Vantung mi hongs am ding, Nang tawh naizaw nuam ing,  Nang tawh naizaw nuam ing, ka Pasian aw.

 Nangma min phatna tawh, ka khanglo ding, KA dahna teng Pasian, phatna’n nei ning, Tua bangin dahna hang, Nang tawh kizaizaw na’ng,  Nang tawh kinaizaw na’ng, ka Pasian aw

title: I MAWH NA LEH I DAHNA TENG
body:
I mawh na leh I dahna teng, A pua ding Zeisu I lawm Pasian kiang I sapna teng Thum theih na’ng thupha a om Lungnopna tampi I tan a, Thuak loh ding pi I thuak hi, Na khempeuh te Pasian kiangah,T hum in I kohl oh hang hi.

Ze-et bawlsiat ahi zongin, Lung khamna khat peuh om maw. Cik mah ciang lungkia ngei-lo in, Topa kiang ah ko in aw, Dah teng thuakpih nuam Zeisu bang, Lawm man dang muzo ding maw, Zeisu’n thei khin I sap bangbang, Ama kiangah ko in aw,

Lung khamna vangik bang lel in, Zawng khal in na tha nem maw, Manpha honpa I belh hi in, Ama kiangah thu ngen in aw, Min hong sim mawh hong huat ciangin, Zeisu kiang I pai ding hi, A ang sung hong pom hong dal in Lungnopna hong pia ding hi.

title: NANG KONG DEIH TAAWNTUNG HI
body:
Nang kong deih tawntung hi, Migi ka To, Lungnopna hong pia thei, A dang omlo

 Kong deih hi, Nang kong deih hi,  Nang kong deih tawntung hi, Thupha hong pia’n Topa aw, Nang kong zuan hi.

 Nang kong deih tawntung hi, Nai tak kei kiang, Ze-etna’n hong zolo, nang hong nai ciang

Nang kong deih tawntung hi, Nuam leng dah leng,  Nuntakna’n man neikei, Nang hong taan leng.

 Nang kong deih tawntung hi. Hong thu hilh in, Nong khapsa aphate, Hong ngah sakin

Nang kong deih tawntung hi, Siangpen pa aw, Nang a tak hong hi-ning, Tapa pha aw.

title: TOPA THU UPNA
body:
Topa thu ki ciamna thei a Upkhialhna ka pia ding hi. Lungkiatnathuak loh na’ng in-ah A thupha ka um ding hi.

(Cho) //A kicing hi, a thupha pi Keimah in-ah ka um hi.//

Verse 2 Ki mawhsakna Zeisu in-ah A si pha tawh hong sawp hi. Keimah hong siangtho zo ta. Innpi ah hong kha ding hi.

Verse 3 Topa Zeisu hong hehpih man Kihtak lau-na om lo hi. Ka lampi ah khua a mial hang Khuavak hong taangsak ding hi.

Verse 4 Ka nuamna teng Zeisu ka pia Amah bek ke’n ka deih hi. Amah in leitung teng uk a Deihna teng A kiang om hi.

Verse 5 Ka vekpi in Zeisu ka pia Ka lungsim ka pum khempeuh. Ka lametna a om khempeuh Tawntung Ama kiang om hi.

title: LAM TAWNTUNG AH HONG PAIPIH HI
body:
Lam tawntung a hong paipih hi,A dang bang ka ngen nawn diam? Khan tawntung lam hong hilhzo hi,Hong itna ka muangkhial diam. Amah muang leng leitungah zong,Vantung nopna pha ka nei, (Kei tungah bangbang hong tung zong,Zeisu’n a pha bawl ka thei)2

Lam tawntung a hong paipih hi,Lam haksa hang lungnuam sak, Ze-etna zawhnain hong hehpih,Hinna anlum in hong vak, Amah muang leng leitungah zong,Vantung nopna pha ka nei. (Ka mai-ah suangpi pan hong phul,En un lungdamna tuinak)2

Lam tawntung a hong paipih hi,Kicing lamdang hong itna, Tawl damna tak hong khamzo hi,Vantung ka Pa inn sungah, Sih nawnlohna puan bang silh in,A tang gam ka kai ding hi. (Tua ciang sa ning a tawntung in,Zeisu’n hong kha mual suak hi.)2

title: MUANG UN LA NGAI UN
body:
1.Thupha khuavak sungah Zeisu tawh pai lai ah, Eite paina lamhong taang sak hi. A deih bang zuih ciang in Amah tawh pai khawm in A thungai a muang a om ding hi.

(Cho) Muang un, ngai un. Lampi dang omlo hi. Zeisu kiang nuam ngah ding in Muang in a thu ngai un.

Van a gik te pua a, Gimna tawlna thuakna Topa hong hehpihna ki cing hi. Eite launa dinga Dawimangpa hong khem na, Zeisu thu ngai in muang leng bei hi.

Ni liim ahihhangin, Meiikai ahihhangin, Zeisu in tha khat a hawl khia hi. Launa leh kihtakna Tau-na leh kahna te Zeisu I muan’ lai in om thei kei.

Ki-itna pha tawh mah Topa Zeisu mai-ah Kikhawm ciangin lampai khawm ding hi. Thu hong piakna ngai a, hong sawlna pai dinga, Cikmah hun lau lo in nuam ding hi.

title: AMAN KA MAWHNA TENG LAKHIA
body:
Lungsim leh aw in Topa phat ning, Ama sung ka kipaak ding, La in sa ning lamdang hong itna, Ken sasa ning hih la,

Aman ka mawhna teng lakhia zo, Amin siang phat un, amin siang phat un, A man ka mawhna teng lakhia zo, Halelui-ah min phat un

Nopna khawlna ngah ding ama kiang, Ka mawhna tawh ka pai ciang Ka nget hong za in hong khahkhia ta, Ken sasa ning hih la,

Ka hu tawpna tawh amah phat ning, Sihna ka zawh man in ah, Amah phat ning a tawntung in ah, Ken sasa ning hih la,

title: THUPHA GUAH BANG HONG ZU DING HI
body:
Thupha guah bang hong zu ding hi, Itna tawh hong ciam bang- in, Thamalh na hun hong tung ding hi, Hong puak suk ding Topa in.

Thupha guah zu bang, Thupha guah ih ki sam hi, Heh-pihna mal hong kiat teei hang, Hong zu suk hen a tampi.

Thupha guah bang hong zu ding hi, Thahak kik- na a manpha, Hong ging zuazua ding hi tam-pi, Mualtung, guamsung, mun tengah.

Thupha guah bang hong zu ding hi, Hong buak suk in Topa aw, Thathak tu in Nong guan ding hi,  Nong ciamsa hong tung sak aw.

Thupha guah bang hong zu ding hi, Tu ni’n hong zu ta leh maw, Zeisu kiangah thu ih gen hi, Pulak in Pa kiang ih mawh.

title: ANN LA TE KAWH OM
body:
Mawhna lo lai a, a hoih teng buh lom, A kai khawm ding an la te koi ah om, Na sepna dingin thumaan phiaukawi keng, Kua mah khawl lo ding an lak khit ma teng

An la te kawh om, kua hong kuan nuam, An lak pawi sungah, kua hong lungdam khawmnuam, Kuan hong khoppih ding, buhlom hoih teng, Mawhna lo sungah om buhlom teng

Zawineu zong zui in zongin pha takpi, Lopa asau hang buh om thei ding hi, Lamlian zong zui-in la nusiat nei ken Vantung innpi sung hong tumkhin uh hen

Lo teng khempeuh ah an min khinta hi, Leitung khempeuh in lak ding bek ngak hi, Ahih hang a la ding tawm lak ding tam, La mengmeng kei leng lah a sia ding tam.

Tua ahih ciang hong pai un phiaukawi tawh, An pha kai khawm un no mihing te aw, An nei Topa hong pai ma teng sem un, Tua ciang an lak pawi ah lungdam khawm un.

title: KHAICI MANPHA VAWH UN
body:
Khaici manpha vawhun,Zingsang phalvak kipat tungin, Khaici manpha vawh un, sun khuaphat laitak, Khaici manpha vawh un,Khangno lungsim zepna dingin, Khaici manpha vawh un, dawm in lungduai tak.

(Khaici manpha vawh un,)2 Gamla nai-ah vawh un, lungdaui itna khut tawh, Nuntak khomun balnen,Lungdamna tangthu genta un ,Khaici manpha vawh un, I it gam sungah.

Khaici manpha vawh un, ni akai laitak inah zong, Khaici manpha vawh un, khuamuina nungah, Khaici manpha vawh un, phunlo,Um lahlo in om un, A vekpi’n Pasian ap in amah muang un.

Khaici manpha vawh un,Lawpna leh hanciamna tak tawh, Khaici manpha vawh un, kham khaici manpha, Khaici manpha vawh un,Khutte tha zawsak ngeilo in, Pasian in ni le guah puak ding thungen un

title: SIHNA GUNGAL KHATAH
body:
Zeisu si in hong sawp siang hi. I khawm ding sihna gungal ah,  Natna hong tun’ kik ding nailo  Nuamna thu kikum in om ni. Sihna gungal khatah

Sihna gungal khatah, sihna gungal khatah, Sihna gungal khatah I tung ding hong nai ta.  I tung ding hong naita,I tung ding hong nai ta,  I tung ding hon nai ta sihna gungal khatah

Dah na hong tun’ ding ka laulo Upna’n ka mu vantung ka en. Ka za hi vantung mi’lasa Khitui khempeuh Topa’n nulkhin. Sihna gungal khat-ah

A itte tawh kikhop nuamna Bang aw ka za ding hiam tua’ah Ka lungsim hong vut hong tho sak Na dang deihna tua mun mang sak Sihna gungal khatah.

Topa hong hilh bang ka zuihna Lungdam ka ngah a kicin’na Khawl ngeilo in ka phat ding hi. Khitui khempeuh hong nulsak hi. Sihna gungal khat-ah

title: VANTUNG KHUA OM DING HI
body: Vantung vaanglian hehpihna gamMi siangthote inn a hi.Ama kiangah om tawntung ni.Leitung na kheempeuh paai ni.Leitung ni a bei ciangin ah Nung ciangin inn nuamahMi siangthote om na lamahVantung khua om ding hi.Tawn tung inn nuam vaanglian gamahI lawmte tua gam om dingTua inn nuam sungah om dinginMi namcin a khawm ding hi.Hong gupna si-pha vaanglianpiHehpihna gam teng zel sakHih gal gamah I om lai inHong hehpihna thugen in.Khat tang hih hang pai in gen ni,Leitung dahna kiam ding hi.Lungsim deih teng tawntung omnaKim takin a om dinghi

title: NI TAMPI KHENG ZOTA HI
body:
A lungmangte hong hehpih in, Ni tampi kheng zota hi. Gimna lungkhamna thuak na-in, Ni tampi kheng zota hi. Khulazinna le kikal a, nuamna lungdamna te tawh, Thu apha ka bawl uh maw, Ni tampi kheng zota hi.

 Ni tampi kheng zo hi, Ni tampi kheng zo hi, Thupha gamtat theihna ding, Ni tampi kheng zota hi.

Mawkna in a hun beisak ke’n,  Ni tampi kheng zota hi. Na mai zingsang khuavak bang hen, Ni tampi kheng zota hi. Leitungah dahna sungah, Lungkhamna kahna om,  Na unaute phong inla, Ni tampi kheng zota hi.

Itna tawh a kikhih khempeuh, Ni tampi kheng zota hi. Eite in i nusia ta hi, Ni tampi kheng zota hi. Khaici pha kituh khempeuh, A vakpha a lim nuai ah, Hong pi a i lungdamna, ni tampi kheng zota hi.

title: SIKTUKILH HILO, HONG ITNA
body:
Ka nuntakna nak Zeisu Topa hi, Ka sapna khempeuh hong sik hong guan hi. Ka sap pen laitak kei a ding hong si, Ka sapna khempeuh kicing sak hi.

Singlamteh tungah kikhen, Bangin len bangin kilhcip, Siktukilh a I diam? Siktukilh hilo, Hong itna hi zen veh, Hih thu ke’n bang tawh ka tehthei diam!

Mawhna koi ah om? Pasian lungtang ah, Itna koi ah om? Pasian lungtang ah, Pasian lungtang tui bang hong sawpsiang ta, Itna in mawhna lohkhinzo ta.

Lainatna in kai, hamsiatna singah, Mawhna’n ling bang sun itna lungtang ah, Zeisu mawhna lom kisuaksak khinta, Hong mawhsakpa’n hong diksak zo ta.

Hong itna lian sa’ng hong ngaihna sang sa’ng, Lei le van a kihal bangin kidang, Bang ka suak zentam, hong itlo hi leh, Ka khitui khempeuh in cin’ ken teh.

title: LEI PIANMA PEK IN
body:
Ka sungah sisan lum a luan lai teng in, Ka nuntakna hu a bei ma in, Man neilo kei bang lel,Hong teel manin nuam lua ing. A migitna gengen ning

Lei pianma pek na ngawn in kei hong teel, Hong ciamteh zo, luah khawmzo ta ka hi ta tu’n, Kha siangtho hong guan,A taak kelkel sisan te’n Van khamkhuapi nuam hong lutpih ta.

Paubanna neilo in mi siangtho bangin, Hong seh kholkhinzo, ama mi dingin, Ama lim le meel sun dingin hong ciamteh zo a, Pasian innkuan ka hi ta.

Keima mi ahilo, keima mi dingin, Ka itloh mite ka itmi dingin, Keima mi hi kei uhteh ke’n kong cihsa hi napi’n “Tate aw” kong ci ding hi.

Tui duh dangtak in vul, ka om laitak in, Sehnel gam keu ah, ka zin lai in, Sun nisa lel in kun, ka om lai aw neem ka za,  Nuntakna tui ka dawn ta.

title: HONG PAAL SAK AW
body:
Topa nagam le na min a ding hong tawi in, Namte tungah hong tawisang in, Zogam le Zomite hong laamto in, Na min a ding hong laamto in.

Israel mite napi bangin,Pa aw, ka nuntakna hong pi aw, Sehnel gam Rose paak bangin,Ka nuntak lai ni, Hong paalsak aw, hong paalsak aw,

Zogam lei aw, khanglo in thasan in hat in, Kum thak nino hong suak en in, Gamkeu gawtaak hong niim ding, Singcin hong paal ding,Upna khuam bang khosak ta in.

Bah leh gui a om khutte hong laamto in, A zaw khutte hong khauhsak in, Muvanlai tha hong guan in, na na sem dingin, Kawlgam sung le leimong dongin.

title: HEHNEM SIAM ZEISU
body:
Lungzuan dahna tenDai bang hong nawk ciang in ah, Hehnem siampa Jesu ngaihsun inA man hong en pah a, damna sung hong tunpihA khasung zatui tawh tongdam nem hong luan.

(Cho) Hong liah hong dal ding amah hong kikham, Topa kha nang kiang hong om tawntungLungsung siktui bangnem, Lungzuang kha hong khoi dam Hehnem siampa Zeisu a ang sung hong sung.

Haksatna khat peuhpeuhNa thuak khak tak ciang in, Lungdam ko in amah phat zaw in, Lungdam ki niamkhiat in amah zuan peuh lecin, Nopsak theih na lungsim hong piaksa hi khin.

It le ngaih ten hong paisan hong nusiat ciang in, Dah teng thuakpih nuam Jesu I lawmHong theisiam mahmah a, Jesu ko peuh lecin,Khamuanna le nopna tui bang hong luang khawm.

title: NA ZIATLAM KHUT TAWH
body:
A hoihna a vangliatna gen zawh hilo, Amuanhuai bel Topa, Hunte kikhel in a kisiat hang, Cik mah hun na kikhel ngei kei

Leitung maingat in Amah thudon kei zong Hong itna kip lai zen. Nau bangin nong kepna lianlua e, Lungdam in Topa kong phat hi.

 Na ziatlam khut tawhKeimah nong makaih a, gun gal khat ah,Haksatna guampi gal khat dong ah, Na ciangkhut in keimah lam nong lah manin, A bei theilo a thak itna tawh kei nong it a, A tul theilo na hehpihna lian kong phat hi.

 Na sung ka nuntak a kipan tu ciang dong, Awnsuk in an nong pia, Lungsim kha laulo in ka han na’ng, Nong pua hi, na liangko tungah

Ka lungsim tawng a ka ngaihsut khempeuhte Sitlo in nong pia a, Ka mailam ding nong gelsak khempeuhte, A sia omlo hoihna bek hi.

title: A THUPI PEN
body:
Vanglian thuneihna, Kumpi hihna Pianpih nate le mihing bawltawm nate, Pilna le theih nate sang a thupipen in Lei pian ma’n nang na om khin zo hi.

Kumpi gam luahna kumpi tokhom Leitung in a thuak ngei langdang sakna te Hauhna nopsak nate sang a thupi pen in Na man zah ding kiseh zolo hi.

(Cho) Hong kithat suang lak hong kivui, Siding nong pai, nang bek hong ki pampaih, Lingpaak bang hong kituan cil hi Kei nong it man leilak kia sa nong tawm hi.

title: VANTUNG TENGAH
body:
Siangtho siangtho ka Topa Leitung teng na min than kizeel hi Minam khempeuh in na min Hong pahtawi hong phat ta hen Nungta cih theih na’ng in Na maitang ko hong lak in.

(Cho) In Pasian in hoih hi ci’n Vantung ah kiphat hi Leitung buppi in zong Hallelujah ci’n lasa ding

title: A TAWN TUNG
body:
Ka nuntakna nong kem den hi Phalbi, khuakhal, tuk hun sung Na khut tawh nong huai hi, Thumanna ah kei nong kha hi, Nang kong lam en hi Nang kong ngak den hi.

(Cho) Nong itna la in kasa ding Kei tungah nong muanhuai hi Na ang sungah kei nong pom den hi Nong khah ngei kei ding hi, a tawn tung (Hallelujah)4

title: HONG NAI SAK IN
body:
Hong kinai sak in, hong khahsuah ngei ken Ki niamkhiat na tawh kong zuan Na lawmpa ka hi, nong ci hi

Nang kong lunggulh hi, kua ma’n hih kenteh Na mun kuama’n luah thei kenteh, Nong kawina an glum ka phawk hi Lam hong musak in, kei hong pi kik in.

Sap teng cinna, deih teng kimna Nang na hi, sap teng cinna Nong naih hong theisak in.

title: OM HITHIAT NING
body: Na kha nuai kei hong seel in,Hong huai in, avangliat na khut tawhTuipi hong khangin van hong gin ciangLauhuai huihpi kheng, I lengkhawm dingDahna tuihual te tung thuneipaPasian kong neih man in om hithiat ningKhris sung bekah ka tawldam hi,A vangliat ka theih teh ka maung hi.

title: TOPAN HONG SEM DING HI
body:
Topa’n hong sem ding,  Lametna teng bei ciangin, Telzawhloh Ama zia tawh, Topa’n kei hong hilh ding hi. Lam hong lak ding hi, Amah’n hong ompih den ding, Itna leh hehpihna tawh, A nisim inah, lam hong pi den ding.

Sehnel gamah kei hong tonpih in lam hong lak Sehnel gam sung ciktui ka mu ta,’ Van leh lei a mangthang zong, Pasian kammal kipden ding Tuni-in tha thak hong guan hi.

title: KAMCIAM NONG PIA NGAM DIAM?
body:
Topan hong sem ding,Lam etna teng bei ciang in Tel zawhloh ama zia tawh Topan kei hong hilh ding hi Lam hong lak ding hiA mah’n hong ompih den ding Itna leh hehpihna tawh A nisim in ah, lam hong pi den ding,

Sehnel gam ah kei hong tonpih in lam hong lak Sehnel gam sung ciktui ka mu ta, Van leh lei a mangthang zong Pasian kammal kip den ding Tu ni in thathak hong guan hi.

title: ZION ZAWLLA
body:
Kangaih in kei a hi, kei zong ama a hing Sun leh zan lunggulh ing, sawlbang heina peuhah Nanglo in guabang ka hing zo diam Pheiphung suankhawm, banzal hong len in aw

Na sakmel paallun ee, et in ka cim thei lo Na tongdam khum zungzung, taangbang ka damna hi Simlei ah nang bang a hoih om kei Lungdeih sinthu liibang cinna hi cia

Na kha nuai ah hong seel aw Na liimnuai hong beel sak aw Ka lungdeih nanglo om kei Sinlai vabang hong phawng cia Nang lo in deih cing thei kei Vangngaih Zeisu nang lo

Ka kumpipa na hi, Pasian zong na hi hi Ka pa zong nahi a, ka lawmhoihpen zong na hi Zato mangpa, damna mangpa na hi Sianmang vontawi, minlian pen To Zeisu

title: ZEISU LO BUANG
body:
Hih leitung ah ka khualzinna, lungkim nop cih omlo Leitung teekta, thusia lasia bek na za ding Pilna hileh, hauhna hileh lokhawh singpuakna pan in Lungnopna om nawnlo hi Zeisu lo buang

Kalani mual tungah, a sisan hong bua a Kilawm lopi’n khonkhong nuntakna hong pia zo A liamma hang damna, a zawnkhalna hang hauhna A sisan in ka mawhna teng hong sawpsiang ta

Lungnopna ding ken ka zonga, lungkim nop cih om lo Mualtung lamah kahto diaidiai ka khuadak leh Tua mual hoihpen, kalani mual lungnop kicing tawldamna Tawldam nopna ngah nading Zeisu lo buang

I hunte bei hong kheng diaidiai, anlak hun kheng dekta Apil nga bang meivak taangsak, taangsak veni Mi tul tampi kikhawm mai ah, meivak taanglo a paite Zumna bek hi ding aiveh Zeisu mai ah

title: KA KHA AA DING A HOIH HI
body:
Gunpi taanlo bang nuam na’ng nong hilh na in, Dahna tui bangin hong let hi, Topa hong hilhna pha hi ka kha aa ding, Hoih bel hi, kha aading , hoih bel hi.

Hoih bel hi, hoih bel hi, kha aading ,Hoih bel hi, hoih bel hi, kha aading.

Dawi in hong khem a,bawlsiatna hong tun hang, Ka up dinga thu ciam om hi, Topa zeisu in, ka thanem hong en hi, Hoih bel hi, kha aa ding, hoih bel hi.

Hongit a a nuam I ngaihsut ciangin ah, Ka mawh ka khelh na sung pan-in, Ka suahtakna ding singlamteh tung si hi, Ka lungsim in kaphat hi Topa.

Topa Zeisu tu nung ciang hong pai ding hi, Ka lungkhamna teng bei ding hi, Topa hih leitungah hong pai dingin ah, Ka,kha siangtho aading a pha hi.

title: NOPLUA SI
body:
Leitung i nunsung, haksa thei zel a, Ahih hang Topa muang tawntung peuh le'ng Ei tawh hong omkhawm den hi, Buaina teng veng mang ta, I innkuan sung i vangkhua ah, Nop na kicing hong pia.

Cho Noplua si! Topa, nang tawh tonkhawm le'ng, Lei buaina khempeuh tuikhu bang vengsakpa, Nisim paisan deudeu oh! Haleluijah, Zeisu zawhna sungah lungmuang-in ka omta.

Zeisu bek en in, nung hei nawn lo ding, Ze-etnate in hong tuamcip mah leh, I langah kuan pang zo diam, Lau nawn peuhmah kei ning, Topa tawh tonkhawm peuh le'ng, Bangmah patau keng.

A phattak Zeisu lam bang paak ve ni, Israel mite a paikhiatpihpa, San tuipi kantanpihin, Suangpi pan tui phulsak, Gualzawhna tawh a makai den, Eite' Pasian a hi.

title: TOPA HOIH HI
body:
Topa hoih hi, lungkham hunin hong huh a, Amah a bel mite limtakin kem hi, Sunin ni-in, zanin khapi'n Hong cingin hong gimsak lo a, Vantung mite'n giahphual satin hong kem.

Cho Aw Topa aw, nang na hoih hi, Kei nong itna tumdang diak sa'ng, Nong ompihna ciang a nopin nuam zungzung, Lamet bei dongin ka om a, Ka nu ka pa, kei hong kempa, Ka bangkim ah ka lawm hoihpen na hi.

Na bawlsa kha le aksite ka et ciang, Na phawktham ding mi in bang hi lel a hiamd Tangtel bang lel kei nong itna, Tapa neihsun kei nong pia maw, Kei nong itna lamdangin lianlua sa'ng.

Ka khualzinna hih leitung ah hong tonpih, Hong khah ngei lo, itna khut tawh nong len a, Ka lampi sau, suk le to ah, Lungkhamna huihpi'n hong nawk ciang, Nong ompihna itna awnem ka za.

title: NANG TAWH A HOLIM NUAM BEK HI'NG
body:
Topa nang tungah na khat zong hong ngen kei ning, Nang tawh a holim nuam bek hi'ng, Lungdamna kong kohzawh loh zah ding, Nong piaksa khempeuhte kicing, Nang tawh a holim nuam bek hi'ng

Cho Lungkhamna, dahna zing ciangin thakkha mah ning, Ka khitui tampi luangkha ding, Tua haksatna ka thuak ma-in ah, Lungdam hong ko nua, ing Topa aw, Nang tawh a holim nuam bek hi'ng.

Haksatnate in thu hong ngen sak pahpah a, Tu'n bel a holim nuam bek hi'ng, Kiphatsakna them zong nei lo-in, Lungdamna ko nua in Topa, Nang tawh a holim nuam bek hi'ng

title: MUNKHAT AH GELIN THUNGEN KHIAN NING
body:
Sep dinga kilawm lopi ka sem kha a Gen dinga kilawm lopi ka gen kha hi Tua hun ciang hi ka sep ding Thupha ka ngah nang inah Munkhatah gelin thungen khian ning.

//Kenpawh thungen ning// Lam hongpi ding Topa pha ken nei lel ing //Kenpawh thungen ning// Munkhat ah gelin thungen khian ning

Nisim a hongpiak thupha teng phat peuhleng Ka thumna khempeuh hong dawng cih kathei hi Munkhat ah gelkhia in ah ama kiang thungen peuh leng Ka vangik khemppeuh hong dawn khia hi

title: ZEISU LIANBEL TA HEN
body:
Lam tawntungah kei hong tonpih hi Hong liah hong dal hi Tawntung Pasian kei sung nungta hi A vangliatna tawh kei hong tuam hi Topa lianbel hi Tawntung Pasian keisung nungta hi

Nungta hi Zeisu, keisung nungta hi Han sungpan Zeisu thokik hi Kumpi tokhom tung a vangliatna tawh kidim Zeisu lianbel ta hen

Ka mawhna khempeuh hong maisak zo Kei hong sawpsiang zo Zeisu liamma hangin ka dam zo Zeisu zawngkhalna hangin hau zo Giautau ngei nawnlo Deih teng cing khin Zeisun hong dim zo.

title: EBENEZER
body:
Ang lai ah kapom, aman kei hong kem Vanglian pa’n hong kem, zanni tuni a tawntung Topa in zingvai hong hawm a, Topa ka khuavak hong hi ta

Sambang zal napeuh, van laukha’n hong kem Lungkham huihkhi leh tuihualte hong dai sak hi Tu ciangciang gualzawhna hong pia Gualzawhna mualsuang bang phut ing

Topa na min kong pahtawi hi Nang bang adang pasian omlo Na hoihna te sinlung ka geel ciang Lungdam luankhi te’n nang hong phat zel

title: HONG CIAH KIK LEL DING HI
body:
Jerusalen khuapi sungah, To Zeisu a lutni-in ah, Kisin nai lo lano tungah, Tuangin minthanna ngah, A neipa in kham zo tuan lo, Topa in a deih nungsang, Paipihta e, Jerusalemlam ah.

Cho Topa in a deih a leh, Hong piaksa thuphbate khempeuh, Paipih lel hen, a minthan nading ahih leh, I neihsa bangmah om kei, A sumkem dingte bek i hi, Paipih hen aw, hong ciah kik lel ding hi.

Khazih sung a on u le nau, Hih thupha hi na ngah ngei maw, Satan in a paipihte pen, Hong ciah kik ngei nawn lo ding, Ahih hang vanglian Topa in, A paipih sum le paaite pen, Hong ciah kik hi, a zah tampi tak tawh.

I pianna khua le gam a om, Thu-ummi khangthak lia le taang, Tu ni-in Topa'n nang hong deih, Tu-in nang na man nai hiam, Pang ciatve ni Topa ading, Piakkhiatna le thungetna tawh, I sep kul hi, Topa in hong deih hi

title: HONG PAI IN, THUPHA NAMKIM NAK
body:
Hong pai in, thupha namkim nak, Ka lungsim hong puah sak in, Kang ngeilo nong hehpihna nak, Nakpi’n hong phat theisak in, Vantung mite phatna la-ngaih, Kei zong hong sa thei nuam ing.  Nong itna tung kip ka lungngaih, Tua itna mual ka phat ding.

Nong huhna tawh hih ciang kong tung, Huhna mualsuang hiah phut ing. Nong deihsakna hangin tu-nung, Lungmuanin inn hong tung ning, Lamkhial a Pasian ka nusia, Ahih hang Zeisu’n hong zong, A si manpha tawh hong tankhia Gimna lauhuai pan hong hon.

A nisim-in hong hehpihna A tampi hong basak den, Na hehpihna’n hong khih inla, Na kiang pan hong pial sak ken, Topa kong vaksan dekzeel hi, Ka it Pasian, hong keem in, Hiah! Ka lungsim, nang sung seel ni, Nang a ding na ciamteh in.

title: NANGMAH TAWH PASIAN OMKHAWM TA HEN
body:
Nangmah tawh Pasian omkhawm ta hen A hongpi a hong len dingin A tuu tawh hong kembit ding in Nangmah tawh Pasian omkhawm ta hen

Ih kimuh kik mateng Zeisu kiang kimuh mateng Ih kimuh kik mateng Nangmah tawh Pasian omkhawm ta hen

Nangmah tawh Pasian omkhawm ta hen A kha nuai ah hong liah hong dal in Nisim ‘manna’ hong vak dingin Nangmah tawh Pasian omkhawm ta hen

Nangmah tawh Pasian omkhawm ta hen Launa’n hong lungam sak ciangin Ang sung hong pom bikbek ding Nangmah tawh Pasian omkhawm ta hen

Nangmah tawh Pasian omkhawm ta hen Itna nuai ah hong cing dingin Sihna tuihual satpai dingin Nangmah tawh Pasian omkhawm ta hen

title: PASIAN KHUT SUNG MUAN’HUAI HI
body:
Lam hong lak gumpa ka kiang hong nai ciang, Bangbang hong kimvel hang lau om nawnlo, Huihpi, guahpi-te hong dai sak ding a, A khutkuak sung muan huai hi.

A khutkuak sung-muan huai hi, A khutkuak sung- sung muan huai hi, Bangbang hong kim vel hang lau om nawn lo, A khutkuak sung muan huai hi.

Itna tawh a ang sung kei hong pom ciang, Ki lemna thu kha siangtho hong hilh a, Pasian khut in kei hong kimlet zawh ciang, A khutkuak sung muan huai hi.

Ka khakem kei hong nusia nawn lo ding, Hong itna khau tat-sat zo om nawn lo, Ka theihi, Amah in hong kem den ding, A khutkuak sung muan huai hi.

title: PASIAN KIANG OM DINGIN
body:
Leitung ah launa tampi a om hang, Bangmah kihtak ka nei kei Ki langlo Pasian tawh ka om ciangin, koimah peuh paiding ka laulo.

Tua bangin u leh nau,Pasian lammanah lungkip hen, Cik mah hun lung kia lo-in,Pasian kiang i tun ciangin, Lung nopna bangzah takin a om diam.

Haksatna namkim a hong tun hangin, Bangmah kihtak ka nei kei, Pasian ka kiangah a hong om peuh leh, Koi mah peuh pai ding ka lau lo.

Sihna guam thuk sung dong ka tung zongin, Bang mah kihtak ka nei kei, Gam nuamah om ding Topa gam sungah Koimah peuh pai ding ka lau lo.

Mi namkim in kei hong do hang inah, Bangmah kihtak ka nei kei, Pasian vangliatna a om ka sungah, Koimah peuh pai ding kalau lo.

title: NANG KONG BEL HI
body:
Lungsim gal dona leh dahna sung panin, Kei sang a suangzaw suangpi ka bel nuam hi, Mawhlua, gimlua zo, Nang aa hong hi ta ning, A kip suangpi aw, Nang mah kong belta hi.

Cho -Nang kong bel hi. Nang kong bel hi, Nangmah kong bel hi,A kip thupha suangpi.

Sun in gam daiah, dah in lungleen lai tak, Ze-etna in a vang tawh hong tuam ciangin, Nuntak huihpi nung, Tuipi ki hual laitak, Thupha suangpi aw, hong liah in bittak in.

Gal do lai takin, gal in hong neh ciangin, Tai in kong kozel hi, Ka belh suangpi aw, Tui hual bang ze-et gimna hong tun ciangin, Na sung kong bel hi,Keima kha suangpi aw.

title: TOPA NANG MAH KA IT KA THEI
body:
Leitungah sum khempeuh sangin, Topa kongit zaw hi, Ki sia ngeilo nopsakna in, Topa in hong pia hi.
